CREATE PROCEDURE [DBA].[PC_MontaLimpezaBackups]
    @Modo_Debug BIT = 0,
    @Modo_Simulacao BIT = 0,
    @FiltroDatabase NVARCHAR(128) = NULL -- Opcional: filtrar por database específico
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET ANSI_WARNINGS OFF;
    
    -- ========================================
    -- DECLARAÇÃO DE VARIÁVEIS
    -- ========================================
    DECLARE @inicio_execucao DATETIME2 = SYSDATETIME();
    DECLARE @total_configuracoes INT = 0;
    DECLARE @limpezas_executadas INT = 0;
    DECLARE @limpezas_com_erro INT = 0;
    DECLARE @total_grupos INT = 0;
    
    -- Controle de execução
    DECLARE @erro_geral BIT = 0;
    DECLARE @log_execucao NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'';
    
    PRINT N'========================================';
    PRINT N'INICIANDO LIMPEZA DE BACKUPS ANTIGOS - MODO OTIMIZADO';
    PRINT N'========================================';
    PRINT N'Data/Hora: ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(25), @inicio_execucao, 121);
    PRINT N'Modo Simulação: ' + CASE WHEN @Modo_Simulacao = 1 THEN N'SIM' ELSE N'NÃO' END;
    IF @FiltroDatabase IS NOT NULL
        PRINT N'Filtro Database: ' + @FiltroDatabase;
    PRINT N'';

    -- ========================================
    -- CRIAÇÃO DA TABELA TEMPORÁRIA UNIFICADA
    -- ========================================
    CREATE TABLE #configuracoes_limpeza (
        IdBanco INT,
        NomeBanco NVARCHAR(128),
        TipoBackup NVARCHAR(10),
        CaminhoBackup NVARCHAR(500),
        DiasParaManter INT,
        MinArquivosParaManter INT
    );

    -- ========================================
    -- COLETA DE CONFIGURAÇÕES DE LIMPEZA
    -- ========================================
    BEGIN TRY
        -- Coletar configurações de FULL, DIFF e LOG
        INSERT INTO #configuracoes_limpeza (IdBanco, NomeBanco, TipoBackup, CaminhoBackup, DiasParaManter, MinArquivosParaManter)
        -- FULL
        SELECT 
            B.Id,
            B.Nome,
            N'FULL',
            COALESCE(CBF.Caminho, N''),
            ISNULL(CBF.DiasManterBackup, 7),
            ISNULL(CBF.MinimoArquivosManter, 1)
        FROM [DBA].[Banco] B
        INNER JOIN [DBA].[ConfiguracaoBackupFull] CBF ON B.Id = CBF.IdBanco
        WHERE CBF.AtivoBackupFull = 1 
            AND (@FiltroDatabase IS NULL OR B.Nome = @FiltroDatabase)
        
        UNION ALL
        
        -- DIFF
        SELECT 
            B.Id,
            B.Nome,
            N'DIFF',
            COALESCE(CBD.Caminho, N''),
            ISNULL(CBD.DiasManterBackup, 7),
            ISNULL(CBD.MinimoArquivosManter, 1)
        FROM [DBA].[Banco] B
        INNER JOIN [DBA].[ConfiguracaoBackupDiff] CBD ON B.Id = CBD.IdBanco
        WHERE CBD.AtivoBackupDiff = 1 
            AND (@FiltroDatabase IS NULL OR B.Nome = @FiltroDatabase)
        
        UNION ALL
        
        -- LOG
        SELECT 
            B.Id,
            B.Nome,
            N'LOG',
            COALESCE(CBL.Caminho, N''),
            ISNULL(CBL.DiasManterBackup, 7),
            ISNULL(CBL.MinimoArquivosManter, 1)
        FROM [DBA].[Banco] B
        INNER JOIN [DBA].[ConfiguracaoBackupLog] CBL ON B.Id = CBL.IdBanco
        WHERE CBL.AtivoBackupLOG = 1 
            AND (@FiltroDatabase IS NULL OR B.Nome = @FiltroDatabase);
            
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        PRINT N'ERRO ao coletar configurações de limpeza: ' + ERROR_MESSAGE();
        RETURN -1;
    END CATCH

    -- Verificar se encontrou configurações
    SELECT @total_configuracoes = COUNT(*) FROM #configuracoes_limpeza;
    
    IF @total_configuracoes = 0
    BEGIN
        PRINT N'AVISO: Nenhuma configuração de limpeza encontrada.';
        PRINT N'Verifique as tabelas de configuração.';
        RETURN 0;
    END
    
    PRINT N'Total de configurações de limpeza encontradas: ' + CAST(@total_configuracoes AS NVARCHAR(10));
    PRINT N'';

    -- ========================================
    -- CRIAR GRUPOS DE LIMPEZA OTIMIZADOS
    -- ========================================
    CREATE TABLE #grupos_limpeza (
        Id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
        TipoBackup NVARCHAR(10),
        CaminhoBackup NVARCHAR(500),
        DiasParaManter INT,
        MinArquivosParaManter INT,
        ListaBancos NVARCHAR(MAX),
        QuantidadeBancos INT
    );

    -- Agrupar configurações similares
    INSERT INTO #grupos_limpeza (TipoBackup, CaminhoBackup, DiasParaManter, MinArquivosParaManter, ListaBancos, QuantidadeBancos)
    SELECT 
        TipoBackup,
        CaminhoBackup,
        DiasParaManter,
        MinArquivosParaManter,
        STRING_AGG(NomeBanco, N',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY NomeBanco),
        COUNT(*)
    FROM #configuracoes_limpeza 
    GROUP BY TipoBackup, CaminhoBackup, DiasParaManter, MinArquivosParaManter;

    SELECT @total_grupos = COUNT(*) FROM #grupos_limpeza;

    -- ========================================
    -- EXECUTAR LIMPEZA AGRUPADA
    -- ========================================
    DECLARE @grupo_id INT;
    DECLARE @tipo_backup_grupo NVARCHAR(10);
    DECLARE @caminho_grupo NVARCHAR(500);
    DECLARE @dias_manter INT;
    DECLARE @min_arquivos INT;
    DECLARE @lista_bancos NVARCHAR(MAX);
    DECLARE @qtd_bancos INT;

    DECLARE GrupoCursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD READ_ONLY FOR
    SELECT Id, TipoBackup, CaminhoBackup, DiasParaManter, MinArquivosParaManter, ListaBancos, QuantidadeBancos
    FROM #grupos_limpeza
    ORDER BY QuantidadeBancos DESC;

    OPEN GrupoCursor;
    FETCH NEXT FROM GrupoCursor INTO @grupo_id, @tipo_backup_grupo, @caminho_grupo, @dias_manter, @min_arquivos, @lista_bancos, @qtd_bancos;

    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
        PRINT N'----------------------------------------';
        PRINT N'Executando LIMPEZA ' + UPPER(@tipo_backup_grupo) + N' para ' + CAST(@qtd_bancos AS NVARCHAR(10)) + N' banco(s)';
        PRINT N'Bancos: ' + @lista_bancos;
        PRINT N'Caminho: ' + ISNULL(@caminho_grupo, N'Padrão');
        PRINT N'Dias para manter: ' + CAST(@dias_manter AS NVARCHAR(10));
        PRINT N'Mínimo de arquivos: ' + CAST(@min_arquivos AS NVARCHAR(10));
        PRINT N'----------------------------------------';
        
        IF @Modo_Debug = 1
        BEGIN
            PRINT N'  [DEBUG] Comando que seria executado:';
            PRINT N'  EXEC [DBA].[PC_LimparBackupsAntigos]';
            PRINT N'      @CaminhoBackup = N''' + @caminho_grupo + N''',';
            PRINT N'      @NomeBanco = N''' + @lista_bancos + N''',';
            PRINT N'      @IdBanco = 0, -- Será processado individualmente';
            PRINT N'      @TipoBackup = N''' + @tipo_backup_grupo + N''',';
            PRINT N'      @DiasParaManter = ' + CAST(@dias_manter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + N',';
            PRINT N'      @MinArquivosParaManter = ' + CAST(@min_arquivos AS NVARCHAR(10)) + N',';
            PRINT N'      @ModoDebug = ' + CAST(@Modo_Debug AS NVARCHAR(1)) + N',';
            PRINT N'      @ModoSimulacao = ' + CAST(@Modo_Simulacao AS NVARCHAR(1));
            PRINT N'';
            
            SET @limpezas_executadas = @limpezas_executadas + @qtd_bancos;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            -- Processar cada banco individualmente (devido ao @IdBanco)
            DECLARE @banco_atual NVARCHAR(128);
            DECLARE @id_banco_atual INT;
            DECLARE @pos INT = 1;
            DECLARE @lista_temp NVARCHAR(MAX) = @lista_bancos + N',';
            
            WHILE CHARINDEX(N',', @lista_temp, @pos) > 0
            BEGIN
                SET @banco_atual = LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(@lista_temp, @pos, CHARINDEX(N',', @lista_temp, @pos) - @pos)));
                
                IF LEN(@banco_atual) > 0
                BEGIN
                    -- Obter ID do banco
                    SELECT @id_banco_atual = Id 
                    FROM [DBA].[Banco] 
                    WHERE Nome = @banco_atual;
                    
                    BEGIN TRY
                        EXEC [DBA].[PC_LimparBackupsAntigos]
                            @CaminhoBackup = @caminho_grupo,
                            @NomeBanco = @banco_atual,
                            @IdBanco = @id_banco_atual,
                            @TipoBackup = @tipo_backup_grupo,
                            @DiasParaManter = @dias_manter,
                            @MinArquivosParaManter = @min_arquivos,
                            @ModoDebug = @Modo_Debug,
                            @ModoSimulacao = @Modo_Simulacao;
                        
                        SET @limpezas_executadas = @limpezas_executadas + 1;
                        PRINT N'  ✅ LIMPEZA ' + UPPER(@tipo_backup_grupo) + N' concluída para: ' + @banco_atual;
                        
                    END TRY
                    BEGIN CATCH
                        SET @erro_geral = 1;
                        SET @limpezas_com_erro = @limpezas_com_erro + 1;
                        
                        DECLARE @error_msg NVARCHAR(MAX) = ERROR_MESSAGE();
                        
                        PRINT N'  ❌ ERRO na LIMPEZA ' + UPPER(@tipo_backup_grupo) + N' para ' + @banco_atual + N': ' + @error_msg;
                        
                        SET @log_execucao = @log_execucao + N'ERRO LIMPEZA ' + UPPER(@tipo_backup_grupo) + 
                                           N' [' + @banco_atual + N']: ' + @error_msg + NCHAR(13) + NCHAR(10);
                        
                        -- Registrar erro
                        INSERT INTO [DBA].[TarefasManutencaoErro] (NomeBanco, Comando, Erro, DataInserido)
                        VALUES (@banco_atual, 
                               N'LIMPEZA ' + UPPER(@tipo_backup_grupo), 
                               N'Erro: ' + @error_msg, 
                               GETDATE());
                    END CATCH
                END
                
                SET @pos = CHARINDEX(N',', @lista_temp, @pos) + 1;
            END
            PRINT N'';
        END

        FETCH NEXT FROM GrupoCursor INTO @grupo_id, @tipo_backup_grupo, @caminho_grupo, @dias_manter, @min_arquivos, @lista_bancos, @qtd_bancos;
    END

    CLOSE GrupoCursor;
    DEALLOCATE GrupoCursor;

    -- ========================================
    -- RELATÓRIO FINAL E ESTATÍSTICAS
    -- ========================================
    DECLARE @fim_execucao DATETIME2 = SYSDATETIME();
    DECLARE @duracao_ms BIGINT = DATEDIFF(MILLISECOND, @inicio_execucao, @fim_execucao);
    DECLARE @duracao_formatada NVARCHAR(50) = 
        CASE 
            WHEN @duracao_ms < 1000 THEN CAST(@duracao_ms AS NVARCHAR(10)) + N'ms'
            WHEN @duracao_ms < 60000 THEN CAST(@duracao_ms/1000.0 AS NVARCHAR(10)) + N's'
            ELSE CAST(@duracao_ms/60000.0 AS NVARCHAR(10)) + N'min'
        END;
    
    DECLARE @taxa_sucesso DECIMAL(5,2) = 
        CASE WHEN @limpezas_executadas > 0 
             THEN ((@limpezas_executadas - @limpezas_com_erro) * 100.0) / @limpezas_executadas
             ELSE 0 
        END;
        
    DECLARE @economia_execucoes INT = @total_configuracoes - @total_grupos;
    DECLARE @eficiencia_percentual DECIMAL(5,2) = 
        CASE WHEN @total_configuracoes > 0 
             THEN (@total_grupos * 100.0) / @total_configuracoes
             ELSE 0 
        END;
    
    PRINT N'========================================';
    PRINT N'LIMPEZA DE BACKUPS FINALIZADA';
    PRINT N'========================================';
    PRINT N'Configurações processadas: ' + CAST(@total_configuracoes AS NVARCHAR(10));
    PRINT N'Limpezas executadas: ' + CAST(@limpezas_executadas AS NVARCHAR(10));
    PRINT N'Limpezas com erro: ' + CAST(@limpezas_com_erro AS NVARCHAR(10));
    PRINT N'Taxa de sucesso: ' + CAST(@taxa_sucesso AS NVARCHAR(10)) + N'%';
    PRINT N'Duração total: ' + @duracao_formatada;
    PRINT N'Status geral: ' + CASE WHEN @erro_geral = 1 THEN N'COM ERROS' ELSE N'SUCESSO' END;
    PRINT N'Finalizado em: ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(25), @fim_execucao, 121);
    PRINT N'';
    PRINT N'OTIMIZAÇÃO ALCANÇADA:';
    PRINT N'Total de grupos criados: ' + CAST(@total_grupos AS NVARCHAR(10));
    PRINT N'Execuções economizadas: ' + CAST(@economia_execucoes AS NVARCHAR(10));
    PRINT N'Eficiência: ' + CAST(@eficiencia_percentual AS NVARCHAR(10)) + N'% de redução nas execuções';
    
    -- Log de erros se houver
    IF @erro_geral = 1 AND LEN(@log_execucao) > 0
    BEGIN
        PRINT N'';
        PRINT N'========================================';
        PRINT N'LOG DE ERROS DETALHADO:';
        PRINT N'========================================';
        PRINT @log_execucao;
    END

    -- Relatório detalhado em modo debug
    IF @Modo_Debug = 1
    BEGIN
        PRINT N'';
        PRINT N'========================================';
        PRINT N'DETALHAMENTO DOS GRUPOS CRIADOS:';
        PRINT N'========================================';
        
        SELECT 
            Id as GrupoID,
            TipoBackup,
            QuantidadeBancos,
            LEFT(ListaBancos, 100) + CASE WHEN LEN(ListaBancos) > 100 THEN N'...' ELSE N'' END as BancosResumo,
            CASE WHEN LEN(CaminhoBackup) > 0 THEN CaminhoBackup ELSE N'Padrão' END as CaminhoBackup,
            DiasParaManter,
            MinArquivosParaManter
        FROM #grupos_limpeza
        ORDER BY QuantidadeBancos DESC, TipoBackup;
    END

    -- ========================================
    -- RESULTADO FINAL (SELECT para retorno)
    -- ========================================
    SELECT 
        @total_configuracoes as ConfiguracoesProcessadas,
        @limpezas_executadas as LimpezasExecutadas,
        @limpezas_com_erro as LimpezasComErro,
        @total_grupos as GruposCriados,
        @economia_execucoes as ExecucoesEconomizadas,
        CAST(@eficiencia_percentual AS NVARCHAR(10)) + N'%' as EficienciaPercentual,
        @taxa_sucesso as TaxaSucessoPercentual,
        @duracao_formatada as DuracaoTotal,
        CASE WHEN @erro_geral = 1 THEN N'COM ERROS' ELSE N'SUCESSO' END as StatusGeral,
        @inicio_execucao as InicioExecucao,
        @fim_execucao as FimExecucao;

    -- Limpeza
    DROP TABLE #configuracoes_limpeza;
    DROP TABLE #grupos_limpeza;
    
    -- Retorno do procedimento
    RETURN CASE WHEN @erro_geral = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
END
GO

    DROP PROCEDURE [DBA].[PC_AplicarCompressaoPageIndices];

CREATE PROCEDURE [DBA].[PC_AplicarCompressaoPageIndices]
    @IdBanco BIGINT,				-- ID único do banco de dados
    @NomeBanco NVARCHAR(255),		-- Nome do banco de dados para manutenção
	@RealizaCompressaoIndices BIT,	-- Verificar se realizar Compressao de indices
    @TamanhoMinimoMB INT = 10,		-- Tamanho mínimo do índice em MB para aplicar compressão (padrão: 10MB)
    @ExecutarComandos BIT = 0		-- 0 = Apenas gera comandos, 1 = Gera e executa comandos
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        /*
        ==================================================================================
        PROCEDURE: PC_AplicarCompressaoPageIndices
        DESCRIÇÃO: Identifica índices sem compressão PAGE e gera/executa comandos 
                   para aplicar compressão nos índices elegíveis
        
        PARÂMETROS:
        - @IdBanco: Identificador único do banco
        - @NomeBanco: Nome do banco para executar a manutenção
        - @TamanhoMinimoMB: Tamanho mínimo em MB para aplicar compressão
        - @ExecutarComandos: Define se apenas gera ou também executa os comandos
        
        CRITÉRIOS PARA COMPRESSÃO:
        - Índice não possui compressão PAGE
        - Tamanho do índice >= @TamanhoMinimoMB
        - Não é tabela do sistema
        - Não é tabela In-Memory
        ==================================================================================
        */

		IF (@RealizaCompressaoIndices = 0)
		RETURN;

        -- Remove registros de execuções anteriores para evitar duplicatas
        DELETE FROM [DBA].[TarefasManutencao] 
        WHERE TipoComando = 3 AND DataRodou IS NOT NULL; -- TipoComando = 3 para compressão

        -- Declaração de variáveis principais
        DECLARE @comandoSql NVARCHAR(MAX);        -- Comando SQL a ser executado
        DECLARE @nomeObjeto NVARCHAR(255);        -- Nome completo do objeto (schema.tabela)
        DECLARE @idBancoDados INT = DB_ID(@NomeBanco); -- ID do banco de dados
        DECLARE @contadorIndices INT = 0;         -- Contador de índices processados

        /*
        ==================================================================================
        CRIAÇÃO DE TABELA TEMPORÁRIA PARA ARMAZENAR ÍNDICES SEM COMPRESSÃO
        ==================================================================================
        */
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#IndicesSemCompressao') IS NOT NULL 
            DROP TABLE #IndicesSemCompressao;

        CREATE TABLE #IndicesSemCompressao (
            ObjectId INT,                    -- ID do objeto (tabela)
            IndexId INT,                     -- ID do índice
            NomeSchema SYSNAME,              -- Nome do schema
            NomeTabela SYSNAME,              -- Nome da tabela
            NomeIndice SYSNAME,              -- Nome do índice
            TamanhoMB DECIMAL(10,2),         -- Tamanho atual em MB
            QuantidadePaginas INT,           -- Número de páginas
        );

        /*
        ==================================================================================
        COLETA DE INFORMAÇÕES DOS ÍNDICES SEM COMPRESSÃO PAGE
        ==================================================================================
        */
          DECLARE @sqlDinamico NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'
        USE ' + QUOTENAME(@NomeBanco) + N';
        
        INSERT INTO #IndicesSemCompressao (
            ObjectId, IndexId, NomeSchema, NomeTabela, NomeIndice, 
            TamanhoMB,  QuantidadePaginas
        )
        SELECT 
			    i.object_id,
			    i.index_id,
			    OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(i.object_id) AS NomeSchema,
			    OBJECT_NAME(i.object_id) AS NomeTabela,
			    i.name AS NomeIndice,
			    CAST((p.page_count * 8.0) / 1024 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TamanhoMB,
			    p.page_count AS QuantidadePaginas
			FROM sys.indexes i
			INNER JOIN sys.tables t ON i.object_id = t.object_id
			INNER JOIN sys.dm_db_index_physical_stats(@idBancoDados, NULL, NULL, NULL, ''LIMITED'') p
			    ON i.object_id = p.object_id AND i.index_id = p.index_id
			INNER JOIN sys.partitions ps ON i.object_id = ps.object_id AND i.index_id = ps.index_id
			WHERE 
			    i.index_id > 0
			    AND t.is_ms_shipped = 0
			    AND t.is_memory_optimized = 0
			    AND i.type IN (1, 2)
			    AND ps.data_compression = 0
			    AND (p.page_count * 8.0) / 1024 >= @TamanhoMinimoMB
			    AND i.is_disabled = 0
			GROUP BY 
			    i.object_id, 
			    i.index_id, 
			    OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(i.object_id), 
			    OBJECT_NAME(i.object_id), 
			    i.name, 
			    p.page_count
			ORDER BY TamanhoMB DESC;
		';

        -- Executa o SQL dinâmico
        EXEC sp_executesql @sqlDinamico, 
             N'@idBancoDados INT, @TamanhoMinimoMB INT', 
             @idBancoDados = @idBancoDados, 
             @TamanhoMinimoMB = @TamanhoMinimoMB;

        /*
        ==================================================================================
        PROCESSAMENTO DOS ÍNDICES IDENTIFICADOS
        ==================================================================================
        */
        DECLARE @nomeSchema SYSNAME;
        DECLARE @nomeTabela SYSNAME;
        DECLARE @nomeIndice SYSNAME;
        DECLARE @tamanhoMB DECIMAL(10,2);
        DECLARE @tipoCompressaoAtual NVARCHAR(10);
        DECLARE @tipoIndice NVARCHAR(20);
        DECLARE @quantidadePaginas INT;

        -- Cursor para processar cada índice individualmente
        DECLARE cursorIndicesCompressao CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR
            SELECT 
                NomeSchema, NomeTabela, NomeIndice, TamanhoMB, QuantidadePaginas
            FROM #IndicesSemCompressao
            ORDER BY TamanhoMB DESC; -- Processa primeiro os maiores índices

        OPEN cursorIndicesCompressao;
        FETCH NEXT FROM cursorIndicesCompressao 
        INTO @nomeSchema, @nomeTabela, @nomeIndice, @tamanhoMB, @quantidadePaginas;

        WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
            SET @nomeObjeto = QUOTENAME(@nomeSchema) + '.' + QUOTENAME(@nomeTabela);
            SET @contadorIndices = @contadorIndices + 1;

            -- Monta o comando de compressão baseado no tamanho e tipo do índice
            IF @tamanhoMB >= 100 -- Índices grandes - rebuild com opções otimizadas
            BEGIN
                SET @comandoSql = N'USE ' + QUOTENAME(@NomeBanco) + ';' + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) +
                  N'ALTER INDEX ' + QUOTENAME(@nomeIndice) + ' ON ' + @nomeObjeto + 
                  N' REBUILD WITH (' + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) +
                  N'    DATA_COMPRESSION = PAGE,' + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) +
                  N'    FILLFACTOR = 85,' + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) +
                  N'    PAD_INDEX = ON,' + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) +
                  N'    SORT_IN_TEMPDB = ON' + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) +
                  N');';
            END
            ELSE IF @tamanhoMB >= 50 -- Índices médios
            BEGIN
                SET @comandoSql = N'USE ' + QUOTENAME(@NomeBanco) + ';' + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) +
                  N'ALTER INDEX ' + QUOTENAME(@nomeIndice) + ' ON ' + @nomeObjeto + 
                  N' REBUILD WITH (' + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) +
                  N'    DATA_COMPRESSION = PAGE,' + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) +
                  N'    FILLFACTOR = 90,' + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) +
                  N'    SORT_IN_TEMPDB = ON' + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) +
                  N');';
            END
            ELSE -- Índices menores
            BEGIN
                SET @comandoSql = N'USE ' + QUOTENAME(@NomeBanco) + ';' + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) +
                  N'ALTER INDEX ' + QUOTENAME(@nomeIndice) + ' ON ' + @nomeObjeto + 
                  N' REBUILD WITH (DATA_COMPRESSION = PAGE);';
            END

			IF NOT EXISTS( SELECT * FROM [DBA].[TarefasManutencao] WHERE IdBanco = @IdBanco AND Comando = @comandoSql)
			BEGIN
				-- Insere o comando na tabela de tarefas
				INSERT INTO [DBA].[TarefasManutencao] (
				    TipoComando, Objeto, Comando, NomeBanco, IdBanco, DataInserido
				)
				VALUES (
				    3, -- TipoComando = 3 para compressão
				    @nomeObjeto + '.' + @nomeIndice + ' (' + @tipoCompressaoAtual + ' -> PAGE, ' + 
				    CAST(@tamanhoMB AS NVARCHAR(20)) + 'MB)',
				    @comandoSql,
				    @NomeBanco,
				    @IdBanco,
				    GETDATE()
				);
			END

            -- Se configurado para executar, executa o comando
            IF @ExecutarComandos = 1
            BEGIN
                BEGIN TRY
                    PRINT 'Executando compressão PAGE no índice: ' + @nomeObjeto + '.' + @nomeIndice + 
                          ' (Tamanho: ' + CAST(@tamanhoMB AS NVARCHAR(20)) + 'MB)';
                    
                    EXEC sp_executesql @comandoSql;
                    
					SELECT * FROM [DBA].[TarefasManutencao] 

                    -- Atualiza registro indicando sucesso
                    UPDATE [DBA].[TarefasManutencao] 
                    SET DataRodou = GETDATE()
                    WHERE TipoComando = 3 
                      AND Objeto = @nomeObjeto + '.' + @nomeIndice + ' (' + @tipoCompressaoAtual + ' -> PAGE, ' + 
                                   CAST(@tamanhoMB AS NVARCHAR(20)) + 'MB)'
                      AND DataRodou IS NULL;

                    PRINT 'Compressão aplicada com sucesso!';
                    
                END TRY
                BEGIN CATCH
                    -- Em caso de erro na execução, registra o erro
                    DECLARE @erroExecucao NVARCHAR(MAX) = ERROR_MESSAGE();
                    
                    UPDATE [DBA].[TarefasManutencao] 
                    SET DataRodou = GETDATE()
                    WHERE TipoComando = 3 
                      AND Objeto = @nomeObjeto + '.' + @nomeIndice + ' (' + @tipoCompressaoAtual + ' -> PAGE, ' + 
                                   CAST(@tamanhoMB AS NVARCHAR(20)) + 'MB)'
                      AND DataRodou IS NULL;

                    PRINT 'ERRO ao aplicar compressão: ' + @erroExecucao;
                    
                    -- Continua processando outros índices mesmo com erro
                END CATCH
            END

            FETCH NEXT FROM cursorIndicesCompressao 
            INTO @nomeSchema, @nomeTabela, @nomeIndice, @tamanhoMB, @quantidadePaginas;
        END

        CLOSE cursorIndicesCompressao;
        DEALLOCATE cursorIndicesCompressao;

        /*
        ==================================================================================
        RELATÓRIO FINAL
        ==================================================================================
        */
        PRINT '==================================================================================';
        PRINT 'RELATÓRIO DE COMPRESSÃO PAGE - BANCO: ' + @NomeBanco;
        PRINT '==================================================================================';
        PRINT 'Total de índices identificados para compressão: ' + CAST(@contadorIndices AS NVARCHAR(10));
        PRINT 'Tamanho mínimo considerado: ' + CAST(@TamanhoMinimoMB AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ' MB';
        PRINT 'Modo de execução: ' + CASE WHEN @ExecutarComandos = 1 THEN 'EXECUTAR COMANDOS' ELSE 'APENAS GERAR COMANDOS' END;
        
        IF @ExecutarComandos = 0
        BEGIN
            PRINT '';
            PRINT 'ATENÇÃO: Os comandos foram apenas gerados. Para executar, defina @ExecutarComandos = 1';
            PRINT 'Consulte a tabela [DBA].[TarefasManutencao] para ver os comandos gerados.';
        END
        
        PRINT '==================================================================================';

        /*
        ==================================================================================
        LIMPEZA DE TABELAS TEMPORÁRIAS
        ==================================================================================
        */
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#IndicesSemCompressao') IS NOT NULL 
            DROP TABLE #IndicesSemCompressao;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        /*
        ==================================================================================
        TRATAMENTO DE ERROS
        ==================================================================================
        */
        
        DECLARE @numeroErro INT = ERROR_NUMBER();
        DECLARE @severidadeErro INT = ERROR_SEVERITY();
        DECLARE @estadoErro INT = ERROR_STATE();
        DECLARE @procedureErro NVARCHAR(128) = ERROR_PROCEDURE();
        DECLARE @linhaErro INT = ERROR_LINE();
        DECLARE @mensagemErro NVARCHAR(4000) = ERROR_MESSAGE();
        
        -- Monta mensagem de erro detalhada
        DECLARE @mensagemCompleta NVARCHAR(MAX) = 
            N'ERRO na procedure ' + ISNULL(@procedureErro, 'PC_AplicarCompressaoPageIndices') + 
            N' - Banco: ' + @NomeBanco + 
            N' (ID: ' + CAST(@IdBanco AS NVARCHAR(20)) + N')' + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) +
            N'Número: ' + CAST(@numeroErro AS NVARCHAR(10)) + 
            N' | Severidade: ' + CAST(@severidadeErro AS NVARCHAR(10)) + 
            N' | Estado: ' + CAST(@estadoErro AS NVARCHAR(10)) + 
            N' | Linha: ' + CAST(@linhaErro AS NVARCHAR(10)) + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) +
            N'Mensagem: ' + @mensagemErro;

        -- Registra o erro (assumindo que a tabela existe)
        BEGIN TRY
            INSERT INTO [DBA].[TarefasManutencaoErro] (NomeBanco, Comando, Erro, DataInserido)
            VALUES (@NomeBanco, 'PC_AplicarCompressaoPageIndices', @mensagemCompleta, GETDATE());
        END TRY
        BEGIN CATCH
            -- Se não conseguir registrar o erro, apenas imprime
            PRINT @mensagemCompleta;
        END CATCH

        -- Limpeza de tabelas temporárias em caso de erro
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#IndicesSemCompressao') IS NOT NULL 
            DROP TABLE #IndicesSemCompressao;

        -- Re-propaga o erro
        RAISERROR(@mensagemCompleta, @severidadeErro, @estadoErro);
        
    END CATCH
END
GO

scripts.name: Manutenção do banco - Parte 2
scripts.content:
USE [DBA_MetaManutencao];
GO

SET NOCOUNT ON;
GO


IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.schemas WHERE name = 'DBA')
BEGIN
    EXEC('CREATE SCHEMA [DBA]');
END

/*==============================================================================
  INDEX ADVISOR - BLOCO 1
  TABELAS / ESTRUTURA BASE
==============================================================================*/

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.schemas WHERE name = N'Manutencao')
    EXEC('CREATE SCHEMA Manutencao AUTHORIZATION dbo;');
GO

/*==============================================================================
  1) CONFIGURAO GERAL
     - defaults fixos para evitar dependncia de configurao manual do suporte
==============================================================================*/
IF OBJECT_ID(N'Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_Config', N'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_Config
    (PC_IndexAdvisor_GenerateIndexPlan
        [TargetDatabaseName] SYSNAME NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [PK_IndexAdvisor_Config] PRIMARY KEY,

        /* ndices */
        [DefaultPhysicalStatsMode] NVARCHAR(10) NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_DefaultPhysicalStatsMode] DEFAULT(N'LIMITED'),

        [LowFragThreshold] FLOAT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_LowFragThreshold] DEFAULT(5.0),

        [ReorgThreshold] FLOAT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_ReorgThreshold] DEFAULT(10.0),

        [RebuildThreshold] FLOAT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_RebuildThreshold] DEFAULT(30.0),

        [MinPageCount] BIGINT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_MinPageCount] DEFAULT(128),

        [WriteHeavyRatio] FLOAT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_WriteHeavyRatio] DEFAULT(2.0),

        [MinWritesForWriteHeavy] BIGINT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_MinWritesForWriteHeavy] DEFAULT(50000),

        [SplitRateHigh] FLOAT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_SplitRateHigh] DEFAULT(0.02),

        [SplitRateMed] FLOAT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_SplitRateMed] DEFAULT(0.005),

        [PreferPageCompressionMinMB] INT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_PreferPageCompressionMinMB] DEFAULT(512),

        [SortMinIndexSizeMB] INT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_SortMinIndexSizeMB] DEFAULT(512),

        [TempdbFreeMultiplier] FLOAT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_TempdbFreeMultiplier] DEFAULT(1.5),

        [TempdbLatencyFactor] FLOAT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_TempdbLatencyFactor] DEFAULT(1.2),

        [MaxTempdbFilesRecommended] INT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_MaxTempdbFilesRecommended] DEFAULT(8),

        [TempdbImbalancePct] FLOAT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_TempdbImbalancePct] DEFAULT(10.0),

        /* Estatsticas */
        [IncludeUpdateStats] BIT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_IncludeUpdateStats] DEFAULT(1),

        [StatsMinModificationCount] BIGINT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_StatsMinModificationCount] DEFAULT(10000),

        [StatsSmallObjectRows] BIGINT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_StatsSmallObjectRows] DEFAULT(500000),

        [StatsMediumObjectRows] BIGINT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_StatsMediumObjectRows] DEFAULT(5000000),

        [StatsLargeObjectRows] BIGINT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_StatsLargeObjectRows] DEFAULT(50000000),

        [StatsStalePctSmall] FLOAT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_StatsStalePctSmall] DEFAULT(0.10),

        [StatsStalePctMedium] FLOAT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_StatsStalePctMedium] DEFAULT(0.10),

        [StatsStalePctLarge] FLOAT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_StatsStalePctLarge] DEFAULT(0.05),

        [StatsStalePctVeryLarge] FLOAT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_StatsStalePctVeryLarge] DEFAULT(0.03),

        [StatsSamplePercentMedium] INT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_StatsSamplePercentMedium] DEFAULT(50),

        [StatsSamplePercentLarge] INT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_StatsSamplePercentLarge] DEFAULT(20),

        [StatsSamplePercentVeryLarge] INT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_StatsSamplePercentVeryLarge] DEFAULT(10),

        /* Config DB */
        [AllowRecommendRCSI] BIT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_AllowRecommendRCSI] DEFAULT(1),

        [AllowRecommendSnapshotIsolation] BIT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_AllowRecommendSnapshotIsolation] DEFAULT(1),

        [AllowRecommendAsyncStats] BIT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_AllowRecommendAsyncStats] DEFAULT(1),

        [AllowRecommendQueryStore] BIT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_AllowRecommendQueryStore] DEFAULT(1),

        /* Histrico */
        [KeepDays_EnvironmentSnapshot] INT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_KeepDays_EnvironmentSnapshot] DEFAULT(90),

        [KeepDays_IndexSnapshot] INT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_KeepDays_IndexSnapshot] DEFAULT(60),

        [KeepDays_StatsSnapshot] INT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_KeepDays_StatsSnapshot] DEFAULT(60),

        [KeepDays_IndexPlan] INT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_KeepDays_IndexPlan] DEFAULT(60),

        [KeepDays_StatsPlan] INT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_KeepDays_StatsPlan] DEFAULT(60),

        [KeepDays_DbConfigPlan] INT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_KeepDays_DbConfigPlan] DEFAULT(60),

        [UpdatedAt] DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Config_UpdatedAt] DEFAULT(SYSUTCDATETIME())
    );
END
GO

/*==============================================================================
  2) SNAPSHOT DE AMBIENTE
==============================================================================*/
IF OBJECT_ID(N'Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_EnvironmentSnapshot', N'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_EnvironmentSnapshot
    (
        [SnapshotId] BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [PK_EnvironmentSnapshot] PRIMARY KEY,

        [CapturedAt] DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Env_CapturedAt] DEFAULT(SYSUTCDATETIME()),

        [ServerName] SYSNAME NULL,
        [InstanceName] SYSNAME NULL,

        [TargetDatabaseId] INT NOT NULL,
        [TargetDatabaseName] SYSNAME NOT NULL,
        [DbCompatibility] INT NOT NULL,

        [CpuCount] INT NULL,
        [HyperthreadRatio] INT NULL,
        [PhysicalMemoryMB] BIGINT NULL,
        [AvailableMemoryMB] BIGINT NULL,
        [SqlServerStartTime] DATETIME NULL,

        [Edition] NVARCHAR(200) NULL,
        [ProductVersion] NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
        [EngineEdition] INT NULL,

        [TempdbDataFiles] INT NULL,
        [TempdbTotalMB] DECIMAL(19,2) NULL,
        [TempdbMinMB] DECIMAL(19,2) NULL,
        [TempdbMaxMB] DECIMAL(19,2) NULL,
        [TempdbImbalancePct] DECIMAL(19,2) NULL,
        [TempdbPercentGrowthFiles] INT NULL,
        [TempdbFreeMB] DECIMAL(19,2) NULL,
        [TempdbUserObjMB] DECIMAL(19,2) NULL,
        [TempdbInternalObjMB] DECIMAL(19,2) NULL,
        [TempdbVersionStoreMB] DECIMAL(19,2) NULL,
        [TempdbWriteLatencyMs] DECIMAL(19,4) NULL,
        [TempdbReadLatencyMs] DECIMAL(19,4) NULL,
        [DbWriteLatencyMs] DECIMAL(19,4) NULL,
        [DbReadLatencyMs] DECIMAL(19,4) NULL,
        [TempdbPagelatchWaitingTasks] INT NULL,

        [PhysicalStatsModeUsed] NVARCHAR(10) NULL,
        [IsBusinessHours] BIT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_Env_IsBusinessHours] DEFAULT(0)
    );

    CREATE INDEX [IX_Env_TargetDb_CapturedAt]
        ON Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_EnvironmentSnapshot([TargetDatabaseName], [CapturedAt] DESC);
END
GO

/*==============================================================================
  3) SNAPSHOT DE NDICES
==============================================================================*/
IF OBJECT_ID(N'Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexSnapshot', N'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexSnapshot
    (
        [IndexSnapshotId] BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [PK_IndexSnapshot] PRIMARY KEY,

        [SnapshotId] BIGINT NOT NULL,
        [CapturedAt] DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL,
        [TargetDatabaseName] SYSNAME NOT NULL,

        [ObjectType] CHAR(1) NOT NULL, -- U/V
        [SchemaName] SYSNAME NOT NULL,
        [ObjectName] SYSNAME NOT NULL,
        [ObjectId] INT NOT NULL,

        [IndexId] INT NOT NULL,
        [IndexName] SYSNAME NOT NULL,
        [IndexTypeDesc] NVARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
        [PartitionNumber] INT NOT NULL,

        [IsDisabled] BIT NOT NULL,
        [IsHypothetical] BIT NOT NULL,
        [IsUnique] BIT NOT NULL,
        [IsPrimaryKey] BIT NOT NULL,
        [HasFilter] BIT NOT NULL,
        [FilterDefinition] NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL,

        [RowCount] BIGINT NULL,
        [ReservedPageCount] BIGINT NULL,
        [UsedPageCount] BIGINT NULL,
        [PageCount] BIGINT NULL,
        [IndexSizeMB] DECIMAL(19,2) NULL,
        [AvgFragmentationInPercent] FLOAT NULL,

        [Reads] BIGINT NULL,
        [Writes] BIGINT NULL,
        [WriteReadRatio] FLOAT NULL,

        [LeafAllocationCount] BIGINT NULL,
        [LeafSplitCount] BIGINT NULL,
        [ChurnPerWrite] FLOAT NULL,

        [FillFactor] INT NOT NULL,
        [PadIndex] BIT NOT NULL,
        [AllowPageLocks] BIT NOT NULL,
        [AllowRowLocks] BIT NOT NULL,
        [DataCompressionDesc] NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,

        [StatsLastUpdated] DATETIME NULL,
        [StatsModificationCounter] BIGINT NULL,
        [StatsStale] BIT NOT NULL
    );

    CREATE INDEX [IX_IndexSnap_Target_Snapshot]
        ON Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexSnapshot
        (
            [TargetDatabaseName],
            [SnapshotId],
            [ObjectType],
            [SchemaName],
            [ObjectName],
            [IndexName]
        );

    CREATE INDEX [IX_IndexSnap_Target_CapturedAt]
        ON Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexSnapshot([TargetDatabaseName], [CapturedAt] DESC);
END
GO

/*==============================================================================
  4) SNAPSHOT DE ESTATSTICAS
     - cobre index stats, auto stats, user stats e stats de indexed view
==============================================================================*/
IF OBJECT_ID(N'Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_StatsSnapshot', N'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_StatsSnapshot
    (
        [StatsSnapshotId] BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [PK_StatsSnapshot] PRIMARY KEY,

        [SnapshotId] BIGINT NOT NULL,
        [CapturedAt] DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL,
        [TargetDatabaseName] SYSNAME NOT NULL,

        [ObjectType] CHAR(1) NOT NULL, -- U/V
        [SchemaName] SYSNAME NOT NULL,
        [ObjectName] SYSNAME NOT NULL,
        [ObjectId] INT NOT NULL,

        [StatsId] INT NOT NULL,
        [StatsName] SYSNAME NOT NULL,

        [IsAutoCreated] BIT NOT NULL,
        [IsUserCreated] BIT NOT NULL,
        [NoRecompute] BIT NOT NULL,
        [IsIncremental] BIT NOT NULL,
        [HasFilter] BIT NOT NULL,
        [FilterDefinition] NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL,

        [IsFromIndex] BIT NOT NULL,
        [RelatedIndexId] INT NULL,
        [RelatedIndexName] SYSNAME NULL,

        [RowCount] BIGINT NULL,
        [RowsSampled] BIGINT NULL,
        [Steps] INT NULL,
        [UnfilteredRows] BIGINT NULL,
        [ModificationCounter] BIGINT NULL,
        [LastUpdated] DATETIME NULL,

        [ObjectSizeMB] DECIMAL(19,2) NULL,
        [ModificationPct] FLOAT NULL,
        [StatsStale] BIT NOT NULL,

        [StatsType] NVARCHAR(30) NOT NULL -- INDEX / AUTO_COLUMN / USER_COLUMN / VIEW
    );

    CREATE INDEX [IX_StatsSnap_Target_Snapshot]
        ON Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_StatsSnapshot
        (
            [TargetDatabaseName],
            [SnapshotId],
            [SchemaName],
            [ObjectName],
            [StatsName]
        );

    CREATE INDEX [IX_StatsSnap_Target_CapturedAt]
        ON Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_StatsSnapshot([TargetDatabaseName], [CapturedAt] DESC);
END
GO

/*==============================================================================
  5) SNAPSHOT DE CONFIGURAO DO BANCO
==============================================================================*/
IF OBJECT_ID(N'Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_DbConfigSnapshot', N'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_DbConfigSnapshot
    (
        [DbConfigSnapshotId] BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [PK_DbConfigSnapshot] PRIMARY KEY,

        [SnapshotId] BIGINT NOT NULL,
        [CapturedAt] DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_DbCfgSnap_CapturedAt] DEFAULT(SYSUTCDATETIME()),

        [TargetDatabaseName] SYSNAME NOT NULL,

        [AutoCreateStatistics] BIT NOT NULL,
        [AutoUpdateStatistics] BIT NOT NULL,
        [AutoUpdateStatisticsAsync] BIT NOT NULL,
        [IsReadCommittedSnapshotOn] BIT NOT NULL,
        [SnapshotIsolationState] TINYINT NOT NULL,
        [SnapshotIsolationStateDesc] NVARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
        [ParameterizationDesc] NVARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
        [RecoveryModelDesc] NVARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
        [PageVerifyOptionDesc] NVARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
        [IsQueryStoreOn] BIT NOT NULL,
        [CompatibilityLevel] INT NOT NULL
    );

    CREATE INDEX [IX_DbConfigSnap_Target_Snapshot]
        ON Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_DbConfigSnapshot([TargetDatabaseName], [SnapshotId]);
END
GO

/*==============================================================================
  6) FILA DE PLANO DE NDICES
==============================================================================*/
IF OBJECT_ID(N'Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexPlanQueue', N'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexPlanQueue
    (
        [PlanId] BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [PK_IndexPlan] PRIMARY KEY,

        [PlanDate] DATE NOT NULL,
        [TargetDatabaseName] SYSNAME NOT NULL,
        [SnapshotId] BIGINT NOT NULL,

        [ObjectType] CHAR(1) NOT NULL,

/*==============================================================================
  1) EnsureConfig
     - garante defaults fixos por database
==============================================================================*/
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE Manutencao.PC_IndexAdvisor_EnsureConfig
(
    @TargetDatabase SYSNAME
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SET @TargetDatabase = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@TargetDatabase)), N'');

    IF @TargetDatabase IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR(N'@TargetDatabase est vazio.',16,1);
        RETURN;
    END;

    MERGE Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_Config AS tgt
    USING (SELECT @TargetDatabase AS [TargetDatabaseName]) AS src
       ON tgt.[TargetDatabaseName] = src.[TargetDatabaseName]
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
        INSERT ([TargetDatabaseName])
        VALUES (src.[TargetDatabaseName])
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
        UPDATE SET [UpdatedAt] = SYSUTCDATETIME();
END
GO

/*==============================================================================
  2) CollectDbConfig
==============================================================================*/
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE Manutencao.PC_IndexAdvisor_CollectDbConfig
(
      @TargetDatabase SYSNAME
    , @SnapshotId BIGINT = NULL
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SET @TargetDatabase = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@TargetDatabase)), N'');

    IF @TargetDatabase IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR(N'@TargetDatabase est vazio.',16,1);
        RETURN;
    END;

    IF @SnapshotId IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP (1) @SnapshotId = [SnapshotId]
        FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_EnvironmentSnapshot
        WHERE [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
        ORDER BY [SnapshotId] DESC;
    END;

    IF @SnapshotId IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR(N'Nenhum SnapshotId encontrado para %s.',16,1,@TargetDatabase);
        RETURN;
    END;

    DELETE Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_DbConfigSnapshot
    WHERE [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
      AND [SnapshotId] = @SnapshotId;

    INSERT Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_DbConfigSnapshot
    (
        [SnapshotId],
        [TargetDatabaseName],
        [AutoCreateStatistics],
        [AutoUpdateStatistics],
        [AutoUpdateStatisticsAsync],
        [IsReadCommittedSnapshotOn],
        [SnapshotIsolationState],
        [SnapshotIsolationStateDesc],
        [ParameterizationDesc],
        [RecoveryModelDesc],
        [PageVerifyOptionDesc],
        [IsQueryStoreOn],
        [CompatibilityLevel]
    )
    SELECT
        @SnapshotId,
        [d].[name],
        [d].[is_auto_create_stats_on],
        [d].[is_auto_update_stats_on],
        [d].[is_auto_update_stats_async_on],
        [d].[is_read_committed_snapshot_on],
        [d].[snapshot_isolation_state],
        [d].[snapshot_isolation_state_desc],
        CASE WHEN [d].[is_parameterization_forced] = 1 THEN N'FORCED' ELSE N'SIMPLE' END,
        [d].[recovery_model_desc],
        [d].[page_verify_option_desc],
        CASE WHEN [d].[is_query_store_on] = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
        [d].[compatibility_level]
    FROM [sys].[databases] AS [d]
    WHERE [d].[name] = @TargetDatabase;
END
GO

/*==============================================================================
  3) CollectSnapshot
     - coleta ambiente + snapshot de ndices
     - @IsBusinessHours = 1 => coleta leve (sem fsica pesada)
     - @UsePhysicalStatsMode:
         LIMITED / SAMPLED / DETAILED
       padro final do produto: LIMITED
==============================================================================*/
USE [DBA_MetaManutencao];
GO

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE Manutencao.PC_IndexAdvisor_CollectSnapshot
(
      @TargetDatabase SYSNAME
    , @ManutencaoDatabase SYSNAME = NULL
    , @UsePhysicalStatsMode NVARCHAR(10) = N'LIMITED'
    , @IsBusinessHours BIT = 0
    , @CollectOperationalStats BIT = 0
    , @Debug BIT = 0
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SET @ManutencaoDatabase = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@ManutencaoDatabase)), N'');
    IF @ManutencaoDatabase IS NULL
        SET @ManutencaoDatabase = DB_NAME();

    SET @TargetDatabase = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@TargetDatabase)), N'');

    IF @TargetDatabase IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR(N'@TargetDatabase est vazio.',16,1);
        RETURN;
    END;

    IF DB_ID(@TargetDatabase) IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR(N'Database alvo no existe: %s',16,1,@TargetDatabase);
        RETURN;
    END;

    EXEC Manutencao.PC_IndexAdvisor_EnsureConfig
         @TargetDatabase = @TargetDatabase;

    DECLARE @PhysMode NVARCHAR(10);

    IF @IsBusinessHours = 1
        SET @PhysMode = N'NONE';
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SET @PhysMode = UPPER(ISNULL(NULLIF(@UsePhysicalStatsMode,N''),N'LIMITED'));
        IF @PhysMode NOT IN (N'LIMITED',N'SAMPLED',N'DETAILED')
            SET @PhysMode = N'LIMITED';
    END;

    DECLARE
        @TargetDbId INT = DB_ID(@TargetDatabase),
        @Compat INT,
        @CpuCount INT,
        @HyperthreadRatio INT,
        @PhysicalMemoryMB BIGINT,
        @AvailableMemoryMB BIGINT,
        @SqlServerStartTime DATETIME,
        @Edition NVARCHAR(200),
        @ProductVersion NVARCHAR(50),
        @EngineEdition INT;

    SELECT @Compat = [compatibility_level]
    FROM sys.databases
    WHERE [name] = @TargetDatabase;

    SELECT
        @CpuCount = [cpu_count],
        @HyperthreadRatio = [hyperthread_ratio],
        @SqlServerStartTime = [sqlserver_start_time]
    FROM sys.dm_os_sys_info;

    SELECT
        @PhysicalMemoryMB = [total_physical_memory_kb] / 1024,
        @AvailableMemoryMB = [available_physical_memory_kb] / 1024
    FROM sys.dm_os_sys_memory;

    SELECT
        @Edition = CAST(SERVERPROPERTY('Edition') AS NVARCHAR(200)),
        @ProductVersion = CAST(SERVERPROPERTY('ProductVersion') AS NVARCHAR(50)),
        @EngineEdition = CAST(SERVERPROPERTY('EngineEdition') AS INT);

    ;WITH tempdb_files AS
    (
        SELECT
            [size_mb] = CAST([df].[size] * 8.0 / 1024.0 AS DECIMAL(19,2)),
            [df].[is_percent_growth]
        FROM [tempdb].[sys].[database_files] AS [df]
        WHERE [df].[type_desc] = 'ROWS'
    ),
    agg AS
    (
        SELECT
            [TempdbDataFiles] = COUNT(*),
            [TempdbTotalMB] = SUM([size_mb]),
            [TempdbMinMB] = MIN([size_mb]),
            [TempdbMaxMB] = MAX([size_mb]),
            [TempdbPercentGrowthFiles] = SUM(CASE WHEN [is_percent_growth]=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
            [TempdbImbalancePct] =
                CASE
                    WHEN MIN([size_mb]) = 0 THEN NULL
                    ELSE CAST(100.0 * (MAX([size_mb]) - MIN([size_mb])) / NULLIF(MIN([size_mb]),0) AS DECIMAL(19,2))
                END
        FROM tempdb_files
    ),
    space AS
    (
        SELECT
            [TempdbFreeMB] = CAST(SUM([unallocated_extent_page_count]) * 8.0 / 1024.0 AS DECIMAL(19,2)),
            [TempdbUserObjMB] = CAST(SUM([user_object_reserved_page_count]) * 8.0 / 1024.0 AS DECIMAL(19,2)),
            [TempdbInternalObjMB] = CAST(SUM([internal_object_reserved_page_count]) * 8.0 / 1024.0 AS DECIMAL(19,2)),
            [TempdbVersionStoreMB] = CAST(SUM([version_store_reserved_page_count]) * 8.0 / 1024.0 AS DECIMAL(19,2))
        FROM [tempdb].[sys].[dm_db_file_space_usage]
    ),
    vfs_temp AS
    (
        SELECT
            [TempdbWriteLatencyMs] =
                CASE WHEN SUM([v].[num_of_writes]) = 0 THEN NULL
                     ELSE CAST(1.0 * SUM([v].[io_stall_write_ms]) / SUM([v].[num_of_writes]) AS DECIMAL(19,4)) END,
            [TempdbReadLatencyMs] =
                CASE WHEN SUM([v].[num_of_reads]) = 0 THEN NULL
                     ELSE CAST(1.0 * SUM([v].[io_stall_read_ms]) / SUM([v].[num_of_reads]) AS DECIMAL(19,4)) END
        FROM sys.dm_io_virtual_file_stats(DB_ID('tempdb'), NULL) AS [v]
    ),
    vfs_db AS
    (
        SELECT
            [DbWriteLatencyMs] =
                CASE WHEN SUM([v].[num_of_writes]) = 0 THEN NULL
                     ELSE CAST(1.0 * SUM([v].[io_stall_write_ms]) / SUM([v].[num_of_writes]) AS DECIMAL(19,4)) END,
            [DbReadLatencyMs] =
                CASE WHEN SUM([v].[num_of_reads]) = 0 THEN NULL
                     ELSE CAST(1.0 * SUM([v].[io_stall_read_ms]) / SUM([v].[num_of_reads]) AS DECIMAL(19,4)) END
        FROM sys.dm_io_virtual_file_stats(@TargetDbId, NULL) AS [v]
    ),
    latch AS
    (
        SELECT
            [TempdbPagelatchWaitingTasks] =
                SUM(CASE WHEN [wt].[wait_type] LIKE 'PAGELATCH%' AND [wt].[resource_description] LIKE '2:%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        FROM sys.dm_os_waiting_tasks AS [wt]
    )
    INSERT Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_EnvironmentSnapshot
    (
        [CapturedAt],[ServerName],[InstanceName],
        [TargetDatabaseId],[TargetDatabaseName],[DbCompatibility],
        [CpuCount],[HyperthreadRatio],[PhysicalMemoryMB],[AvailableMemoryMB],[SqlServerStartTime],
        [Edition],[ProductVersion],[EngineEdition],
        [TempdbDataFiles],[TempdbTotalMB],[TempdbMinMB],[TempdbMaxMB],[TempdbImbalancePct],[TempdbPercentGrowthFiles],
        [TempdbFreeMB],[TempdbUserObjMB],[TempdbInternalObjMB],[TempdbVersionStoreMB],
        [TempdbWriteLatencyMs],[TempdbReadLatencyMs],[DbWriteLatencyMs],[DbReadLatencyMs],
        [TempdbPagelatchWaitingTasks],
        [PhysicalStatsModeUsed],[IsBusinessHours]
    )
    SELECT
        SYSUTCDATETIME(),
        CAST(SERVERPROPERTY('MachineName') AS SYSNAME),
        CAST(SERVERPROPERTY('ServerName') AS SYSNAME),
        @TargetDbId,@TargetDatabase,@Compat,
        @CpuCount,@HyperthreadRatio,@PhysicalMemoryMB,@AvailableMemoryMB,@SqlServerStartTime,
        @Edition,@ProductVersion,@EngineEdition,
        [a].[TempdbDataFiles],[a].[TempdbTotalMB],[a].[TempdbMinMB],[a].[TempdbMaxMB],[a].[TempdbImbalancePct],[a].[TempdbPercentGrowthFiles],
        [s].[TempdbFreeMB],[s].[TempdbUserObjMB],[s].[TempdbInternalObjMB],[s].[TempdbVersionStoreMB],
        [t].[TempdbWriteLatencyMs],[t].[TempdbReadLatencyMs],[d].[DbWriteLatencyMs],[d].[DbReadLatencyMs],
        [l].[TempdbPagelatchWaitingTasks],
        @PhysMode,@IsBusinessHours
    FROM agg AS [a]
    CROSS JOIN space AS [s]
    CROSS JOIN vfs_temp AS [t]
    CROSS JOIN vfs_db AS [d]
    CROSS JOIN latch AS [l];

    DECLARE
        @SnapshotId BIGINT = SCOPE_IDENTITY(),
        @CapturedAt DATETIME2(0),
        @SplitCol SYSNAME = NULL,
        @sql NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @params NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @qMaintDb NVARCHAR(260);

    SELECT @CapturedAt = [CapturedAt]
    FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_EnvironmentSnapshot
    WHERE [SnapshotId] = @SnapshotId;

    SET @qMaintDb = QUOTENAME(@ManutencaoDatabase);

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM sys.all_columns
        WHERE [object_id] = OBJECT_ID('sys.dm_db_index_operational_stats')
          AND [name] = 'leaf_insert_split_count'
    )
        SET @SplitCol = N'leaf_insert_split_count';
    ELSE IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM sys.all_columns
        WHERE [object_id] = OBJECT_ID('sys.dm_db_index_operational_stats')
          AND [name] = 'leaf_page_split_count'
    )
        SET @SplitCol = N'leaf_page_split_count';

    SET @params = N'
        @p_SnapshotId BIGINT,
        @p_CapturedAt DATETIME2(0),
        @p_TargetDb SYSNAME,
        @p_PhysMode NVARCHAR(10)';

    SET @sql =
        CAST(N'' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) +
        N'USE ' + QUOTENAME(@TargetDatabase) + N';
SET NOCOUNT ON;

IF OBJECT_ID(''tempdb..#base'') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #base;
IF OBJECT_ID(''tempdb..#phys'') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #phys;
IF OBJECT_ID(''tempdb..#usage'') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #usage;
IF OBJECT_ID(''tempdb..#ops'') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ops;
IF OBJECT_ID(''tempdb..#stats_props'') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #stats_props;

SELECT
    [ObjectType] = [o].[type],
    [SchemaName] = [sch].[name],
    [ObjectName] = [o].[name],
    [ObjectId] = [o].[object_id],
    [IndexId] = [i].[index_id],
    [IndexName] = [i].[name],
    [IndexTypeDesc] = [i].[type_desc],
    [PartitionNumber] = [p].[partition_number],
    [IsDisabled] = [i].[is_disabled],
    [IsHypothetical] = [i].[is_hypothetical],
    [IsUnique] = [i].[is_unique],
    [IsPrimaryKey] = [i].[is_primary_key],
    [HasFilter] = [i].[has_filter],
    [FilterDefinition] = [i].[filter_definition],
    [FillFactor] = ISNULL(NULLIF([i].[fill_factor],0),100),
    [PadIndex] = [i].[is_padded],
    [AllowPageLocks] = [i].[allow_page_locks],
    [AllowRowLocks] = [i].[allow_row_locks],
    [DataCompressionDesc] =
        CASE
            WHEN MIN([p].[data_compression]) = MAX([p].[data_compression]) THEN MAX([p].[data_compression_desc])
            ELSE N''MIXED''
        END,
    [RowCount] = SUM(CONVERT(BIGINT,[ps].[row_count])),
    [ReservedPageCount] = SUM(CONVERT(BIGINT,[ps].[reserved_page_count])),
    [UsedPageCount] = SUM(CONVERT(BIGINT,[ps].[used_page_count]))
INTO #base
FROM [sys].[objects] AS [o]
JOIN [sys].[schemas] AS [sch]
  ON [sch].[schema_id] = [o].[schema_id]
JOIN [sys].[indexes] AS [i]
  ON [i].[object_id] = [o].[object_id]
JOIN [sys].[partitions] AS [p]
  ON [p].[object_id] = [i].[object_id]
 AND [p].[index_id] = [i].[index_id]
JOIN [sys].[dm_db_partition_stats] AS [ps]
  ON [ps].[object_id] = [p].[object_id]
 AND [ps].[index_id] = [p].[index_id]
 AND [ps].[partition_number] = [p].[partition_number]
WHERE [o].[type] IN (''U'',''V'')
  AND [i].[index_id] > 0
  AND [i].[name] IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    [o].[type],[sch].[name],[o].[name],[o].[object_id],
    [i].[index_id],[i].[name],[i].[type_desc],[p].[partition_number],
    [i].[is_disabled],[i].[is_hypothetical],[i].[is_unique],[i].[is_primary_key],
    [i].[has_filter],[i].[filter_definition],
    [i].[fill_factor],[i].[is_padded],[i].[allow_page_locks],[i].[allow_row_locks];

CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_base ON #base([ObjectId],[IndexId],[PartitionNumber]);

' +
CASE
    WHEN @IsBusinessHours = 1 THEN
        N'
SELECT
    [ObjectId],
    [IndexId],
    [PartitionNumber],
    [PageCount] = CAST(NULL AS BIGINT),
    [AvgFragmentationInPercent] = CAST(NULL AS FLOAT)
INTO #phys
FROM #base;'
    ELSE
        N'
SELECT
    [ips].[object_id] AS [ObjectId],
    [ips].[index_id] AS [IndexId],
    [ips].[partition_number] AS [PartitionNumber],
    [PageCount] = SUM([ips].[page_count]),
    [AvgFragmentationInPercent] = AVG([ips].[avg_fragmentation_in_percent])
INTO #phys
FROM [sys].[dm_db_index_physical_stats](DB_ID(), NULL, NULL, NULL, @p_PhysMode) AS [ips]
WHERE [ips].[index_id] > 0
GROUP BY [ips].[object_id],[ips].[index_id],[ips].[partition_number];'
END + N'

CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_phys ON #phys([ObjectId],[IndexId],[PartitionNumber]);

SELECT
    [us].[object_id] AS [ObjectId],
    [us].[index_id] AS [IndexId],
    [Reads] = CONVERT(BIGINT, ISNULL([us].[user_seeks],0) + ISNULL([us].[user_scans],0) + ISNULL([us].[user_lookups],0)),
    [Writes] = CONVERT(BIGINT, ISNULL([us].[user_updates],0))
INTO #usage
FROM [sys].[dm_db_index_usage_stats] AS [us]
WHERE [us].[database_id] = DB_ID();

CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_usage ON #usage([ObjectId],[IndexId]);

' +
CASE
    WHEN @IsBusinessHours = 1 OR @CollectOperationalStats = 0 THEN
        N'
SELECT
    [ObjectId],
    [IndexId],
    [PartitionNumber],
    [LeafAllocationCount] = CAST(NULL AS BIGINT),
    [LeafSplitCount] = CAST(NULL AS BIGINT)
INTO #ops
FROM #base;'
    ELSE
        N'
SELECT
    [o].[object_id] AS [ObjectId],
    [o].[index_id] AS [IndexId],
    [o].[partition_number] AS [PartitionNumber],
    [LeafAllocationCount] = SUM(CONVERT(BIGINT,[o].[leaf_allocation_count])),
    [LeafSplitCount] = ' +
        CASE
            WHEN @SplitCol IS NULL THEN N'CAST(NULL AS BIGINT)'
            ELSE N'SUM(CONVERT(BIGINT,[o].' + QUOTENAME(@SplitCol) + N'))'
        END + N'
INTO #ops
FROM [sys].[dm_db_index_operational_stats](DB_ID(), NULL, NULL, NULL) AS [o]
WHERE [o].[index_id] > 0
GROUP BY [o].[object_id],[o].[index_id],[o].[partition_number];'
END + N'

CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_ops ON #ops([ObjectId],[IndexId],[PartitionNumber]);

SELECT
    [st].[object_id],
    [st].[name] AS [stats_name],
    [sp].[last_updated],
    [sp].[modification_counter]
INTO #stats_props
FROM [sys].[stats] AS [st]
OUTER APPLY [sys].[dm_db_stats_properties]([st].[object_id], [st].[stats_id]) AS [sp];

CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_stats_props ON #stats_props([object_id],[stats_name]);

INSERT ' + @qMaintDb + N'.[Manutencao].[IndexAdvisor_IndexSnapshot]
(
    [SnapshotId],[CapturedAt],[TargetDatabaseName],
    [ObjectType],[SchemaName],[ObjectName],[ObjectId],
    [IndexId],[IndexName],[IndexTypeDesc],[PartitionNumber],
    [IsDisabled],[IsHypothetical],[IsUnique],[IsPrimaryKey],[HasFilter],[FilterDefinition],
    [RowCount],[ReservedPageCount],[UsedPageCount],[PageCount],[IndexSizeMB],[AvgFragmentationInPercent],
    [Reads],[Writes],[WriteReadRatio],
    [LeafAllocationCount],[LeafSplitCount],[ChurnPerWrite],
    [FillFactor],[PadIndex],[AllowPageLocks],[AllowRowLocks],[DataCompressionDesc],
    [StatsLastUpdated],[StatsModificationCounter],[StatsStale]
)
SELECT
    @p_SnapshotId,
    @p_CapturedAt,
    @p_TargetDb,
    [b].[ObjectType],[b].[SchemaName],[b].[ObjectName],[b].[ObjectId],
    [b].[IndexId],[b].[IndexName],[b].[IndexTypeDesc],[b].[PartitionNumber],
    [b].[IsDisabled],[b].[IsHypothetical],[b].[IsUnique],[b].[IsPrimaryKey],[b].[HasFilter],[b].[FilterDefinition],
    [b].[RowCount],[b].[ReservedPageCount],[b].[UsedPageCount],
    [p].[PageCount],
    CAST(ISNULL([p].[PageCount],[b].[UsedPageCount]) * 8.0 / 1024.0 AS DECIMAL(19,2)),
    [p].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],
    ISNULL([u].[Reads],0),
    ISNULL([u].[Writes],0),
    CASE
        WHEN ISNULL([u].[Reads],0) = 0 AND ISNULL([u].[Writes],0) > 0 THEN 999.0
        WHEN ISNULL([u].[Reads],0) = 0 THEN 0.0
        ELSE 1.0 * ISNULL([u].[Writes],0) / NULLIF([u].[Reads],0)
    END,
    [os].[LeafAllocationCount],
    [os].[LeafSplitCount],
    CASE
        WHEN ISNULL([u].[Writes],0) = 0 THEN 0.0
        WHEN [os].[LeafSplitCount] IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0 * [os].[LeafSplitCount] / NULLIF([u].[Writes],0)
        WHEN [os].[LeafAllocationCount] IS NULL THEN 0.0
        ELSE 1.0 * [os].[LeafAllocationCount] / NULLIF([u].[Writes],0)
    END,
    [b].[FillFactor],[b].[PadIndex],[b].[AllowPageLocks],[b].[AllowRowLocks],[b].[DataCompressionDesc],
    [sp].[last_updated],
    [sp].[modification_counter],
    CASE
        WHEN [b].[RowCount] IS NULL OR [b].[RowCount] = 0 THEN 0
        WHEN [sp].[modification_counter] IS NULL THEN 0
        WHEN 1.0 * [sp].[modification_counter] > (1.0 * [b].[RowCount] * 0.10) THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END
FROM #base AS [b]
LEFT JOIN #phys AS [p]
  ON [p].[ObjectId] = [b].[ObjectId]
 AND [p].[IndexId] = [b].[IndexId]
 AND [p].[PartitionNumber] = [b].[PartitionNumber]
LEFT JOIN #usage AS [u]
  ON [u].[ObjectId] = [b].[ObjectId]
 AND [u].[IndexId] = [b].[IndexId]
LEFT JOIN #ops AS [os]
  ON [os].[ObjectId] = [b].[ObjectId]
 AND [os].[IndexId] = [b].[IndexId]
 AND [os].[PartitionNumber] = [b].[PartitionNumber]
LEFT JOIN #stats_props AS [sp]
  ON [sp].[object_id] = [b].[ObjectId]
 AND [sp].[stats_name] = [b].[IndexName]
WHERE [b].[IsDisabled] = 0
  AND [b].[IsHypothetical] = 0;';

    IF @Debug = 1
    BEGIN
        SELECT [SnapshotId] = @SnapshotId;
        SELECT [SqlPreview_Part1] = SUBSTRING(@sql, 1, 4000);
        SELECT [SqlPreview_Part2] = SUBSTRING(@sql, 4001, 4000);
        SELECT [SqlPreview_Part3] = SUBSTRING(@sql, 8001, 4000);
        SELECT [SqlPreview_Part4] = SUBSTRING(@sql, 12001, 4000);
        RETURN;
    END;

    EXEC sys.sp_executesql
        @sql,
        @params,
        @p_SnapshotId = @SnapshotId,
        @p_CapturedAt = @CapturedAt,
        @p_TargetDb = @TargetDatabase,
        @p_PhysMode = @PhysMode;
END
GO

/*==============================================================================
  4) CollectStatsSnapshot
     - coleta todas as estatsticas do banco:
       INDEX / AUTO_COLUMN / USER_COLUMN / VIEW
     - sem depender do suporte configurar nada
==============================================================================*/
USE [DBA_MetaManutencao];
GO

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE Manutencao.PC_IndexAdvisor_CollectStatsSnapshot
(
      @TargetDatabase SYSNAME
    , @ManutencaoDatabase SYSNAME = NULL
    , @SnapshotId BIGINT = NULL
    , @Debug BIT = 0
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SET @ManutencaoDatabase = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@ManutencaoDatabase)), N'');
    IF @ManutencaoDatabase IS NULL
        SET @ManutencaoDatabase = DB_NAME();

    SET @TargetDatabase = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@TargetDatabase)), N'');

    IF @TargetDatabase IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR(N'@TargetDatabase est vazio.',16,1);
        RETURN;
    END;

    IF DB_ID(@TargetDatabase) IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR(N'Database alvo no existe: %s',16,1,@TargetDatabase);
        RETURN;
    END;

    IF @SnapshotId IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP (1) @SnapshotId = [SnapshotId]
        FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_EnvironmentSnapshot
        WHERE [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
        ORDER BY [SnapshotId] DESC;
    END;

    IF @SnapshotId IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR(N'Nenhum SnapshotId encontrado para %s.',16,1,@TargetDatabase);
        RETURN;
    END;

    DECLARE
        @sql NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @params NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @qMaintDb NVARCHAR(260);

    SET @qMaintDb = QUOTENAME(@ManutencaoDatabase);

    SET @params = N'
        @p_SnapshotId BIGINT,
        @p_TargetDb SYSNAME';

    SET @sql =
        CAST(N'' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) +
        N'USE ' + QUOTENAME(@TargetDatabase) + N';
SET NOCOUNT ON;

;WITH obj_size AS
(
    SELECT
        [p].[object_id],
        [ObjectSizeMB] = CAST(SUM(CONVERT(BIGINT,[ps].[used_page_count])) * 8.0 / 1024.0 AS DECIMAL(19,2)),
        [RowCount] = SUM(CONVERT(BIGINT,[ps].[row_count]))
    FROM [sys].[partitions] AS [p]
    JOIN [sys].[dm_db_partition_stats] AS [ps]
      ON [ps].[object_id] = [p].[object_id]
     AND [ps].[index_id] = [p].[index_id]
     AND [ps].[partition_number] = [p].[partition_number]
    GROUP BY [p].[object_id]
),
stats_base AS
(
    SELECT
        [ObjectType] = [o].[type],
        [SchemaName] = [sch].[name],
        [ObjectName] = [o].[name],
        [ObjectId] = [st].[object_id],
        [StatsId] = [st].[stats_id],
        [StatsName] = [st].[name],
        [IsAutoCreated] = [st].[auto_created],
        [IsUserCreated] = [st].[user_created],
        [NoRecompute] = [st].[no_recompute],
        [IsIncremental] = [st].[is_incremental],
        [HasFilter] = [st].[has_filter],
        [FilterDefinition] = [st].[filter_definition],
        [IsFromIndex] = CASE WHEN [ix].[index_id] IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
        [RelatedIndexId] = [ix].[index_id],
        [RelatedIndexName] = [ix].[name],
        [RowsSampled] = [sp].[rows_sampled],
        [Steps] = [sp].[steps],
        [UnfilteredRows] = [sp].[unfiltered_rows],
        [ModificationCounter] = [sp].[modification_counter],
        [LastUpdated] = [sp].[last_updated],
        [ObjectSizeMB] = [os].[ObjectSizeMB],
        [RowCount] = ISNULL(CONVERT(BIGINT,[sp].[rows]), [os].[RowCount]),
        [StatsType] =
            CASE
                WHEN [o].[type] = ''V'' THEN N''VIEW''
                WHEN [ix].[index_id] IS NOT NULL THEN N''INDEX''
                WHEN [st].[auto_created] = 1 THEN N''AUTO_COLUMN''
                ELSE N''USER_COLUMN''
            END
    FROM [sys].[stats] AS [st]
    JOIN [sys].[objects] AS [o]
      ON [o].[object_id] = [st].[object_id]
    JOIN [sys].[schemas] AS [sch]
      ON [sch].[schema_id] = [o].[schema_id]
    LEFT JOIN [sys].[indexes] AS [ix]
      ON [ix].[object_id] = [st].[object_id]
     AND [ix].[name] = [st].[name]
    OUTER APPLY [sys].[dm_db_stats_properties]([st].[object_id], [st].[stats_id]) AS [sp]
    LEFT JOIN [obj_size] AS [os]
      ON [os].[object_id] = [st].[object_id]
    WHERE [o].[type] IN (''U'',''V'')
),
calc AS
(
    SELECT
        [sb].*,
        [ModificationPct] =
            CASE
                WHEN ISNULL([sb].[RowCount],0) = 0 THEN 0.0
                WHEN [sb].[ModificationCounter] IS NULL THEN 0.0
                ELSE 1.0 * [sb].[ModificationCounter] / NULLIF([sb].[RowCount],0)
            END,
        [StatsStale] =
            CASE
                WHEN [sb].[ModificationCounter] IS NULL THEN 0
                WHEN [sb].[ModificationCounter] < 10000 THEN 0
                WHEN ISNULL([sb].[RowCount],0) <= 500000
                     AND (1.0 * [sb].[ModificationCounter] / NULLIF([sb].[RowCount],0)) >= 0.10 THEN 1
                WHEN ISNULL([sb].[RowCount],0) <= 5000000
                     AND (1.0 * [sb].[ModificationCounter] / NULLIF([sb].[RowCount],0)) >= 0.10 THEN 1
                WHEN ISNULL([sb].[RowCount],0) <= 50000000
                     AND (1.0 * [sb].[ModificationCounter] / NULLIF([sb].[RowCount],0)) >= 0.05 THEN 1
                WHEN ISNULL([sb].[RowCount],0) > 50000000
                     AND (1.0 * [sb].[ModificationCounter] / NULLIF([sb].[RowCount],0)) >= 0.03 THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
    FROM [stats_base] AS [sb]
)
INSERT ' + @qMaintDb + N'.[Manutencao].[IndexAdvisor_StatsSnapshot]
(
    [SnapshotId],[CapturedAt],[TargetDatabaseName],
    [ObjectType],[SchemaName],[ObjectName],[ObjectId],
    [StatsId],[StatsName],
    [IsAutoCreated],[IsUserCreated],[NoRecompute],[IsIncremental],[HasFilter],[FilterDefinition],
    [IsFromIndex],[RelatedIndexId],[RelatedIndexName],
    [RowCount],[RowsSampled],[Steps],[UnfilteredRows],[ModificationCounter],[LastUpdated],
    [ObjectSizeMB],[ModificationPct],[StatsStale],[StatsType]
)
SELECT
    @p_SnapshotId,
    SYSUTCDATETIME(),
    @p_TargetDb,
    [c].[ObjectType],[c].[SchemaName],[c].[ObjectName],[c].[ObjectId],
    [c].[StatsId],[c].[StatsName],
    [c].[IsAutoCreated],[c].[IsUserCreated],[c].[NoRecompute],[c].[IsIncremental],[c].[HasFilter],[c].[FilterDefinition],
    [c].[IsFromIndex],[c].[RelatedIndexId],[c].[RelatedIndexName],
    [c].[RowCount],[c].[RowsSampled],[c].[Steps],[c].[UnfilteredRows],[c].[ModificationCounter],[c].[LastUpdated],
    [c].[ObjectSizeMB],[c].[ModificationPct],[c].[StatsStale],[c].[StatsType]
FROM [calc] AS [c];';

    IF @Debug = 1
    BEGIN
        SELECT [SnapshotId] = @SnapshotId;
        SELECT [SqlPreview_Part1] = SUBSTRING(@sql, 1, 4000);
        SELECT [SqlPreview_Part2] = SUBSTRING(@sql, 4001, 4000);
        SELECT [SqlPreview_Part3] = SUBSTRING(@sql, 8001, 4000);
        SELECT [SqlPreview_Part4] = SUBSTRING(@sql, 12001, 4000);
        RETURN;
    END;

    EXEC sys.sp_executesql
        @sql,
        @params,
        @p_SnapshotId = @SnapshotId,
        @p_TargetDb = @TargetDatabase;
END
GO

/*==============================================================================
  INDEX ADVISOR  - BLOCO 3
  GERAO DOS PLANOS
==============================================================================*/

/*
    Procedure: Manutencao.PC_IndexAdvisor_GenerateIndexPlan

    Objetivo geral
    --------------
    Gerar recomendações automáticas de manutenção de índices com foco em ambientes OLTP,
    equilibrando:
      - fragmentação atual do snapshot;
      - recorrência histórica de fragmentação;
      - pressão adaptativa (padrão repetitivo ao longo dos snapshots);
      - cenários sensíveis a deadlock / write-heavy;
      - histerese, para evitar "flip-flop" diário de FF / PAD / compressão.

    Filosofia da decisão
    --------------------
    1) Casos pesados e realmente degradados continuam indo para REBUILD.
    2) Casos small/medium com frag intermediária tendem para REORGANIZE, quando a pressão atual não justificar rebuild.
    3) Mudança estrutural (FF / PAD / compressão) é postergada quando:
         - a fragmentação atual está muito baixa;
         - o impulso da recomendação vem mais do histórico do que do snapshot atual;
         - ou existe risco de oscilação diária (histerese).
    4) Indexed views recebem tratamento próprio, porque muitas vezes o custo de alteração estrutural
       em ambiente OLTP é maior do que o ganho marginal quando a frag atual está baixa.
*/
USE [DBA_MetaManutencao];
GO

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE Manutencao.PC_IndexAdvisor_GenerateIndexPlan
(
      @TargetDatabase SYSNAME
    , @ManutencaoDatabase SYSNAME = NULL
    , @PlanDate DATE = NULL
    , @SnapshotId BIGINT = NULL
    , @QueuePlan BIT = 1
    , @Debug BIT = 0
    , @IndexedViewStructuralOptimization BIT = 1
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Refinamento piloto - compressão/fillfactor estrutural
       - PAGE -> ROW obrigatório quando houver risco real de escrita/bloqueio.
       - Híbridos grandes continuam protegidos contra falsos positivos.
       - AdaptivePressureScore para pressão estrutural foi elevado de 40 para 50.
       - PAGE->ROW entre 256MB e 512MB exige pressão real (Deadlock/Split; sem Adaptive isolado).
       - Índices pequenos (<32MB ou <1000 páginas) ignoram histórico adaptativo para evitar manutenção sem ganho.
       - Índices entre 256 MB e 512 MB exigem >= 200k writes para troca obrigatória.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Normalização dos parâmetros de entrada
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    SET @ManutencaoDatabase = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@ManutencaoDatabase)), N'');
    IF @ManutencaoDatabase IS NULL
        SET @ManutencaoDatabase = DB_NAME();

    SET @TargetDatabase = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@TargetDatabase)), N'');
    IF @TargetDatabase IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR(N'@TargetDatabase está vazio.', 16, 1);
        RETURN;
    END;

    IF DB_ID(@TargetDatabase) IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR(N'Database alvo não existe: %s', 16, 1, @TargetDatabase);
        RETURN;
    END;

    IF @PlanDate IS NULL
        SET @PlanDate = CONVERT(date, GETDATE());

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Quando o SnapshotId não é informado, usa o último snapshot válido
       que possua dados reais em IndexSnapshot.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    IF @SnapshotId IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP (1)
            @SnapshotId = [E].[SnapshotId]
        FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_EnvironmentSnapshot AS [E]
        WHERE [E].[TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
          AND EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexSnapshot AS [I]
              WHERE [I].[TargetDatabaseName] = [E].[TargetDatabaseName]
                AND [I].[SnapshotId] = [E].[SnapshotId]
          )
        ORDER BY [E].[SnapshotId] DESC;
    END;

    IF @SnapshotId IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR(N'Nenhum IndexSnapshot válido encontrado para %s.', 16, 1, @TargetDatabase);
        RETURN;
    END;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexSnapshot AS [I]
        WHERE [I].[TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
          AND [I].[SnapshotId] = @SnapshotId
    )
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR(N'Nenhum IndexSnapshot encontrado para %s no SnapshotId=%I64d.', 16, 1, @TargetDatabase, @SnapshotId);
        RETURN;
    END;

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Thresholds / parâmetros da heurística
       -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Observação:
       - Os thresholds foram separados por blocos conceituais.
       - Cada grupo controla uma decisão diferente da proc.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    DECLARE
          /* Thresholds base de manutenção física */
          @LowFragThreshold FLOAT = 5.0
        , @ReorgThreshold FLOAT = 10.0
        , @RebuildThreshold FLOAT = 30.0
        , @MinPageCount BIGINT = 128

          /* Heurística de write-heavy / split */
        , @WriteHeavyRatio FLOAT = 2.0
        , @MinWritesForWriteHeavy BIGINT = 50000
        , @SplitRateHigh FLOAT = 0.02
        , @SplitRateMed FLOAT = 0.005

          /* Heurística de compressão e sort_in_tempdb */
        , @PreferPageCompressionMinMB INT = 512
        , @SortMinIndexSizeMB INT = 512
        , @TempdbFreeMultiplier FLOAT = 1.5
        , @TempdbLatencyFactor FLOAT = 1.2
        , @MaxTempdbFilesRecommended INT = 8
        , @TempdbImbalancePct FLOAT = 10.0

          /* Casos de altíssima escrita absoluta */
        , @AbsoluteWriteHeavyMinWrites BIGINT = 10000000
        , @AbsoluteWriteHeavyLargeIndexMB INT = 1024

          /* Proxy de pressão estrutural recorrente */
        , @ProxySplitFragThreshold FLOAT = 8.0
        , @ProxySplitFragHistoryThreshold FLOAT = 6.0
        , @ProxyRecurringFragHits INT = 3

          /* Pontuação de risco para deadlock / updates pesados */
        , @DeadlockPressureMinMB INT = 1024
        , @DeadlockPressureMinWrites BIGINT = 5000000

          /* Casos extremos de recorrência */
        , @ExtremeFragThreshold FLOAT = 50.0
        , @VeryHighFragHistoryThreshold FLOAT = 25.0
        , @SmallIndexRaiseMaxFragHistory FLOAT = 3.0
        , @SmallIndexRaiseMaxCurrentFrag FLOAT = 3.0

          /* Small/medium conservador */
        , @ConservativeMediumFragCurrent FLOAT = 15.0
        , @ConservativeMediumFragHistory FLOAT = 8.0
        , @ConservativeMediumHighHits INT = 4

          /* Guarda anti-100:
             evita voltar FF=100 em objetos com histórico claramente ruim */
        , @GlobalNo100VeryHighFragHits INT = 2
        , @GlobalNo100AvgFragHistory FLOAT = 10.0
        , @GlobalNo100CurrentFrag FLOAT = 30.0

          /* Guardas de compressão em cenários recorrentes */
        , @KeepRowOnRecurringAvgFrag FLOAT = 8.0
        , @KeepRowOnRecurringHighHits INT = 4
        , @KeepRowOnRecurringPressure INT = 50
        , @KeepRowOnDeadlockPressure INT = 45
        , @PageBlockPressure INT = 60
        , @PageBlockCurrentFrag FLOAT = 20.0
        , @PageBlockAvgFragHistory FLOAT = 10.0

          /* Tabelas efêmeras / transitórias:
             alta escrita, ciclo curto, depois apaga/processa */
        , @EphemeralMinWrites BIGINT = 200000
        , @EphemeralMaxRowCount BIGINT = 500000
        , @EphemeralMaxIndexSizeMB DECIMAL(19,2) = 64.0
        , @EphemeralHighPressureScore INT = 50
        , @EphemeralRecurringHits INT = 5

          /* Guarda anti-ruído para índices pequenos:
             abaixo desses limites, histórico adaptativo/fragmentação histórica não deve
             forçar REBUILD, pois a fragmentação é instável e o ganho prático é baixo. */
        , @TinyIndexIgnoreAdaptiveMaxMB DECIMAL(19,2) = 32.0
        , @TinyIndexIgnoreAdaptiveMaxPageCount BIGINT = 1000
        , @MinimumMaintainedIndexMB DECIMAL(19,2) = 16.0

          /* Histerese:
             evita que a recomendação estrutural mude todo dia sem necessidade */
        , @HysteresisLookback INT = 4
        , @HysteresisMinSupport INT = 2
        , @HysteresisPressureOverride INT = 70
        , @HysteresisFragOverride FLOAT = 25.0
        , @HysteresisNoFlipLargeMB DECIMAL(19,2) = 512.0
        , @HysteresisDeadlockOverride INT = 50
        , @HysteresisVeryHighFragOverride INT = 2
        , @HysteresisAnchorFFUpperBound INT = 95

          /* Regra estrutural small/medium:
             quando a frag atual não justifica rebuild, rebaixa para reorganize/none */
        , @StructuralSmallMediumMaxFragForNoRebuild FLOAT = 20.0
        , @StructuralOnlyPressureCeiling INT = 45
        , @StructuralOnlyDeadlockCeiling INT = 40
        , @StructuralOnlyMaxVeryHighFragHits INT = 0

          /* Frag atual baixa: snapshot atual deve mandar mais que o histórico */
        , @LowCurrentFragTableStructuralThreshold FLOAT = 5.0
        , @LowCurrentFragViewStructuralThreshold FLOAT = 10.0
        , @LowCurrentFragPressureCeiling INT = 55
        , @LowCurrentFragDeadlockCeiling INT = 45
        , @LowCurrentFragMaxVeryHighFragHits INT = 1
        , @LowCurrentFragMinViewMB DECIMAL(19,2) = 64.0

          /* Frag ultra-baixa em small/medium:
             bloqueia rebuild estrutural vindo "só do histórico" */
        , @UltraLowFragSmallMediumThreshold FLOAT = 1.0
        , @UltraLowFragFallbackThreshold FLOAT = 2.0
        , @UltraLowFragPressureCeiling INT = 60
        , @UltraLowFragDeadlockCeiling INT = 45
        , @UltraLowFragMaxVeryHighFragHits INT = 3

          /* Faixa intermediária 5%-10%:
             reduz rebuild para reorganize quando a pressão atual é baixa */
        , @MidFragSmallMediumMin FLOAT = 5.0
        , @MidFragSmallMediumMax FLOAT = 10.0
        , @MidFragPressureCeiling INT = 45
        , @MidFragDeadlockCeiling INT = 35
        , @MidFragMaxVeryHighFragHits INT = 0

          /* Refinamento final small/medium faixa 3%-8% */
        , @MidFragSmallMediumLow FLOAT = 3.0
        , @MidFragSmallMediumHigh FLOAT = 8.0
        , @MidFragMaxPressure INT = 70
        , @MidFragMaxDeadlock INT = 55

          /* Refinamento de indexed view PAD-only:
             se a única mudança é PAD e a frag está baixa, não vale rebuild estrutural */
        , @ViewLowFragThreshold FLOAT = 10.0
        , @ViewPadOnlyMaxPressure INT = 60
        , @ViewPadOnlyMaxDeadlock INT = 50

          /* Indexed Views - otimização estrutural segura:
             corrige apenas configurações claramente inadequadas,
             sem alterar locks automaticamente e sem promover PAGE/FF alto por padrão. */
        , @IndexedViewStructuralMinMB DECIMAL(19,2) = 512.0
        , @IndexedViewStructuralLargeMB DECIMAL(19,2) = 1024.0
        , @IndexedViewStructuralFragForFF FLOAT = 10.0
        , @IndexedViewExtremeRebuildFrag FLOAT = 30.0

          /* Métricas do ambiente */
        , @EngineEdition INT
        , @TempdbFreeMB DECIMAL(19,2)
