        , @TempdbWriteLatencyMs DECIMAL(19,4)
        , @DbWriteLatencyMs DECIMAL(19,4)
        , @TempdbPagelatchWaitingTasks INT
        , @TempdbDataFiles INT
        , @CpuCount INT
        , @TempdbImbPct DECIMAL(19,2);

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Permite sobrepor thresholds pela tabela de configuração por banco.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    SELECT TOP (1)
          @LowFragThreshold = ISNULL([LowFragThreshold], @LowFragThreshold)
        , @ReorgThreshold = ISNULL([ReorgThreshold], @ReorgThreshold)
        , @RebuildThreshold = ISNULL([RebuildThreshold], @RebuildThreshold)
        , @MinPageCount = ISNULL([MinPageCount], @MinPageCount)
        , @WriteHeavyRatio = ISNULL([WriteHeavyRatio], @WriteHeavyRatio)
        , @MinWritesForWriteHeavy = ISNULL([MinWritesForWriteHeavy], @MinWritesForWriteHeavy)
        , @SplitRateHigh = ISNULL([SplitRateHigh], @SplitRateHigh)
        , @SplitRateMed = ISNULL([SplitRateMed], @SplitRateMed)
        , @PreferPageCompressionMinMB = ISNULL([PreferPageCompressionMinMB], @PreferPageCompressionMinMB)
        , @SortMinIndexSizeMB = ISNULL([SortMinIndexSizeMB], @SortMinIndexSizeMB)
        , @TempdbFreeMultiplier = ISNULL([TempdbFreeMultiplier], @TempdbFreeMultiplier)
        , @TempdbLatencyFactor = ISNULL([TempdbLatencyFactor], @TempdbLatencyFactor)
        , @MaxTempdbFilesRecommended = ISNULL([MaxTempdbFilesRecommended], @MaxTempdbFilesRecommended)
        , @TempdbImbalancePct = ISNULL([TempdbImbalancePct], @TempdbImbalancePct)
    FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_Config
    WHERE [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase;

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Carrega métricas do ambiente do snapshot.
       São usadas principalmente para SORT_IN_TEMPDB e decisão de ONLINE.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    SELECT
          @EngineEdition = [EngineEdition]
        , @TempdbFreeMB = [TempdbFreeMB]
        , @TempdbWriteLatencyMs = [TempdbWriteLatencyMs]
        , @DbWriteLatencyMs = [DbWriteLatencyMs]
        , @TempdbPagelatchWaitingTasks = [TempdbPagelatchWaitingTasks]
        , @TempdbDataFiles = [TempdbDataFiles]
        , @CpuCount = [CpuCount]
        , @TempdbImbPct = [TempdbImbalancePct]
    FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_EnvironmentSnapshot
    WHERE [SnapshotId] = @SnapshotId;

    DECLARE
          @AdaptiveHistoryDepth INT = 7
        , @AdaptiveMinSamples INT = 3
        , @AdaptiveRecurringHighFragHits INT = 3
        , @AdaptiveRecurringVeryHighFragHits INT = 2
        , @AdaptiveMinPressureScore INT = 40
        , @AdaptiveMinWrites BIGINT = 50000
        , @AdaptiveMinSplitRate FLOAT = 0.005
        , @AdaptiveMinSplitRateHigh FLOAT = 0.02
        , @AdaptiveMinFF INT = 80;

    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#rec') IS NOT NULL
        DROP TABLE #rec;

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Tabela de trabalho:
       concentra snapshot atual, métricas históricas, recomendações e scripts.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    CREATE TABLE #rec
    (
          [TargetDatabaseName] SYSNAME NOT NULL
        , [SnapshotId] BIGINT NOT NULL
        , [CapturedAt] DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL
        , [ObjectType] CHAR(1) NOT NULL
        , [SchemaName] SYSNAME NOT NULL
        , [ObjectName] SYSNAME NOT NULL
        , [IndexName] SYSNAME NOT NULL
        , [IndexId] INT NOT NULL
        , [PartitionNumber] INT NOT NULL
        , [RowCount] BIGINT NULL
        , [PageCount] BIGINT NULL
        , [IndexSizeMB] DECIMAL(19,2) NULL
        , [AvgFragmentationInPercent] FLOAT NULL
        , [Reads] BIGINT NULL
        , [Writes] BIGINT NULL
        , [WriteReadRatio] FLOAT NULL
        , [LeafSplitCount] BIGINT NULL
        , [ChurnPerWrite] FLOAT NULL
        , [IndexTypeDesc] NVARCHAR(60) NOT NULL
        , [IsUnique] BIT NOT NULL
        , [IsPrimaryKey] BIT NOT NULL
        , [HasFilter] BIT NOT NULL
        , [FilterDefinition] NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL
        , [CurrentFillFactor] INT NOT NULL
        , [CurrentPadIndex] BIT NOT NULL
        , [CurrentAllowPageLocks] BIT NOT NULL
        , [CurrentAllowRowLocks] BIT NOT NULL
        , [CurrentCompression] NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL
        , [IsClustered] BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0)
        , [IsClusteredPrimaryKey] BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0)
        , [IsSmallIndex] BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0)
        , [IsMediumIndex] BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0)
        , [IsEphemeralWriteHeavy] BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0)
        , [IsEphemeralTransient] BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0)
        , [IsAbsoluteWriteIntensive] BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0)
        , [HasRealSplitSignal] BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0)
        , [HasProxySplitPressure] BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0)
        , [HasExtremeRecurringFrag] BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0)
        , [NeedsConservativeMediumFF] BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0)
        , [GlobalNo100Guard] BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0)
        , [FFIncreaseBlocked] BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0)
        , [FillFactorChangeRequired] BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0)
        , [FillFactorRequiredReason] NVARCHAR(400) NULL
        , [CompressionPromotionBlocked] BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0)
        , [CompressionChangeRequired] BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0)
        , [CompressionRequiredReason] NVARCHAR(400) NULL
        , [DeadlockPressureScore] INT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0)

        , [HistorySamples] INT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0)
        , [HighFragHits] INT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0)
        , [VeryHighFragHits] INT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0)
        , [AvgFragHistory] FLOAT NULL
        , [MaxFragHistory] FLOAT NULL
        , [AvgWritesHistory] BIGINT NULL
        , [AvgSplitRateHistory] FLOAT NULL
        , [AdaptivePressureScore] INT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0)
        , [AdaptiveSuggestedFF] INT NULL
        , [AdaptiveCompressionHint] NVARCHAR(10) NULL
        , [IsRecurringFragmenter] BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0)

        , [PrevRec_FillFactor] INT NULL
        , [PrevRec_PadIndex] NVARCHAR(10) NULL
        , [PrevRec_DataCompression] NVARCHAR(10) NULL
        , [PrevSameFFSupport] INT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0)
        , [PrevSamePADSupport] INT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0)
        , [PrevSameCompressionSupport] INT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0)
        , [HysteresisBlockedFF] BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0)
        , [HysteresisBlockedPAD] BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0)
        , [HysteresisBlockedCompression] BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0)

        , [Rec_Action] NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT(N'NONE')
        , [Rec_FillFactor] INT NULL
        , [Rec_PadIndex] NVARCHAR(10) NULL
        , [Rec_AllowPageLocks] NVARCHAR(10) NULL
        , [Rec_AllowRowLocks] NVARCHAR(10) NULL
        , [Rec_DataCompression] NVARCHAR(10) NULL
        , [Rec_SortInTempdb] NVARCHAR(3) NULL
        , [Rec_MaxDop] INT NULL

        , [Reason] NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL
        , [PriorityScore] INT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0)
        , [SuggestedScript] NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL

        , [Diff_FF] BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0)
        , [Diff_PAD] BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0)
        , [Diff_Compression] BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0)
        , [Diff_Sort] BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0)

        , [HasFragData] BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0)
        , [IncludedInPlan] BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0)
    );

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Carrega o snapshot atual para a tabela de trabalho.
       Só entram índices reais, com page_count mínimo, index_id > 0 e nome válido.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    INSERT #rec
    (
          [TargetDatabaseName],[SnapshotId],[CapturedAt]
        , [ObjectType],[SchemaName],[ObjectName],[IndexName],[IndexId],[PartitionNumber]
        , [RowCount],[PageCount],[IndexSizeMB],[AvgFragmentationInPercent]
        , [Reads],[Writes],[WriteReadRatio],[LeafSplitCount],[ChurnPerWrite]
        , [IndexTypeDesc],[IsUnique],[IsPrimaryKey],[HasFilter],[FilterDefinition]
        , [CurrentFillFactor],[CurrentPadIndex],[CurrentAllowPageLocks],[CurrentAllowRowLocks],[CurrentCompression]
        , [HasFragData]
    )
    SELECT
          [I].[TargetDatabaseName], [I].[SnapshotId], [I].[CapturedAt]
        , [I].[ObjectType], [I].[SchemaName], [I].[ObjectName], [I].[IndexName], [I].[IndexId], [I].[PartitionNumber]
        , [I].[RowCount], [I].[PageCount], [I].[IndexSizeMB], [I].[AvgFragmentationInPercent]
        , [I].[Reads], [I].[Writes], [I].[WriteReadRatio], [I].[LeafSplitCount], [I].[ChurnPerWrite]
        , [I].[IndexTypeDesc], [I].[IsUnique], [I].[IsPrimaryKey], [I].[HasFilter], [I].[FilterDefinition]
        , [I].[FillFactor], [I].[PadIndex], [I].[AllowPageLocks], [I].[AllowRowLocks]
        , ISNULL(NULLIF([I].[DataCompressionDesc],N''),N'NONE')
        , CASE WHEN [I].[AvgFragmentationInPercent] IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
    FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexSnapshot AS [I]
    WHERE [I].[TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
      AND [I].[SnapshotId] = @SnapshotId
      AND ISNULL([I].[PageCount], [I].[UsedPageCount]) >= @MinPageCount
      AND [I].[IndexId] > 0
      AND [I].[IndexName] IS NOT NULL
      AND [I].[IndexName] NOT LIKE N'<%';

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Classificação inicial do índice:
       - clustered / PK clustered
       - small / medium
       - write-heavy efêmero
       - escrita absoluta intensa
       - sinal real de split
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [IsClustered] = CASE WHEN UPPER(ISNULL([R].[IndexTypeDesc],N'')) LIKE N'%CLUSTERED%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         , [IsClusteredPrimaryKey] = CASE WHEN [R].[IsPrimaryKey] = 1 AND UPPER(ISNULL([R].[IndexTypeDesc],N'')) LIKE N'%CLUSTERED%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         , [IsSmallIndex] =
            CASE WHEN [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
                   AND ISNULL([R].[PageCount],0) <= 2000
                   AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) <= 64
                 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         , [IsMediumIndex] =
            CASE WHEN [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
                   AND
                   (
                        (ISNULL([R].[PageCount],0) > 2000 AND ISNULL([R].[PageCount],0) <= 25000)
                     OR (ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) > 64 AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) <= 512)
                   )
                 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         , [IsEphemeralWriteHeavy] =
            CASE
                WHEN [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
                 AND ISNULL([R].[Writes],0) >= @MinWritesForWriteHeavy
                 AND
                 (
                      ISNULL([R].[WriteReadRatio],0) >= @WriteHeavyRatio
                   OR ISNULL([R].[Reads],0) = 0
                   OR (ISNULL([R].[RowCount],0) > 0 AND 1.0 * ISNULL([R].[Writes],0) >= (1.0 * [R].[RowCount] * 2.0))
                 )
                 AND
                 (
                      [R].[IsSmallIndex] = 1
                   OR ([R].[IsMediumIndex] = 1 AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) <= 128)
                 )
                THEN 1 ELSE 0
            END
         , [IsAbsoluteWriteIntensive] =
            CASE
                WHEN [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
                 AND ISNULL([R].[Writes],0) >= @AbsoluteWriteHeavyMinWrites
                 AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= @AbsoluteWriteHeavyLargeIndexMB
                THEN 1 ELSE 0
            END
         , [HasRealSplitSignal] =
            CASE
                WHEN ISNULL([R].[ChurnPerWrite],0) >= @SplitRateMed
                  OR ISNULL([R].[LeafSplitCount],0) > 0
                THEN 1 ELSE 0
            END
    FROM #rec AS [R];

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Detecta índices transitórios:
       muita escrita, pouco volume, vida útil curta.
       Neles a proc tende a ser menos agressiva estruturalmente.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [IsEphemeralTransient] =
            CASE
                WHEN [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
                 AND [R].[IsEphemeralWriteHeavy] = 1
                 AND ISNULL([R].[Writes],0) >= @EphemeralMinWrites
                 AND ISNULL([R].[RowCount],0) <= @EphemeralMaxRowCount
                 AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) <= @EphemeralMaxIndexSizeMB
                THEN 1 ELSE 0
            END
    FROM #rec AS [R];

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Ação física base (sem refinamentos):
       >= rebuild_threshold -> REBUILD
       >= reorg_threshold   -> REORGANIZE
       senão                -> NONE
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [Rec_Action] =
            CASE
                WHEN [R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent] IS NULL THEN N'NONE'
                WHEN [R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent] >= @RebuildThreshold THEN N'REBUILD'
                WHEN [R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent] >= @ReorgThreshold THEN N'REORGANIZE'
                ELSE N'NONE'
            END
    FROM #rec AS [R];

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       FF base:
       - write-heavy / split alto -> FF mais baixo
       - leitura predominante -> FF 100
       - views materializadas têm política própria
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [Rec_FillFactor] =
            CASE
                WHEN [R].[ObjectType] = 'V'
                 AND ISNULL([R].[Writes],0) >= @MinWritesForWriteHeavy
                 AND ISNULL([R].[ChurnPerWrite],0) >= @SplitRateHigh THEN 80
                WHEN [R].[ObjectType] = 'V'
                 AND ISNULL([R].[Writes],0) >= @MinWritesForWriteHeavy THEN 85
                WHEN [R].[ObjectType] = 'V' THEN CASE WHEN ISNULL([R].[CurrentFillFactor],0) > 0 THEN [R].[CurrentFillFactor] ELSE 85 END
                WHEN [R].[IsSmallIndex] = 1 AND ISNULL([R].[Writes],0) < @MinWritesForWriteHeavy THEN 100
                WHEN ISNULL([R].[Writes],0) >= @MinWritesForWriteHeavy
                 AND (ISNULL([R].[WriteReadRatio],0) >= @WriteHeavyRatio OR ISNULL([R].[Reads],0)=0)
                 AND ISNULL([R].[ChurnPerWrite],0) >= @SplitRateHigh THEN 80
                WHEN ISNULL([R].[Writes],0) >= @MinWritesForWriteHeavy
                 AND (ISNULL([R].[WriteReadRatio],0) >= @WriteHeavyRatio OR ISNULL([R].[Reads],0)=0)
                 AND ISNULL([R].[ChurnPerWrite],0) >= @SplitRateMed THEN 85
                WHEN ISNULL([R].[Writes],0) >= @MinWritesForWriteHeavy
                 AND (ISNULL([R].[WriteReadRatio],0) >= @WriteHeavyRatio OR ISNULL([R].[Reads],0)=0)
                 AND ISNULL([R].[ChurnPerWrite],0) > 0 THEN 90
                WHEN [R].[IsAbsoluteWriteIntensive] = 1 THEN 95
                WHEN ISNULL([R].[Reads],0) > ISNULL([R].[Writes],0) THEN 100
                ELSE 95
            END
    FROM #rec AS [R];

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       PAD base:
       - views com FF<100 -> ON
       - índices muito grandes -> ON
       - small index ou FF=100 -> OFF
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [Rec_PadIndex] =
            CASE
                WHEN [R].[ObjectType] = 'V'
                 AND ISNULL([R].[Rec_FillFactor],CASE WHEN ISNULL([R].[CurrentFillFactor],0) > 0 THEN [R].[CurrentFillFactor] ELSE 85 END) < 100 THEN N'ON'
                WHEN [R].[ObjectType] = 'V' THEN N'OFF'
                WHEN [R].[IsSmallIndex] = 1 AND ISNULL([R].[Rec_FillFactor],100) >= 100 THEN N'OFF'
                WHEN ISNULL([R].[Rec_FillFactor],100) >= 100 THEN N'OFF'
                WHEN ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= 1024 THEN N'ON'
                ELSE N'OFF'
            END
    FROM #rec AS [R];

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Lock options:
       a proc NÃO altera automaticamente allow_page_locks / allow_row_locks.
       Ela apenas marca REVIEW quando há chance de ser relevante.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [Rec_AllowPageLocks] =
            CASE
                WHEN [R].[ObjectType] = 'V' THEN N'REVIEW'
                WHEN (ISNULL([R].[Writes],0) >= @MinWritesForWriteHeavy AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= 512)
                  OR ([R].[IsAbsoluteWriteIntensive] = 1)
                THEN N'REVIEW'
                ELSE N'KEEP'
            END
         , [Rec_AllowRowLocks] =
            CASE
                WHEN [R].[ObjectType] = 'V' THEN N'REVIEW'
                WHEN (ISNULL([R].[Writes],0) >= @MinWritesForWriteHeavy AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= 1024)
                  OR ([R].[IsAbsoluteWriteIntensive] = 1)
                THEN N'REVIEW'
                ELSE N'KEEP'
            END
    FROM #rec AS [R];

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Compressão base:
       - write-heavy tende para NONE/ROW
       - leitura e índice maior podem justificar ROW/PAGE
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [Rec_DataCompression] =
            CASE
                WHEN [R].[ObjectType] = 'V' THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN ISNULL([R].[Reads],0) >= (ISNULL([R].[Writes],0) * 10)
                         AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= @PreferPageCompressionMinMB THEN N'PAGE'
                        WHEN ISNULL([R].[Writes],0) >= (@MinWritesForWriteHeavy * 4)
                         OR (ISNULL([R].[WriteReadRatio],0) >= (@WriteHeavyRatio * 3) AND ISNULL([R].[Writes],0) >= @MinWritesForWriteHeavy)
                        THEN N'NONE'
                        ELSE N'ROW'
                    END
                WHEN [R].[IsSmallIndex] = 1
                 AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) < 128
                 AND ISNULL([R].[Writes],0) < @MinWritesForWriteHeavy THEN N'NONE'
                WHEN [R].[IsAbsoluteWriteIntensive] = 1
                 AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= 128 THEN N'ROW'
                WHEN ISNULL([R].[Writes],0) >= @MinWritesForWriteHeavy
                 AND (ISNULL([R].[WriteReadRatio],0) >= @WriteHeavyRatio OR ISNULL([R].[Reads],0)=0)
                 AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= 128 THEN N'ROW'
                WHEN ISNULL([R].[Reads],0) > (ISNULL([R].[Writes],0) * 5)
                 AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= @PreferPageCompressionMinMB THEN N'PAGE'
                WHEN ISNULL([R].[Reads],0) > ISNULL([R].[Writes],0)
                 AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= 128 THEN N'ROW'
                ELSE N'NONE'
            END
    FROM #rec AS [R];

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       SORT_IN_TEMPDB:
       ligado apenas quando o ambiente parece suportar:
       - tempdb com espaço
       - latência aceitável
       - número de arquivos razoável
       - sem sinais fortes de contenção
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [Rec_SortInTempdb] =
            CASE
                WHEN ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) < @SortMinIndexSizeMB THEN N'OFF'
                WHEN ISNULL(@TempdbFreeMB,0) < (ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) * @TempdbFreeMultiplier) THEN N'OFF'
                WHEN ISNULL(@TempdbPagelatchWaitingTasks,0) >= 5 THEN N'OFF'
                WHEN ISNULL(@TempdbDataFiles,0) <
                     CASE WHEN ISNULL(@CpuCount,1) < @MaxTempdbFilesRecommended THEN ISNULL(@CpuCount,1) ELSE @MaxTempdbFilesRecommended END THEN N'OFF'
                WHEN ISNULL(@TempdbImbPct,0) > @TempdbImbalancePct THEN N'OFF'
                WHEN @DbWriteLatencyMs IS NULL OR @DbWriteLatencyMs = 0 THEN N'ON'
                WHEN @TempdbWriteLatencyMs IS NULL THEN N'OFF'
                WHEN @TempdbWriteLatencyMs <= (@DbWriteLatencyMs * @TempdbLatencyFactor) THEN N'ON'
                ELSE N'OFF'
            END
         , [Rec_MaxDop] = NULL
    FROM #rec AS [R];

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Histórico adaptativo:
       consolida os últimos snapshots do mesmo índice para medir recorrência.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    ;WITH [hist] AS
    (
        SELECT
              [H].[TargetDatabaseName],[H].[SchemaName],[H].[ObjectName],[H].[IndexName],[H].[IndexId],[H].[PartitionNumber]
            , [HistorySamples] = COUNT(*)
            , [HighFragHits] = SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL([H].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) >= @LowFragThreshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            , [VeryHighFragHits] = SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL([H].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) >= @RebuildThreshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            , [AvgFragHistory] = AVG(CONVERT(FLOAT, ISNULL([H].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0)))
            , [MaxFragHistory] = MAX(CONVERT(FLOAT, ISNULL([H].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0)))
            , [AvgWritesHistory] = AVG(CONVERT(BIGINT, ISNULL([H].[Writes],0)))
            , [AvgSplitRateHistory] =
                AVG
                (
                    CONVERT
                    (
                        FLOAT,
                        CASE
                            WHEN ISNULL([H].[Writes],0) > 0
                                THEN 1.0 * ISNULL([H].[LeafSplitCount],0) / NULLIF([H].[Writes],0)
                            ELSE ISNULL([H].[ChurnPerWrite],0)
                        END
                    )
                )
        FROM
        (
            SELECT
                  [S].[TargetDatabaseName],[S].[SchemaName],[S].[ObjectName],[S].[IndexName],[S].[IndexId],[S].[PartitionNumber]
                , [S].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],[S].[Writes],[S].[LeafSplitCount],[S].[ChurnPerWrite]
                , [RN] = ROW_NUMBER() OVER
                    (
                        PARTITION BY [S].[TargetDatabaseName],[S].[SchemaName],[S].[ObjectName],[S].[IndexName],[S].[IndexId],[S].[PartitionNumber]
                        ORDER BY [S].[SnapshotId] DESC
                    )
            FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexSnapshot AS [S]
            WHERE [S].[TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
              AND [S].[IndexName] IS NOT NULL
              AND [S].[IndexName] NOT LIKE N'<%'
        ) AS [H]
        WHERE [H].[RN] <= @AdaptiveHistoryDepth
        GROUP BY [H].[TargetDatabaseName],[H].[SchemaName],[H].[ObjectName],[H].[IndexName],[H].[IndexId],[H].[PartitionNumber]
    )
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [R].[HistorySamples] = [H].[HistorySamples]
         , [R].[HighFragHits] = [H].[HighFragHits]
         , [R].[VeryHighFragHits] = [H].[VeryHighFragHits]
         , [R].[AvgFragHistory] = [H].[AvgFragHistory]
         , [R].[MaxFragHistory] = [H].[MaxFragHistory]
         , [R].[AvgWritesHistory] = [H].[AvgWritesHistory]
         , [R].[AvgSplitRateHistory] = [H].[AvgSplitRateHistory]
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    INNER JOIN [hist] AS [H]
        ON [H].[TargetDatabaseName] = [R].[TargetDatabaseName]
       AND [H].[SchemaName] = [R].[SchemaName]
       AND [H].[ObjectName] = [R].[ObjectName]
       AND [H].[IndexName] = [R].[IndexName]
       AND [H].[IndexId] = [R].[IndexId]
       AND [H].[PartitionNumber] = [R].[PartitionNumber];

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       ProxySplitPressure:
       quando não há split real medido, mas a recorrência histórica sugere que
       existe pressão estrutural recorrente.
       Também calcula DeadlockPressureScore.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [HasProxySplitPressure] =
            CASE
                WHEN [R].[ObjectType] = 'V'
                 AND ISNULL([R].[CurrentFillFactor],0) <= 85
                 AND ISNULL([R].[CurrentFillFactor],0) > 0
                THEN 0
                WHEN [R].[HasRealSplitSignal] = 1 THEN 1
                WHEN [R].[IsAbsoluteWriteIntensive] = 1
                 AND ISNULL([R].[HighFragHits],0) >= @ProxyRecurringFragHits
                 AND ISNULL([R].[AvgFragHistory],0) >= @ProxySplitFragHistoryThreshold THEN 1
                WHEN [R].[IsAbsoluteWriteIntensive] = 1
                 AND ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) >= @ProxySplitFragThreshold THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
         , [HasExtremeRecurringFrag] =
            CASE
                WHEN [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
                 AND ([R].[IsSmallIndex] = 1 OR [R].[IsMediumIndex] = 1)
                 AND
                 (
                      ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) >= @ExtremeFragThreshold
                   OR ISNULL([R].[AvgFragHistory],0) >= @VeryHighFragHistoryThreshold
                   OR ISNULL([R].[VeryHighFragHits],0) >= 2
                 )
                THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
         , [DeadlockPressureScore] =
            (
                CASE WHEN [R].[ObjectType] = 'V' THEN 15 ELSE 0 END
              + CASE WHEN [R].[IsAbsoluteWriteIntensive] = 1 THEN 30 ELSE 0 END
              + CASE WHEN ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= @DeadlockPressureMinMB THEN 15 ELSE 0 END
              + CASE WHEN ISNULL([R].[Writes],0) >= @DeadlockPressureMinWrites THEN 15 ELSE 0 END
              + CASE WHEN ISNULL([R].[HighFragHits],0) >= @ProxyRecurringFragHits THEN 20 ELSE 0 END
              + CASE WHEN ISNULL([R].[AvgFragHistory],0) >= @ProxySplitFragHistoryThreshold THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
              + CASE WHEN [R].[HasRealSplitSignal] = 1 THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
            )
    FROM #rec AS [R];

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       AdaptivePressureScore:
       pontua quão recorrente / persistente é o problema ao longo do histórico.
       Isso serve para diferenciar "ruído do snapshot" de "comportamento estrutural".
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [AdaptivePressureScore] =
            (
                CASE WHEN [R].[HistorySamples] >= @AdaptiveMinSamples THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
              + CASE WHEN [R].[HighFragHits] >= @AdaptiveRecurringHighFragHits THEN 20 WHEN [R].[HighFragHits] = 2 THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
              + CASE WHEN [R].[VeryHighFragHits] >= @AdaptiveRecurringVeryHighFragHits THEN 20 WHEN [R].[VeryHighFragHits] = 1 THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
              + CASE WHEN ISNULL([R].[AvgWritesHistory],0) >= (@AdaptiveMinWrites * 10) THEN 20 WHEN ISNULL([R].[AvgWritesHistory],0) >= @AdaptiveMinWrites THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
              + CASE WHEN ISNULL([R].[AvgSplitRateHistory],0) >= @AdaptiveMinSplitRateHigh THEN 30 WHEN ISNULL([R].[AvgSplitRateHistory],0) >= @AdaptiveMinSplitRate THEN 15 ELSE 0 END
              + CASE WHEN [R].[HasProxySplitPressure] = 1 THEN 15 ELSE 0 END
            )
         , [IsRecurringFragmenter] =
            CASE
                WHEN [R].[HistorySamples] >= @AdaptiveMinSamples
                 AND ([R].[HighFragHits] >= @AdaptiveRecurringHighFragHits OR [R].[VeryHighFragHits] >= @AdaptiveRecurringVeryHighFragHits)
                THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    FROM #rec AS [R];

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Guarda anti-ruído para índices pequenos:
       - fragmentação histórica em índices muito pequenos costuma ser instável;
       - não deixa histórico adaptativo transformar ruído em REBUILD recorrente;
       - a fragmentação atual ainda pode gerar REORGANIZE/REBUILD pela regra base,
         mas sem o reforço artificial do histórico.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [AdaptivePressureScore] = 0
         , [IsRecurringFragmenter] = 0
         , [HasExtremeRecurringFrag] = 0
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    WHERE ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) < @TinyIndexIgnoreAdaptiveMaxMB
       OR ISNULL([R].[PageCount],0) < @TinyIndexIgnoreAdaptiveMaxPageCount;

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Small/medium conservador:
       quando há padrão recorrente relevante, proíbe recomendações otimistas demais.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [NeedsConservativeMediumFF] =
            CASE
                WHEN [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
                 AND ([R].[IsSmallIndex] = 1 OR [R].[IsMediumIndex] = 1)
                 AND [R].[IsRecurringFragmenter] = 1
                 AND
                 (
                      ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) >= @ConservativeMediumFragCurrent
                   OR ISNULL([R].[AvgFragHistory],0) >= @ConservativeMediumFragHistory
                   OR ISNULL([R].[HighFragHits],0) >= @ConservativeMediumHighHits
                   OR ISNULL([R].[VeryHighFragHits],0) >= 1
                 )
                THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
    FROM #rec AS [R];

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Guarda anti-100.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [GlobalNo100Guard] = 1
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    WHERE [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
      AND
      (
            ISNULL([R].[VeryHighFragHits],0) >= @GlobalNo100VeryHighFragHits
         OR ISNULL([R].[AvgFragHistory],0) >= @GlobalNo100AvgFragHistory
         OR ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) >= @GlobalNo100CurrentFrag
      );

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Recupera a recomendação estrutural anterior mais recente para histerese.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    ;WITH [PrevHist] AS
    (
        SELECT
              [Q].[ObjectType],[Q].[SchemaName],[Q].[ObjectName],[Q].[IndexName],[Q].[IndexId],[Q].[PartitionNumber]
            , [Q].[Rec_FillFactor],[Q].[Rec_PadIndex],[Q].[Rec_DataCompression]
            , [RN] = ROW_NUMBER() OVER
                (
                    PARTITION BY [Q].[ObjectType],[Q].[SchemaName],[Q].[ObjectName],[Q].[IndexName],[Q].[IndexId],[Q].[PartitionNumber]
                    ORDER BY [Q].[PlanDate] DESC, [Q].[SnapshotId] DESC
                )
        FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexPlanQueue AS [Q]
        WHERE [Q].[TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
          AND [Q].[SnapshotId] < @SnapshotId
    )
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [PrevRec_FillFactor] = [P].[Rec_FillFactor]
         , [PrevRec_PadIndex] = [P].[Rec_PadIndex]
         , [PrevRec_DataCompression] = [P].[Rec_DataCompression]
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    INNER JOIN [PrevHist] AS [P]
            ON [P].[ObjectType] = [R].[ObjectType]
           AND [P].[SchemaName] = [R].[SchemaName]
           AND [P].[ObjectName] = [R].[ObjectName]
           AND [P].[IndexName] = [R].[IndexName]
           AND [P].[IndexId] = [R].[IndexId]
           AND [P].[PartitionNumber] = [R].[PartitionNumber]
           AND [P].[RN] = 1;

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Mede suporte da recomendação anterior para reforçar histerese.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    ;WITH [RecentHist] AS
    (
        SELECT
              [Q].[ObjectType],[Q].[SchemaName],[Q].[ObjectName],[Q].[IndexName],[Q].[IndexId],[Q].[PartitionNumber]
            , [Q].[Rec_FillFactor],[Q].[Rec_PadIndex],[Q].[Rec_DataCompression]
            , [RN] = ROW_NUMBER() OVER
                (
                    PARTITION BY [Q].[ObjectType],[Q].[SchemaName],[Q].[ObjectName],[Q].[IndexName],[Q].[IndexId],[Q].[PartitionNumber]
                    ORDER BY [Q].[PlanDate] DESC, [Q].[SnapshotId] DESC
                )
        FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexPlanQueue AS [Q]
        WHERE [Q].[TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
          AND [Q].[SnapshotId] < @SnapshotId
    ),
    [RecentLimited] AS
    (
        SELECT *
        FROM [RecentHist]
        WHERE [RN] <= @HysteresisLookback
    ),
    [Anchor] AS
    (
        SELECT
              [X].[ObjectType],[X].[SchemaName],[X].[ObjectName],[X].[IndexName],[X].[IndexId],[X].[PartitionNumber]
            , [AnchorFF] = [X].[Rec_FillFactor]
            , [AnchorPAD] = [X].[Rec_PadIndex]
            , [AnchorCompression] = [X].[Rec_DataCompression]
        FROM [RecentLimited] AS [X]
        WHERE [X].[RN] = 1
    ),
    [SupportAgg] AS
    (
        SELECT
              [R].[ObjectType],[R].[SchemaName],[R].[ObjectName],[R].[IndexName],[R].[IndexId],[R].[PartitionNumber]
            , [PrevSameFFSupport] = SUM(CASE WHEN [R].[Rec_FillFactor] = [A].[AnchorFF] THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            , [PrevSamePADSupport] = SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL([R].[Rec_PadIndex],N'') = ISNULL([A].[AnchorPAD],N'') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            , [PrevSameCompressionSupport] = SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL([R].[Rec_DataCompression],N'') = ISNULL([A].[AnchorCompression],N'') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        FROM [RecentLimited] AS [R]
        INNER JOIN [Anchor] AS [A]
                ON [A].[ObjectType] = [R].[ObjectType]
               AND [A].[SchemaName] = [R].[SchemaName]
               AND [A].[ObjectName] = [R].[ObjectName]
               AND [A].[IndexName] = [R].[IndexName]
               AND [A].[IndexId] = [R].[IndexId]
               AND [A].[PartitionNumber] = [R].[PartitionNumber]
        GROUP BY [R].[ObjectType],[R].[SchemaName],[R].[ObjectName],[R].[IndexName],[R].[IndexId],[R].[PartitionNumber]
    )
    UPDATE [T]
       SET [PrevSameFFSupport] = ISNULL([S].[PrevSameFFSupport],0)
         , [PrevSamePADSupport] = ISNULL([S].[PrevSamePADSupport],0)
         , [PrevSameCompressionSupport] = ISNULL([S].[PrevSameCompressionSupport],0)
    FROM #rec AS [T]
    INNER JOIN [SupportAgg] AS [S]
            ON [S].[ObjectType] = [T].[ObjectType]
           AND [S].[SchemaName] = [T].[SchemaName]
           AND [S].[ObjectName] = [T].[ObjectName]
           AND [S].[IndexName] = [T].[IndexName]
           AND [S].[IndexId] = [T].[IndexId]
           AND [S].[PartitionNumber] = [T].[PartitionNumber];

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Sugestão adaptativa de FF:
       ajusta o FF base com base em recorrência e pressão.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [AdaptiveSuggestedFF] =
            CASE
                WHEN [R].[ObjectType] = 'V' THEN NULL
                WHEN [R].[HasExtremeRecurringFrag] = 1 THEN NULL
                WHEN [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
                 AND [R].[IsRecurringFragmenter] = 0
                 AND ISNULL([R].[CurrentFillFactor],100) < 100
                 AND ISNULL([R].[AvgFragHistory],0) < @SmallIndexRaiseMaxFragHistory
                 AND ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) < @SmallIndexRaiseMaxCurrentFrag
                 AND ISNULL([R].[AvgWritesHistory],0) < @AdaptiveMinWrites
                 AND ISNULL([R].[Reads],0) > ISNULL([R].[Writes],0)
                    THEN 100
                WHEN [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
                 AND [R].[IsRecurringFragmenter] = 0
                 AND ISNULL([R].[CurrentFillFactor],100) < 95
                 AND ISNULL([R].[AvgFragHistory],0) < @LowFragThreshold
                 AND ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) < @LowFragThreshold
                    THEN 95
                WHEN [R].[HasRealSplitSignal] = 1
                 AND [R].[AdaptivePressureScore] >= 85
                 AND ISNULL([R].[CurrentFillFactor],100) > 80
                    THEN CASE
                            WHEN ISNULL([R].[CurrentFillFactor],100) >= 100 THEN 90
                            WHEN [R].[CurrentFillFactor] > 90 THEN 85
                            WHEN [R].[CurrentFillFactor] > 85 THEN 80
                            ELSE [R].[CurrentFillFactor]
                         END
                WHEN [R].[HasRealSplitSignal] = 1
                 AND [R].[AdaptivePressureScore] >= 60
                 AND ISNULL([R].[CurrentFillFactor],100) > 85
                    THEN CASE
                            WHEN ISNULL([R].[CurrentFillFactor],100) >= 100 THEN 95
                            WHEN [R].[CurrentFillFactor] > 95 THEN 90
                            WHEN [R].[CurrentFillFactor] > 90 THEN 85
                            ELSE [R].[CurrentFillFactor]
                         END
                WHEN [R].[HasRealSplitSignal] = 0
                 AND [R].[HasProxySplitPressure] = 1
                 AND [R].[AdaptivePressureScore] >= @AdaptiveMinPressureScore
                 AND [R].[IsAbsoluteWriteIntensive] = 1
                 AND ISNULL([R].[CurrentFillFactor],100) > 95
                    THEN 95
                ELSE NULL
            END
    FROM #rec AS [R];

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Sugestão adaptativa de compressão.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [AdaptiveCompressionHint] =
            CASE
                WHEN [R].[ObjectType] = 'V' THEN NULL
                WHEN [R].[HasRealSplitSignal] = 1
                 AND [R].[AdaptivePressureScore] >= 70
                 AND [R].[CurrentCompression] = N'PAGE'
                 AND
                 (
                       ISNULL([R].[DeadlockPressureScore],0) >= 30
                    OR ISNULL([R].[HasRealSplitSignal],0) = 1
                    OR ISNULL([R].[HasProxySplitPressure],0) = 1
                    OR ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= 512
                 )
                    THEN N'ROW'
                WHEN [R].[IsAbsoluteWriteIntensive] = 1
                 AND [R].[CurrentCompression] = N'PAGE'
                 AND
                 (
                       ISNULL([R].[DeadlockPressureScore],0) >= 30
                    OR ISNULL([R].[HasRealSplitSignal],0) = 1
                    OR ISNULL([R].[HasProxySplitPressure],0) = 1
                    OR ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= 512
                 )
                    THEN N'ROW'
                ELSE NULL
            END
    FROM #rec AS [R];

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Guarda adaptativa de compressão média:
       impede que AdaptiveCompressionHint ou regra base promovam PAGE -> ROW
       em índices de 256MB a 512MB quando não há pressão real de deadlock/split.
       Esta é a trava que elimina o falso positivo FIN_Custo.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [AdaptiveCompressionHint] = NULL
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    WHERE [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
      AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= 256
      AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) < 512
      AND [R].[CurrentCompression] = N'PAGE'
      AND ISNULL([R].[DeadlockPressureScore],0) < 30
      AND ISNULL([R].[HasRealSplitSignal],0) = 0
      AND ISNULL([R].[HasProxySplitPressure],0) = 0;

    UPDATE [R]
       SET [Rec_FillFactor] =
            CASE
                WHEN [R].[ObjectType] = 'V' THEN [R].[Rec_FillFactor]
                WHEN [R].[AdaptiveSuggestedFF] IS NOT NULL
                 AND [R].[AdaptiveSuggestedFF] BETWEEN @AdaptiveMinFF AND 100
                 AND [R].[AdaptiveSuggestedFF] <> ISNULL([R].[Rec_FillFactor], [R].[CurrentFillFactor])
                    THEN [R].[AdaptiveSuggestedFF]
                ELSE [R].[Rec_FillFactor]
            END
    FROM #rec AS [R];

    UPDATE [R]
       SET [Rec_DataCompression] =
            CASE
                WHEN [R].[ObjectType] = 'V' THEN [R].[Rec_DataCompression]
                WHEN [R].[AdaptiveCompressionHint] IS NOT NULL
                 AND [R].[AdaptiveCompressionHint] <> [R].[CurrentCompression]
                    THEN [R].[AdaptiveCompressionHint]
                ELSE [R].[Rec_DataCompression]
            END
    FROM #rec AS [R];

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Guarda definitiva PAGE->ROW médio:
       reverte a recomendação base PAGE->ROW para índices de 256MB a 512MB
       quando não há DeadlockPressure >= 30 nem sinal real/proxy de split.
       Deve ficar antes do cálculo de Diff_Compression e antes do SuggestedScript.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [Rec_DataCompression] = [R].[CurrentCompression]
         , [AdaptiveCompressionHint] = NULL
         , [CompressionChangeRequired] = 0
         , [CompressionRequiredReason] = NULL
         , [Reason] = CONCAT
            (
                ISNULL([R].[Reason] + N' ', N''),
                N'Bloqueado PAGE->ROW médio: índice entre 256MB e 512MB sem DeadlockPressure >= 30 e sem sinal real/proxy de split; compressão atual preservada.'
            )
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    WHERE [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
      AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= 256
      AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) < 512
      AND LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL([R].[CurrentCompression],N''))) = N'PAGE'
      AND LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL([R].[Rec_DataCompression],N''))) = N'ROW'
      AND ISNULL([R].[DeadlockPressureScore],0) < 30
      AND ISNULL([R].[HasRealSplitSignal],0) = 0
      AND ISNULL([R].[HasProxySplitPressure],0) = 0;

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Faixa conservadora small/medium:
       em cenários recorrentes, desce FF para 95/90 conforme gravidade.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [Rec_FillFactor] =
            CASE
                WHEN ISNULL([R].[CurrentFillFactor],100) >= 100
                 AND
                 (
                      [R].[IsEphemeralWriteHeavy] = 1
                   OR ISNULL([R].[DeadlockPressureScore],0) >= 30
                   OR ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) >= @RebuildThreshold
                   OR ISNULL([R].[VeryHighFragHits],0) >= 2
                   OR ISNULL([R].[AvgFragHistory],0) >= 15.0
                 )
                THEN 90
                WHEN ISNULL([R].[CurrentFillFactor],100) >= 100 THEN 95
                ELSE [R].[CurrentFillFactor]
            END
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    WHERE [R].[NeedsConservativeMediumFF] = 1;

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Guarda global anti-100.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [Rec_FillFactor] =
            CASE
                WHEN ISNULL([R].[CurrentFillFactor],100) >= 100 THEN 95
                WHEN ISNULL([R].[CurrentFillFactor],100) > 95 THEN 95
                ELSE [R].[Rec_FillFactor]
            END
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    WHERE [R].[GlobalNo100Guard] = 1
      AND [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
      AND ISNULL([R].[Rec_FillFactor],100) >= 100;

    UPDATE [R]
       SET [Rec_FillFactor] = 90
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    WHERE [R].[GlobalNo100Guard] = 1
      AND [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
      AND ISNULL([R].[Rec_FillFactor],100) > 90
      AND
      (
            ISNULL([R].[VeryHighFragHits],0) >= 2
         OR ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) >= 50.0
         OR ISNULL([R].[AvgFragHistory],0) >= 15.0
      );

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Política efêmera / transitória.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [Rec_FillFactor] =
            CASE
                WHEN [R].[IsEphemeralTransient] = 1
                 AND
                 (
                      [R].[HasRealSplitSignal] = 1
                   OR ISNULL([R].[AdaptivePressureScore],0) >= @EphemeralHighPressureScore
                   OR ISNULL([R].[HighFragHits],0) >= @EphemeralRecurringHits
                   OR ISNULL([R].[DeadlockPressureScore],0) >= 50
                 )
                THEN 85
                ELSE 90
            END
         , [Rec_DataCompression] = N'NONE'
         , [Rec_PadIndex] = N'OFF'
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    WHERE [R].[IsEphemeralTransient] = 1;

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Guarda final de FF:
       se a recomendação estiver aumentando FF em cenário ruim, bloqueia.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [FFIncreaseBlocked] = 1
         , [Rec_FillFactor] =
            CASE
                WHEN [R].[CurrentFillFactor] < ISNULL([R].[Rec_FillFactor],[R].[CurrentFillFactor]) THEN [R].[CurrentFillFactor]
                ELSE [R].[Rec_FillFactor]
            END
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    WHERE [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
      AND ISNULL([R].[Rec_FillFactor],[R].[CurrentFillFactor]) > [R].[CurrentFillFactor]
      AND
      (
            [R].[HasExtremeRecurringFrag] = 1
         OR ([R].[IsRecurringFragmenter] = 1 AND ISNULL([R].[AvgFragHistory],0) >= @LowFragThreshold)
         OR (ISNULL([R].[DeadlockPressureScore],0) >= 50 AND ISNULL([R].[CurrentFillFactor],100) <= 95)
         OR (ISNULL([R].[HighFragHits],0) >= 3 AND ISNULL([R].[AvgFragHistory],0) >= 5.0 AND ISNULL([R].[CurrentFillFactor],100) <= 95)
      );

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Guarda de compressão:
       evita promover PAGE em cenários recorrentes / sensíveis.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [CompressionPromotionBlocked] = 1
         , [Rec_DataCompression] =
            CASE
                WHEN ISNULL([R].[CurrentCompression],N'') IN (N'ROW',N'NONE') THEN [R].[CurrentCompression]
                ELSE N'ROW'
            END
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    WHERE [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
      AND ISNULL([R].[Rec_DataCompression],N'') = N'PAGE'
      AND
      (
            (([R].[IsSmallIndex] = 1 OR [R].[IsMediumIndex] = 1) AND [R].[IsRecurringFragmenter] = 1)
         OR ([R].[IsRecurringFragmenter] = 1 AND
               (
                    ISNULL([R].[AvgFragHistory],0) >= @KeepRowOnRecurringAvgFrag
                 OR ISNULL([R].[HighFragHits],0) >= @KeepRowOnRecurringHighHits
                 OR ISNULL([R].[AdaptivePressureScore],0) >= @PageBlockPressure
                 OR ISNULL([R].[VeryHighFragHits],0) >= 1
               )
            )
         OR (ISNULL([R].[DeadlockPressureScore],0) >= @KeepRowOnDeadlockPressure)
         OR (ISNULL([R].[AdaptivePressureScore],0) >= @PageBlockPressure
             AND
             (
                    ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) >= @PageBlockCurrentFrag
                 OR ISNULL([R].[AvgFragHistory],0) >= @PageBlockAvgFragHistory
             )
            )
      );

    UPDATE [R]
       SET [CompressionPromotionBlocked] = 1
         , [Rec_DataCompression] = N'ROW'
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    WHERE [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
      AND ISNULL([R].[CurrentCompression],N'') = N'ROW'
      AND ISNULL([R].[Rec_DataCompression],N'') = N'NONE'
      AND
      (
            ISNULL([R].[DeadlockPressureScore],0) >= @KeepRowOnDeadlockPressure
         OR ([R].[IsRecurringFragmenter] = 1 AND
               (
                    ISNULL([R].[AvgFragHistory],0) >= @KeepRowOnRecurringAvgFrag
                 OR ISNULL([R].[HighFragHits],0) >= @KeepRowOnRecurringHighHits
                 OR ISNULL([R].[AdaptivePressureScore],0) >= @KeepRowOnRecurringPressure
                 OR ISNULL([R].[VeryHighFragHits],0) >= 1
               )
            )
      )
      AND [R].[IsEphemeralTransient] = 0;

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Índices efêmeros não rebuildam abaixo do threshold de rebuild.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [Rec_Action] = N'NONE'
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    WHERE [R].[IsEphemeralTransient] = 1
      AND ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) < @RebuildThreshold;

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Histerese:
       mantém recomendação estrutural anterior quando não há força suficiente
       para justificar mudança diária.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [HysteresisBlockedFF] = 1
         , [Rec_FillFactor] = [R].[PrevRec_FillFactor]
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    WHERE [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
      AND [R].[IsEphemeralTransient] = 0
      AND [R].[PrevRec_FillFactor] IS NOT NULL
      AND ISNULL([R].[Rec_FillFactor],-1) <> ISNULL([R].[PrevRec_FillFactor],-1)
      AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= @HysteresisNoFlipLargeMB
      AND ISNULL([R].[PrevSameFFSupport],0) >= @HysteresisMinSupport
      AND ISNULL([R].[PrevRec_FillFactor],100) <= @HysteresisAnchorFFUpperBound
      AND ISNULL([R].[AdaptivePressureScore],0) < @HysteresisPressureOverride
      AND ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) < @HysteresisFragOverride
      AND ISNULL([R].[VeryHighFragHits],0) < @HysteresisVeryHighFragOverride
      AND ISNULL([R].[DeadlockPressureScore],0) < @HysteresisDeadlockOverride;

    UPDATE [R]
       SET [HysteresisBlockedPAD] = 1
         , [Rec_PadIndex] = [R].[PrevRec_PadIndex]
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    WHERE [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
      AND [R].[IsEphemeralTransient] = 0
      AND [R].[PrevRec_PadIndex] IS NOT NULL
      AND ISNULL([R].[Rec_PadIndex],N'') <> ISNULL([R].[PrevRec_PadIndex],N'')
      AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= @HysteresisNoFlipLargeMB
      AND ISNULL([R].[PrevSamePADSupport],0) >= @HysteresisMinSupport
      AND ISNULL([R].[AdaptivePressureScore],0) < @HysteresisPressureOverride
      AND ISNULL([R].[DeadlockPressureScore],0) < @HysteresisDeadlockOverride
      AND ISNULL([R].[VeryHighFragHits],0) < @HysteresisVeryHighFragOverride;

    UPDATE [R]
       SET [HysteresisBlockedCompression] = 1
         , [Rec_DataCompression] = [R].[PrevRec_DataCompression]
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    WHERE [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
      AND [R].[IsEphemeralTransient] = 0
      AND [R].[PrevRec_DataCompression] IS NOT NULL
      AND ISNULL([R].[Rec_DataCompression],N'') <> ISNULL([R].[PrevRec_DataCompression],N'')
      AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= @HysteresisNoFlipLargeMB
      AND ISNULL([R].[PrevSameCompressionSupport],0) >= @HysteresisMinSupport
      AND ISNULL([R].[AdaptivePressureScore],0) < @HysteresisPressureOverride
      AND ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) < @HysteresisFragOverride
      AND ISNULL([R].[VeryHighFragHits],0) < @HysteresisVeryHighFragOverride
      AND ISNULL([R].[DeadlockPressureScore],0) < @HysteresisDeadlockOverride
      AND ISNULL([R].[CompressionChangeRequired],0) = 0;

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Recalibra PAD depois das travas e da histerese.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [Rec_PadIndex] =
            CASE
                WHEN [R].[ObjectType] = 'V'
                 AND ISNULL([R].[Rec_FillFactor],CASE WHEN ISNULL([R].[CurrentFillFactor],0) > 0 THEN [R].[CurrentFillFactor] ELSE 85 END) < 100 THEN N'ON'
                WHEN [R].[ObjectType] = 'V' THEN N'OFF'
                WHEN [R].[IsEphemeralTransient] = 1 THEN N'OFF'
                WHEN [R].[HysteresisBlockedPAD] = 1 THEN [R].[Rec_PadIndex]
                WHEN [R].[IsSmallIndex] = 1 THEN N'OFF'
                WHEN ISNULL([R].[Rec_FillFactor],100) >= 100 THEN N'OFF'
                WHEN ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= 1024 THEN N'ON'
                WHEN [R].[HasProxySplitPressure] = 1 AND [R].[IsSmallIndex] = 0 THEN N'ON'
                ELSE N'OFF'
            END
    FROM #rec AS [R];

    UPDATE [R]
       SET [Rec_PadIndex] = N'ON'
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    WHERE [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
      AND [R].[IsEphemeralTransient] = 0
      AND [R].[HysteresisBlockedPAD] = 0
      AND ISNULL([R].[CurrentPadIndex],0) = 1
      AND ISNULL([R].[Rec_PadIndex],N'OFF') = N'OFF'
      AND
      (
            ISNULL([R].[DeadlockPressureScore],0) >= 50
         OR [R].[IsAbsoluteWriteIntensive] = 1
         OR ([R].[IsRecurringFragmenter] = 1 AND ISNULL([R].[AvgFragHistory],0) >= 5.0)
      );

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Calcula diffs estruturais:
       é isso que define se haverá rebuild "por estrutura" mesmo com frag baixa.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [Diff_FF] =
            CASE WHEN ISNULL([R].[Rec_FillFactor],[R].[CurrentFillFactor]) <> [R].[CurrentFillFactor] THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         , [Diff_PAD] =
            CASE
                WHEN [R].[Rec_PadIndex] IN (N'ON',N'OFF')
                 AND (CASE WHEN [R].[Rec_PadIndex]=N'ON' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) <> [R].[CurrentPadIndex]
                THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         , [Diff_Compression] =
            CASE
                WHEN [R].[Rec_DataCompression] IN (N'NONE',N'ROW',N'PAGE')
                 AND ISNULL([R].[Rec_DataCompression],[R].[CurrentCompression]) <> [R].[CurrentCompression]
                THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         , [Diff_Sort] =
            CASE WHEN [R].[Rec_SortInTempdb] IN (N'ON',N'OFF') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    FROM #rec AS [R];

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Small/medium sem pressão suficiente não devem rebuildar só por estrutura.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [Rec_Action] =
            CASE
                WHEN ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) >= @ReorgThreshold THEN N'REORGANIZE'
                ELSE N'NONE'
            END
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    WHERE [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
      AND ([R].[IsSmallIndex] = 1 OR [R].[IsMediumIndex] = 1)
      AND [R].[IsEphemeralTransient] = 0
      AND ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) < @RebuildThreshold
      AND ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) <= @StructuralSmallMediumMaxFragForNoRebuild
      AND ISNULL([R].[AdaptivePressureScore],0) <= @StructuralOnlyPressureCeiling
      AND ISNULL([R].[DeadlockPressureScore],0) <= @StructuralOnlyDeadlockCeiling
      AND ISNULL([R].[VeryHighFragHits],0) <= @StructuralOnlyMaxVeryHighFragHits
      AND ([R].[Diff_FF] = 1 OR [R].[Diff_PAD] = 1 OR [R].[Diff_Compression] = 1);

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Frag atual baixa em tabela:
       snapshot atual pesa mais que o histórico.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [Rec_FillFactor] = [R].[CurrentFillFactor]
         , [Rec_PadIndex] = CASE WHEN [R].[CurrentPadIndex] = 1 THEN N'ON' ELSE N'OFF' END
         , [Rec_DataCompression] = [R].[CurrentCompression]
         , [Rec_Action] = CASE WHEN ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) >= @ReorgThreshold THEN N'REORGANIZE' ELSE N'NONE' END
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    WHERE [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
      AND [R].[IsEphemeralTransient] = 0
      AND ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) < @LowCurrentFragTableStructuralThreshold
      AND ([R].[Diff_FF] = 1 OR [R].[Diff_PAD] = 1 OR [R].[Diff_Compression] = 1)
      AND ISNULL([R].[AdaptivePressureScore],0) <= @LowCurrentFragPressureCeiling
      AND ISNULL([R].[DeadlockPressureScore],0) <= @LowCurrentFragDeadlockCeiling
      AND ISNULL([R].[VeryHighFragHits],0) <= @LowCurrentFragMaxVeryHighFragHits
      AND [R].[HasRealSplitSignal] = 0
      AND [R].[HasProxySplitPressure] = 0;

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Frag atual baixa em indexed view:
       mesma filosofia, mas com threshold mais alto.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [Rec_FillFactor] = [R].[CurrentFillFactor]
         , [Rec_PadIndex] = CASE WHEN [R].[CurrentPadIndex] = 1 THEN N'ON' ELSE N'OFF' END
         , [Rec_DataCompression] = [R].[CurrentCompression]
         , [Rec_Action] = CASE WHEN ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) >= @ReorgThreshold THEN N'REORGANIZE' ELSE N'NONE' END
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    WHERE [R].[ObjectType] = 'V'
      AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= @LowCurrentFragMinViewMB
      AND ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) < @LowCurrentFragViewStructuralThreshold
      AND ([R].[Diff_FF] = 1 OR [R].[Diff_PAD] = 1 OR [R].[Diff_Compression] = 1)
      AND ISNULL([R].[AdaptivePressureScore],0) <= @LowCurrentFragPressureCeiling
      AND ISNULL([R].[DeadlockPressureScore],0) <= @LowCurrentFragDeadlockCeiling
      AND ISNULL([R].[VeryHighFragHits],0) <= @LowCurrentFragMaxVeryHighFragHits;

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Frag ultra-baixa em small/medium:
       bloqueia rebuild estrutural quando a pressão atual não sustenta.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [Rec_FillFactor] = [R].[CurrentFillFactor]
         , [Rec_PadIndex] = CASE WHEN [R].[CurrentPadIndex] = 1 THEN N'ON' ELSE N'OFF' END
         , [Rec_DataCompression] = [R].[CurrentCompression]
         , [Rec_Action] =
            CASE
                WHEN ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) >= @ReorgThreshold THEN N'REORGANIZE'
                ELSE N'NONE'
            END
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    WHERE [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
      AND ([R].[IsSmallIndex] = 1 OR [R].[IsMediumIndex] = 1)
      AND [R].[IsEphemeralTransient] = 0
      AND
      (
            ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) < @UltraLowFragSmallMediumThreshold
         OR
         (
            ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) < @UltraLowFragFallbackThreshold
            AND ISNULL([R].[HasRealSplitSignal],0) = 0
            AND ISNULL([R].[HasProxySplitPressure],0) = 0
         )
      )
      AND ([R].[Diff_FF] = 1 OR [R].[Diff_PAD] = 1 OR [R].[Diff_Compression] = 1)
      AND ISNULL([R].[AdaptivePressureScore],0) <= @UltraLowFragPressureCeiling
      AND ISNULL([R].[DeadlockPressureScore],0) <= @UltraLowFragDeadlockCeiling
      AND ISNULL([R].[VeryHighFragHits],0) <= @UltraLowFragMaxVeryHighFragHits;

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Faixa 5%-10% em small/medium:
       se a pressão atual não justificar rebuild, rebaixa para reorganize.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [Rec_FillFactor] = [R].[CurrentFillFactor]
         , [Rec_PadIndex] = CASE WHEN [R].[CurrentPadIndex] = 1 THEN N'ON' ELSE N'OFF' END
         , [Rec_DataCompression] = [R].[CurrentCompression]
         , [Rec_Action] = N'REORGANIZE'
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    WHERE [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
      AND ([R].[IsSmallIndex] = 1 OR [R].[IsMediumIndex] = 1)
      AND [R].[IsEphemeralTransient] = 0
      AND ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) >= @MidFragSmallMediumMin
      AND ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) < @MidFragSmallMediumMax
      AND ([R].[Diff_FF] = 1 OR [R].[Diff_PAD] = 1 OR [R].[Diff_Compression] = 1)
      AND ISNULL([R].[AdaptivePressureScore],0) <= @MidFragPressureCeiling
      AND ISNULL([R].[DeadlockPressureScore],0) <= @MidFragDeadlockCeiling
      AND ISNULL([R].[VeryHighFragHits],0) <= @MidFragMaxVeryHighFragHits
      AND ISNULL([R].[HasRealSplitSignal],0) = 0
      AND ISNULL([R].[HasProxySplitPressure],0) = 0;

    /* refinamento final small/medium faixa intermediária */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [Rec_FillFactor] = [R].[CurrentFillFactor]
         , [Rec_PadIndex] = CASE WHEN [R].[CurrentPadIndex] = 1 THEN N'ON' ELSE N'OFF' END
         , [Rec_DataCompression] = [R].[CurrentCompression]
         , [Rec_Action] = N'REORGANIZE'
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    WHERE [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
      AND ([R].[IsSmallIndex] = 1 OR [R].[IsMediumIndex] = 1)
      AND [R].[IsEphemeralTransient] = 0
      AND ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) BETWEEN @MidFragSmallMediumLow AND @MidFragSmallMediumHigh
      AND ([R].[Diff_FF] = 1 OR [R].[Diff_PAD] = 1 OR [R].[Diff_Compression] = 1)
      AND ISNULL([R].[AdaptivePressureScore],0) <= @MidFragMaxPressure
      AND ISNULL([R].[DeadlockPressureScore],0) <= @MidFragMaxDeadlock;

    /* refinamento indexed view PAD-only */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [Rec_PadIndex] = CASE WHEN [R].[CurrentPadIndex] = 1 THEN N'ON' ELSE N'OFF' END
         , [Rec_Action] =
            CASE
                WHEN ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) >= @ReorgThreshold THEN N'REORGANIZE'
                ELSE N'NONE'
            END
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    WHERE [R].[ObjectType] = 'V'
      AND ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) < @ViewLowFragThreshold
      AND [R].[Diff_PAD] = 1
      AND [R].[Diff_FF] = 0
      AND [R].[Diff_Compression] = 0
      AND ISNULL([R].[AdaptivePressureScore],0) <= @ViewPadOnlyMaxPressure
      AND ISNULL([R].[DeadlockPressureScore],0) <= @ViewPadOnlyMaxDeadlock;

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Indexed Views - política estrutural segura e controlada:
       - por padrão, preserva compressão, fillfactor e PAD atuais;
       - permite REORGANIZE automático para fragmentação normal;
       - com @IndexedViewStructuralOptimization = 1, corrige somente configurações
         claramente inadequadas:
           a) indexed view grande em PAGE -> NONE via REBUILD;
           b) indexed view grande com FF=100 e fragmentação >= 10% -> FF=90/PAD=ON;
           c) indexed view >= 1GB com fragmentação >= 30% -> REBUILD físico.
       - não altera ALLOW_PAGE_LOCKS / ALLOW_ROW_LOCKS automaticamente.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [Rec_DataCompression] =
            CASE
                WHEN @IndexedViewStructuralOptimization = 1
                 AND [R].[CurrentCompression] = N'PAGE'
                 AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= @IndexedViewStructuralMinMB
                THEN N'NONE'
                ELSE [R].[CurrentCompression]
            END
         , [Rec_FillFactor] =
            CASE
                WHEN @IndexedViewStructuralOptimization = 1
                 AND ISNULL([R].[CurrentFillFactor],100) >= 100
                 AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= @IndexedViewStructuralMinMB
                 AND ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) >= @IndexedViewStructuralFragForFF
                THEN 90
                ELSE [R].[CurrentFillFactor]
            END
         , [Rec_PadIndex] =
            CASE
                WHEN @IndexedViewStructuralOptimization = 1
                 AND ISNULL([R].[CurrentFillFactor],100) >= 100
                 AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= @IndexedViewStructuralMinMB
                 AND ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) >= @IndexedViewStructuralFragForFF
                THEN N'ON'
                WHEN [R].[CurrentPadIndex] = 1 THEN N'ON'
                ELSE N'OFF'
            END
         , [CompressionChangeRequired] =
            CASE
                WHEN @IndexedViewStructuralOptimization = 1
                 AND [R].[CurrentCompression] = N'PAGE'
                 AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= @IndexedViewStructuralMinMB
                THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
         , [CompressionRequiredReason] =
            CASE
                WHEN @IndexedViewStructuralOptimization = 1
                 AND [R].[CurrentCompression] = N'PAGE'
                 AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= @IndexedViewStructuralMinMB
                THEN N'IndexedView: correção estrutural segura: PAGE atual em indexed view grande; recomendado NONE para reduzir custo de manutenção por DML nas tabelas base. REBUILD estrutural controlado.'
                ELSE [R].[CompressionRequiredReason]
            END
         , [FillFactorChangeRequired] =
            CASE
                WHEN @IndexedViewStructuralOptimization = 1
                 AND ISNULL([R].[CurrentFillFactor],100) >= 100
                 AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= @IndexedViewStructuralMinMB
                 AND ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) >= @IndexedViewStructuralFragForFF
                THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
         , [FillFactorRequiredReason] =
            CASE
                WHEN @IndexedViewStructuralOptimization = 1
                 AND ISNULL([R].[CurrentFillFactor],100) >= 100
                 AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= @IndexedViewStructuralMinMB
                 AND ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) >= @IndexedViewStructuralFragForFF
                THEN N'IndexedView: correção estrutural segura: FF 100 em indexed view grande com fragmentação relevante; recomendado FF 90 e PAD ON.'
                ELSE [R].[FillFactorRequiredReason]
            END
         , [Rec_Action] =
            CASE
                WHEN @IndexedViewStructuralOptimization = 1
                 AND (
                        ([R].[CurrentCompression] = N'PAGE' AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= @IndexedViewStructuralMinMB)
                     OR (ISNULL([R].[CurrentFillFactor],100) >= 100 AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= @IndexedViewStructuralMinMB AND ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) >= @IndexedViewStructuralFragForFF)
                     OR (ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= @IndexedViewStructuralLargeMB AND ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) >= @IndexedViewExtremeRebuildFrag)
                    )
                THEN N'REBUILD'
                WHEN ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) >= @ReorgThreshold
                THEN N'REORGANIZE'
                ELSE N'NONE'
            END
         , [HysteresisBlockedFF] = 0
         , [HysteresisBlockedPAD] = 0
         , [HysteresisBlockedCompression] = 0
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    WHERE [R].[ObjectType] = 'V';

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Necessidade explícita de troca de compressão - regra final deadlock-aware:
       - corrige o caso em que a fragmentação atual está baixa, mas a compressão
         PAGE é inadequada para índice grande de OLTP;
       - não usa apenas Reads x Writes, pois índice híbrido grande pode ter muitas
         leituras e ainda assim causar bloqueio/deadlock em atualização;
       - força PAGE -> ROW quando houver uma das classes abaixo:
           1) write-heavy claro:          >= 256 MB, >= 50k writes e ratio >= 2;
           2) híbrido grande perigoso:   >= 512 MB, >= 300k writes e ratio >= 0.20;
           3) pressão estrutural/lock:   >= 256 MB, >= 100k writes e score/split;
              - para índices entre 256 e 512 MB, exige >= 200k writes e pressão real
                (DeadlockPressure >= 30 ou sinal de split; AdaptivePressure isolado não basta);
              - AdaptivePressureScore >= 50 continua válido para índices >= 512MB; para 256-512MB não basta sozinho;
           4) escrita absoluta intensa: flag IsAbsoluteWriteIntensive;
           5) sem leituras no snapshot e muita escrita;
       - quando esta flag é ligada, o plano deve gerar REBUILD, pois REORGANIZE
         não altera DATA_COMPRESSION.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [CompressionChangeRequired] = 1
         , [CompressionRequiredReason] =
            CASE
                WHEN [R].[IsEphemeralTransient] = 1
                THEN N'Troca obrigatória de compressão: PAGE atual em índice transitório/efêmero; recomendado NONE para reduzir custo de escrita.'
                WHEN ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= 512
                 AND ISNULL([R].[Writes],0) >= 300000
                 AND ISNULL([R].[WriteReadRatio],0) >= 0.20
                 AND ISNULL([R].[WriteReadRatio],0) < @WriteHeavyRatio
                THEN N'Troca obrigatória de compressão: PAGE atual em índice híbrido grande com muita escrita absoluta; recomendado ROW para reduzir custo de atualização/bloqueio. REBUILD estrutural mesmo com fragmentação baixa.'
                WHEN ISNULL([R].[Writes],0) >= 100000
                 AND
                 (
                        ISNULL([R].[DeadlockPressureScore],0) >= 30
                     OR ISNULL([R].[AdaptivePressureScore],0) >= 50
                     OR ISNULL([R].[HasRealSplitSignal],0) = 1
                     OR ISNULL([R].[HasProxySplitPressure],0) = 1
                 )
                THEN N'Troca obrigatória de compressão: PAGE atual em índice grande com pressão estrutural/de bloqueio; recomendado ROW. REBUILD estrutural mesmo com fragmentação baixa.'
                ELSE N'Troca obrigatória de compressão: PAGE atual em índice grande write-heavy; recomendado ROW para reduzir custo de escrita/manutenção. REBUILD estrutural mesmo com fragmentação baixa.'
              END
         , [Rec_DataCompression] =
            CASE
                WHEN [R].[IsEphemeralTransient] = 1 THEN N'NONE'
                ELSE N'ROW'
              END
         , [HysteresisBlockedCompression] = 0
         , [CompressionPromotionBlocked] = 0
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    WHERE [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
      AND [R].[CurrentCompression] = N'PAGE'
      AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= 256
      /* Refinamento final:
         - índices entre 256 MB e 512 MB só entram na troca obrigatória
           se tiverem escrita absoluta relevante (>= 200k writes) E pressão real
           (deadlock/split; AdaptivePressure isolado não basta);
         - índices >= 512 MB continuam usando as classes de risco abaixo. */
      AND
      (
            ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= 512
         OR
            (
                ISNULL([R].[Writes],0) >= 200000
                AND
                (
                       ISNULL([R].[DeadlockPressureScore],0) >= 30
                    OR ISNULL([R].[HasRealSplitSignal],0) = 1
                    OR ISNULL([R].[HasProxySplitPressure],0) = 1
                )
            )
      )
      AND
      (
            /* Classe 1: write-heavy claro */
            (
                ISNULL([R].[Writes],0) >= 50000
                AND ISNULL([R].[WriteReadRatio],0) >= @WriteHeavyRatio
            )
         OR
            /* Classe 2: índice híbrido grande com muita escrita absoluta */
            (
                ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= 512
                AND ISNULL([R].[Writes],0) >= 300000
                AND ISNULL([R].[WriteReadRatio],0) >= 0.20
            )
         OR
            /* Classe 3: pressão estrutural / risco de bloqueio */
            (
                ISNULL([R].[Writes],0) >= 100000
                AND
                (
                       ISNULL([R].[DeadlockPressureScore],0) >= 30
                    OR ISNULL([R].[AdaptivePressureScore],0) >= 50
                    OR ISNULL([R].[HasRealSplitSignal],0) = 1
                    OR ISNULL([R].[HasProxySplitPressure],0) = 1
                )
            )
         OR [R].[IsAbsoluteWriteIntensive] = 1
         OR (ISNULL([R].[Reads],0) = 0 AND ISNULL([R].[Writes],0) >= 50000)
      );

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Guarda para índice híbrido muito lido:
       - evita converter automaticamente PAGE -> ROW em índices grandes onde a
         leitura é muito predominante e não há sinal forte de pressão estrutural;
       - mantém a recomendação atual para revisão humana, reduzindo risco de
         remover PAGE de índices com benefício claro de leitura;
       - não bloqueia índices com DeadlockPressure/AdaptivePressure relevante (>=50) ou
         sinal real/proxy de split.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [CompressionChangeRequired] = 0
         , [CompressionRequiredReason] =
            CONCAT
            (
                ISNULL([R].[CompressionRequiredReason] + N' | ', N''),
                N'Guarda aplicada: índice híbrido muito grande com predominância de leitura; ',
                N'compressão PAGE preservada para revisão manual.'
            )
         , [Rec_DataCompression] = [R].[CurrentCompression]
         , [CompressionPromotionBlocked] = 0
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    WHERE [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
      AND [R].[CurrentCompression] = N'PAGE'
      AND [R].[CompressionChangeRequired] = 1
      AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= 512
      AND ISNULL([R].[Reads],0) >= 3000000
      AND ISNULL([R].[WriteReadRatio],0) < 0.30
      AND ISNULL([R].[DeadlockPressureScore],0) < 30
      AND ISNULL([R].[AdaptivePressureScore],0) < 50
      AND ISNULL([R].[HasRealSplitSignal],0) = 0
      AND ISNULL([R].[HasProxySplitPressure],0) = 0
      AND ISNULL([R].[IsAbsoluteWriteIntensive],0) = 0;

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Necessidade explícita de troca de FILLFACTOR:
       - corrige o caso em que a fragmentação atual está baixa, mas o índice
         apresenta pressão clara de escrita/split e o FF atual está alto demais;
       - é propositalmente mais conservador que compressão para evitar rebuilds
         caros por pequenas diferenças como 95 -> 90;
       - quando esta flag é ligada, o plano deve gerar REBUILD, pois REORGANIZE
         não altera FILLFACTOR/PAD_INDEX.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [FillFactorChangeRequired] = 1
         , [FillFactorRequiredReason] =
            CONCAT
            (
                N'Troca obrigatória de FILLFACTOR: FF atual ',
                CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), [R].[CurrentFillFactor]),
                N' e recomendado ',
                CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),
                    CASE
                        WHEN ISNULL([R].[CurrentFillFactor],100) >= 100
                         AND
                         (
                              ISNULL([R].[DeadlockPressureScore],0) >= 50
                           OR ISNULL([R].[AdaptivePressureScore],0) >= 70
                           OR [R].[HasRealSplitSignal] = 1
                           OR [R].[HasProxySplitPressure] = 1
                           OR [R].[IsAbsoluteWriteIntensive] = 1
                         )
                        THEN 90
                        WHEN ISNULL([R].[CurrentFillFactor],100) >= 95
                         AND
                         (
                              ISNULL([R].[DeadlockPressureScore],0) >= 60
                           OR ISNULL([R].[AdaptivePressureScore],0) >= 85
                           OR [R].[HasRealSplitSignal] = 1
                           OR [R].[IsAbsoluteWriteIntensive] = 1
                         )
                        THEN 85
                        ELSE ISNULL([R].[Rec_FillFactor], [R].[CurrentFillFactor])
                    END
                ),
                N' em índice grande com pressão de escrita/split. REBUILD estrutural mesmo com fragmentação baixa.'
            )
         , [Rec_FillFactor] =
            CASE
                WHEN ISNULL([R].[CurrentFillFactor],100) >= 100
                 AND
                 (
                      ISNULL([R].[DeadlockPressureScore],0) >= 50
                   OR ISNULL([R].[AdaptivePressureScore],0) >= 70
                   OR [R].[HasRealSplitSignal] = 1
                   OR [R].[HasProxySplitPressure] = 1
                   OR [R].[IsAbsoluteWriteIntensive] = 1
                 )
                THEN 90
                WHEN ISNULL([R].[CurrentFillFactor],100) >= 95
                 AND
                 (
                      ISNULL([R].[DeadlockPressureScore],0) >= 60
                   OR ISNULL([R].[AdaptivePressureScore],0) >= 85
                   OR [R].[HasRealSplitSignal] = 1
                   OR [R].[IsAbsoluteWriteIntensive] = 1
                 )
                THEN 85
                ELSE [R].[Rec_FillFactor]
              END
         , [Rec_PadIndex] =
            CASE
                WHEN ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= 1024 THEN N'ON'
                WHEN ISNULL([R].[Rec_PadIndex], N'OFF') IN (N'ON', N'OFF') THEN [R].[Rec_PadIndex]
                ELSE N'OFF'
              END
         , [HysteresisBlockedFF] = 0
         , [HysteresisBlockedPAD] = 0
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    WHERE [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
      AND [R].[IsEphemeralTransient] = 0
      AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= 256
      AND
      (
             (ISNULL([R].[CurrentFillFactor],100) >= 100 AND ISNULL([R].[Rec_FillFactor],100) <= 90)
          OR (ISNULL([R].[CurrentFillFactor],100) >= 95  AND ISNULL([R].[Rec_FillFactor],100) <= 85)
          OR (ISNULL([R].[CurrentFillFactor],100) >= 100
              AND
              (
                   ISNULL([R].[DeadlockPressureScore],0) >= 50
                OR ISNULL([R].[AdaptivePressureScore],0) >= 70
                OR [R].[HasRealSplitSignal] = 1
                OR [R].[HasProxySplitPressure] = 1
                OR [R].[IsAbsoluteWriteIntensive] = 1
              )
             )
      )
      AND
      (
             ISNULL([R].[Writes],0) >= @MinWritesForWriteHeavy
          OR [R].[IsAbsoluteWriteIntensive] = 1
          OR ISNULL([R].[DeadlockPressureScore],0) >= 50
          OR ISNULL([R].[AdaptivePressureScore],0) >= 70
          OR [R].[HasRealSplitSignal] = 1
          OR [R].[HasProxySplitPressure] = 1
      );

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Recalcula diffs após as travas finais.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [Diff_FF] =
            CASE
                WHEN ISNULL([R].[Rec_FillFactor],[R].[CurrentFillFactor]) <> [R].[CurrentFillFactor]
                THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         , [Diff_PAD] =
            CASE
                WHEN (CASE WHEN [R].[Rec_PadIndex] = N'ON' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) <> [R].[CurrentPadIndex]
                THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         , [Diff_Compression] =
            CASE
                WHEN ISNULL([R].[Rec_DataCompression],[R].[CurrentCompression]) <> [R].[CurrentCompression]
                THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    FROM #rec AS [R];

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Decide inclusão no plano.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [IncludedInPlan] =
            CASE
                WHEN [R].[HasFragData] = 1
                 AND [R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent] >= @ReorgThreshold
                 AND [R].[IsEphemeralTransient] = 0 THEN 1
                WHEN ([R].[Diff_FF] = 1 OR [R].[Diff_PAD] = 1 OR [R].[Diff_Compression] = 1) THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
    FROM #rec AS [R];

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Ação final:
       - frag alta manda;
       - se não houver frag alta mas ainda houver diff estrutural, vira rebuild.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [Rec_Action] =
            CASE
                WHEN [R].[IncludedInPlan] = 0 THEN N'NONE'
                WHEN [R].[Diff_Compression] = 1 OR [R].[CompressionChangeRequired] = 1 THEN N'REBUILD'
                WHEN [R].[FillFactorChangeRequired] = 1 THEN N'REBUILD'
                WHEN [R].[HasFragData] = 1 AND [R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent] >= @RebuildThreshold THEN N'REBUILD'
                WHEN [R].[HasFragData] = 1 AND [R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent] >= @ReorgThreshold THEN N'REORGANIZE'
