                WHEN [R].[Diff_FF] = 1 OR [R].[Diff_PAD] = 1 THEN N'REBUILD'
                ELSE N'NONE'
            END
    FROM #rec AS [R];

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Guarda final para índice pequeno:
       - abaixo de 32MB ou 1000 páginas, não faz REBUILD apenas por fragmentação
         histórica/adaptativa ou fragmentação atual alta;
       - preserva REBUILD quando existe mudança estrutural obrigatória de compressão
         ou fillfactor, pois nesses casos REORGANIZE não aplica a correção.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [Rec_Action] =
            CASE
                WHEN ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) >= @ReorgThreshold THEN N'REORGANIZE'
                ELSE N'NONE'
            END
         , [Reason] = CONCAT
            (
                ISNULL([R].[Reason] + N' ', N''),
                N'Guarda anti-ruído small index: REBUILD rebaixado para ',
                CASE WHEN ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) >= @ReorgThreshold THEN N'REORGANIZE' ELSE N'NONE' END,
                N' porque o índice tem menos de 32MB ou menos de 1000 páginas e não há mudança estrutural obrigatória.'
            )
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    WHERE [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
      AND [R].[Rec_Action] = N'REBUILD'
      AND (ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) < @TinyIndexIgnoreAdaptiveMaxMB OR ISNULL([R].[PageCount],0) < @TinyIndexIgnoreAdaptiveMaxPageCount)
      AND ISNULL([R].[CompressionChangeRequired],0) = 0
      AND ISNULL([R].[FillFactorChangeRequired],0) = 0
      AND ISNULL([R].[Diff_Compression],0) = 0
      AND ISNULL([R].[Diff_FF],0) = 0;

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Guarda final para índice minúsculo:
       - abaixo de @MinimumMaintainedIndexMB, não mantém o índice na fila apenas por
         fragmentação atual/histórica;
       - preserva a entrada quando existe mudança estrutural real de compressão,
         fillfactor ou PAD, porque REORGANIZE/NONE não aplicariam a correção.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [IncludedInPlan] = 0
         , [Rec_Action] = N'NONE'
         , [PriorityScore] = 0
         , [Reason] = CONCAT
            (
                ISNULL([R].[Reason] + N' ', N''),
                N'Guarda índice minúsculo: removido do plano porque possui menos de ',
                CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30), @MinimumMaintainedIndexMB),
                N'MB e não há mudança estrutural real.'
            )
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    WHERE [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
      AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) < @MinimumMaintainedIndexMB
      AND ISNULL([R].[CompressionChangeRequired],0) = 0
      AND ISNULL([R].[FillFactorChangeRequired],0) = 0
      AND ISNULL([R].[Diff_Compression],0) = 0
      AND ISNULL([R].[Diff_FF],0) = 0
      AND ISNULL([R].[Diff_PAD],0) = 0;

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       GUARDA FINAL FORTE - compressão média (256MB a 512MB):
       - esta trava roda depois de todas as heurísticas e histereses;
       - elimina PAGE -> ROW quando a única evidência é AdaptivePressure/histórico;
       - para essa faixa, exige pressão real de deadlock ou split.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [CompressionChangeRequired] = 0
         , [CompressionRequiredReason] = NULL
         , [Rec_DataCompression] = [R].[CurrentCompression]
         , [Diff_Compression] = 0
         , [Rec_Action] =
            CASE
                WHEN [R].[HasFragData] = 1 AND [R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent] >= @RebuildThreshold THEN N'REBUILD'
                WHEN [R].[HasFragData] = 1 AND [R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent] >= @ReorgThreshold THEN N'REORGANIZE'
                WHEN ISNULL([R].[Diff_FF],0) = 1 OR ISNULL([R].[Diff_PAD],0) = 1 THEN N'REBUILD'
                ELSE N'NONE'
            END
         , [IncludedInPlan] =
            CASE
                WHEN [R].[HasFragData] = 1 AND [R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent] >= @ReorgThreshold THEN 1
                WHEN ISNULL([R].[Diff_FF],0) = 1 OR ISNULL([R].[Diff_PAD],0) = 1 THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
         , [Reason] = CONCAT
            (
                ISNULL([R].[Reason] + N' ', N''),
                N'Guarda final PAGE->ROW médio: compressão preservada porque índice entre 256MB e 512MB não possui pressão real de deadlock/split.'
            )
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    WHERE [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
      AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= 256
      AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) < 512
      AND [R].[CurrentCompression] = N'PAGE'
      AND [R].[Rec_DataCompression] = N'ROW'
      AND ISNULL([R].[DeadlockPressureScore],0) < 30
      AND ISNULL([R].[HasRealSplitSignal],0) = 0
      AND ISNULL([R].[HasProxySplitPressure],0) = 0;

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       GUARDA FINAL FORTE - índices minúsculos (< @MinimumMaintainedIndexMB):
       - remove da fila qualquer índice muito pequeno quando a única razão for
         fragmentação, PAD ou FILLFACTOR;
       - preserva somente correção de compressão PAGE -> ROW/NONE, porque PAGE
         em índice minúsculo é configuração claramente inadequada e requer REBUILD;
       - esta trava roda depois da decisão de ação para não ser revertida.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [IncludedInPlan] = 0
         , [Rec_Action] = N'NONE'
         , [PriorityScore] = 0
         , [Rec_FillFactor] = [R].[CurrentFillFactor]
         , [Rec_PadIndex] = CASE WHEN [R].[CurrentPadIndex] = 1 THEN N'ON' ELSE N'OFF' END
         , [Diff_FF] = 0
         , [Diff_PAD] = 0
         , [Reason] = CONCAT
            (
                ISNULL([R].[Reason] + N' ', N''),
                N'Guarda final índice minúsculo: removido do plano; abaixo do limite mínimo e sem correção de compressão PAGE necessária.'
            )
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    WHERE [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
      AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) < @MinimumMaintainedIndexMB
      AND NOT
      (
          [R].[CurrentCompression] = N'PAGE'
          AND [R].[Rec_DataCompression] IN (N'ROW', N'NONE')
      );

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       PriorityScore e Reason:
       tornam a recomendação auditável e explicável.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [PriorityScore] =
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= 10240 THEN 300
                    WHEN ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= 2048 THEN 200
                    WHEN ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= 512 THEN 120
                    ELSE 40
                END
                +
                CASE
                    WHEN [R].[HasFragData]=1 AND [R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent] >= @RebuildThreshold THEN 220
                    WHEN [R].[HasFragData]=1 AND [R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent] >= @ReorgThreshold THEN 120
                    ELSE 0
                END
                + CASE WHEN [R].[ObjectType]='V' THEN 120 ELSE 0 END
                + CASE WHEN [R].[IsClusteredPrimaryKey]=1 THEN 40 ELSE 0 END
                + CASE WHEN [R].[Diff_Compression]=1 THEN 90 ELSE 0 END
                + CASE WHEN [R].[CompressionChangeRequired]=1 THEN 80 ELSE 0 END
                + CASE WHEN [R].[FillFactorChangeRequired]=1 THEN 70 ELSE 0 END
                + CASE WHEN [R].[Diff_FF]=1 THEN 60 ELSE 0 END
                + CASE WHEN [R].[Diff_PAD]=1 THEN 40 ELSE 0 END
                + CASE WHEN [R].[IsRecurringFragmenter] = 1 THEN 80 ELSE 0 END
                + CASE WHEN [R].[IsAbsoluteWriteIntensive] = 1 THEN 60 ELSE 0 END
                + CASE WHEN [R].[HasExtremeRecurringFrag] = 1 THEN 50 ELSE 0 END
                + CASE WHEN [R].[NeedsConservativeMediumFF] = 1 THEN 30 ELSE 0 END
                + CASE WHEN [R].[GlobalNo100Guard] = 1 THEN 25 ELSE 0 END
                + CASE WHEN [R].[IsEphemeralTransient] = 1 THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
                + CASE
                    WHEN [R].[DeadlockPressureScore] >= 70 THEN 80
                    WHEN [R].[DeadlockPressureScore] >= 50 THEN 50
                    WHEN [R].[DeadlockPressureScore] >= 30 THEN 20
                    ELSE 0
                  END
                + CASE
                    WHEN [R].[AdaptivePressureScore] >= 80 THEN 60
                    WHEN [R].[AdaptivePressureScore] >= 60 THEN 40
                    WHEN [R].[AdaptivePressureScore] >= 40 THEN 20
                    ELSE 0
                  END
                - CASE WHEN [R].[IsSmallIndex]=1 THEN 30 ELSE 0 END
            )
         , [Reason] =
            CONCAT
            (
                CASE WHEN [R].[ObjectType]='V' THEN CASE WHEN @IndexedViewStructuralOptimization = 1 THEN N'IndexedView: política própria preservada com correção estrutural segura habilitada. ' ELSE N'IndexedView: política própria preservada. ' END ELSE N'' END,
                CASE WHEN [R].[IsSmallIndex]=1 THEN N'Índice pequeno: normalização estrutural habilitada. ' ELSE N'' END,
                CASE WHEN [R].[IsMediumIndex]=1 THEN N'Índice médio: regras conservadoras de subida de FF. ' ELSE N'' END,
                CASE WHEN [R].[IsEphemeralWriteHeavy]=1 THEN N'Perfil pequeno/write-heavy detectado. ' ELSE N'' END,
                CASE WHEN [R].[IsEphemeralTransient]=1 THEN N'Política efêmera/transitória aplicada. ' ELSE N'' END,
                CASE WHEN [R].[IsAbsoluteWriteIntensive]=1 THEN N'Alta escrita absoluta detectada em índice grande. ' ELSE N'' END,
                CASE WHEN [R].[HasRealSplitSignal]=1 THEN N'Sinal real de split/churn detectado. ' ELSE N'' END,
                CASE WHEN [R].[HasProxySplitPressure]=1 AND [R].[HasRealSplitSignal]=0 THEN N'Pressão estrutural inferida por recorrência de fragmentação. ' ELSE N'' END,
                CASE WHEN [R].[HasExtremeRecurringFrag]=1 THEN N'Fragmentação recorrente extrema detectada. ' ELSE N'' END,
                CASE WHEN [R].[NeedsConservativeMediumFF]=1 THEN N'Faixa conservadora small/medium aplicada. ' ELSE N'' END,
                CASE WHEN [R].[GlobalNo100Guard]=1 THEN N'Guarda global anti-100 aplicada. ' ELSE N'' END,
                CASE WHEN [R].[FFIncreaseBlocked]=1 THEN N'Guarda final de FF aplicada: aumento automático bloqueado. ' ELSE N'' END,
                CASE WHEN [R].[FillFactorChangeRequired]=1 THEN CONCAT(ISNULL([R].[FillFactorRequiredReason], N'Troca obrigatória de FILLFACTOR aplicada.'), N' ') ELSE N'' END,
                CASE WHEN [R].[CompressionPromotionBlocked]=1 THEN N'Guarda final de compressão aplicada. ' ELSE N'' END,
                CASE WHEN [R].[CompressionChangeRequired]=1 THEN CONCAT(ISNULL([R].[CompressionRequiredReason], N'Troca obrigatória de compressão aplicada.'), N' ') ELSE N'' END,
                CASE WHEN [R].[HysteresisBlockedFF] = 1 THEN N'Histerese reforçada de FF aplicada: mantida recomendação estrutural anterior. ' ELSE N'' END,
                CASE WHEN [R].[HysteresisBlockedPAD] = 1 THEN N'Histerese reforçada de PAD aplicada: mantida recomendação estrutural anterior. ' ELSE N'' END,
                CASE WHEN [R].[HysteresisBlockedCompression] = 1 THEN N'Histerese reforçada de compressão aplicada: mantida recomendação estrutural anterior. ' ELSE N'' END,
                CASE
                    WHEN [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
                     AND ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) < @LowCurrentFragTableStructuralThreshold
                     AND [R].[Rec_Action] IN (N'NONE',N'REORGANIZE')
                    THEN N'Frag atual baixa em tabela: mudança estrutural postergada e snapshot atual priorizado. '
                    ELSE N''
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN [R].[ObjectType] = 'V'
                     AND ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) < @LowCurrentFragViewStructuralThreshold
                     AND [R].[Rec_Action] IN (N'NONE',N'REORGANIZE')
                    THEN N'Frag atual baixa em indexed view: mudança estrutural postergada e snapshot atual priorizado. '
                    ELSE N''
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
                     AND ([R].[IsSmallIndex] = 1 OR [R].[IsMediumIndex] = 1)
                     AND ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) < @UltraLowFragFallbackThreshold
                     AND [R].[Rec_Action] IN (N'NONE',N'REORGANIZE')
                    THEN N'Frag atual ultra-baixa em small/medium: rebuild por histórico extremo foi bloqueado neste ciclo. '
                    ELSE N''
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
                     AND ([R].[IsSmallIndex] = 1 OR [R].[IsMediumIndex] = 1)
                     AND ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) >= @MidFragSmallMediumMin
                     AND ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) < @MidFragSmallMediumMax
                     AND [R].[Rec_Action] = N'REORGANIZE'
                    THEN N'Faixa intermediária 5%-10% em small/medium: rebuild por histórico foi rebaixado para reorganize neste ciclo. '
                    ELSE N''
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
                     AND ([R].[IsSmallIndex] = 1 OR [R].[IsMediumIndex] = 1)
                     AND ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) BETWEEN @MidFragSmallMediumLow AND @MidFragSmallMediumHigh
                    THEN N'Small/Medium frag intermediária: rebuild estrutural postergado. '
                    ELSE N'' END,
                CASE
                    WHEN [R].[ObjectType] = 'V'
                     AND [R].[Diff_PAD] = 0
                     AND ISNULL([R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent],0) < @ViewLowFragThreshold
                    THEN N'Indexed view frag baixa: mudança apenas PAD adiada. '
                    ELSE N'' END,
                CASE WHEN ISNULL([R].[DeadlockPressureScore],0) >= 50 THEN N'Cenário sensível a deadlock / updates em massa: política conservadora aplicada. ' ELSE N'' END,
                CASE
                    WHEN [R].[IsRecurringFragmenter] = 1
                    THEN
                        CONCAT
                        (
                              N'Histórico adaptativo: recorrente. Samples='
                            , [R].[HistorySamples]
                            , N', HighFragHits='
                            , [R].[HighFragHits]
                            , N', VeryHighFragHits='
                            , [R].[VeryHighFragHits]
                            , N', AvgFragHist='
                            , CONVERT(VARCHAR(32), [R].[AvgFragHistory])
                            , N', AvgSplitRateHist='
                            , CONVERT(VARCHAR(32), [R].[AvgSplitRateHistory])
                            , N', AdaptivePressure='
                            , [R].[AdaptivePressureScore]
                            , N'. '
                        )
                    ELSE N''
                END,
                CASE WHEN [R].[DeadlockPressureScore] >= 50 THEN CONCAT(N'DeadlockPressure=', [R].[DeadlockPressureScore], N'. ') ELSE N'' END,
                CASE WHEN [R].[HasFragData]=1 THEN CONCAT(N'Frag=', CONVERT(VARCHAR(32), [R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent]), N'%. ') ELSE N'' END,
                CASE WHEN [R].[Rec_Action] <> N'NONE' THEN CONCAT(N'Ação=', [R].[Rec_Action], N'. ') ELSE N'' END,
                CASE WHEN [R].[Diff_FF]=1 THEN CONCAT(N'FF ', [R].[CurrentFillFactor], N'->', [R].[Rec_FillFactor], N'. ') ELSE N'' END,
                CASE WHEN [R].[Diff_PAD]=1 THEN CONCAT(N'PAD ', CASE WHEN [R].[CurrentPadIndex]=1 THEN N'ON' ELSE N'OFF' END, N'->', [R].[Rec_PadIndex], N'. ') ELSE N'' END,
                CASE WHEN [R].[Diff_Compression]=1 THEN CONCAT(N'Compression ', [R].[CurrentCompression], N'->', [R].[Rec_DataCompression], N'. ') ELSE N'' END,
                CASE WHEN [R].[Rec_SortInTempdb] IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(N'SORT_IN_TEMPDB=', [R].[Rec_SortInTempdb], N'. ') ELSE N'' END,
                CASE WHEN [R].[Rec_AllowPageLocks]=N'REVIEW' THEN N'ALLOW_PAGE_LOCKS=REVIEW (não auto-muda). ' ELSE N'' END,
                CASE WHEN [R].[Rec_AllowRowLocks]=N'REVIEW' THEN N'ALLOW_ROW_LOCKS=REVIEW (não auto-muda). ' ELSE N'' END
            )
    FROM #rec AS [R];


    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       GUARDA FINALÍSSIMA - executada APÓS a remontagem do Reason e ANTES do script:
       1) Bloqueia PAGE->ROW em índice médio (256-512MB) sem pressão real.
       2) Remove índice <16MB da fila quando não há correção de compressão PAGE.
       Motivo: nenhuma regra posterior pode reverter esta decisão antes do SuggestedScript.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [CompressionChangeRequired] = 0
         , [CompressionRequiredReason] = NULL
         , [Rec_DataCompression] = [R].[CurrentCompression]
         , [Diff_Compression] = 0
         , [Rec_Action] =
            CASE
                WHEN ISNULL([R].[Diff_FF],0) = 1 OR ISNULL([R].[Diff_PAD],0) = 1 THEN N'REBUILD'
                WHEN [R].[HasFragData] = 1 AND [R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent] >= @RebuildThreshold THEN N'REBUILD'
                WHEN [R].[HasFragData] = 1 AND [R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent] >= @ReorgThreshold THEN N'REORGANIZE'
                ELSE N'NONE'
            END
         , [IncludedInPlan] =
            CASE
                WHEN ISNULL([R].[Diff_FF],0) = 1 OR ISNULL([R].[Diff_PAD],0) = 1 THEN 1
                WHEN [R].[HasFragData] = 1 AND [R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent] >= @ReorgThreshold THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
         , [Reason] = CONCAT
            (
                ISNULL([R].[Reason] + N' ', N''),
                N'Bloqueado PAGE->ROW médio: índice entre 256MB e 512MB sem DeadlockPressure >= 30 e sem sinal real/proxy de split; compressão atual preservada. '
            )
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    WHERE [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
      AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= 256
      AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) < 512
      AND LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL([R].[CurrentCompression],N''))) = N'PAGE'
      AND LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL([R].[Rec_DataCompression],N''))) = N'ROW'
      AND ISNULL([R].[DeadlockPressureScore],0) < 30
      AND ISNULL([R].[HasRealSplitSignal],0) = 0
      AND ISNULL([R].[HasProxySplitPressure],0) = 0;

    UPDATE [R]
       SET [IncludedInPlan] = 0
         , [Rec_Action] = N'NONE'
         , [PriorityScore] = 0
         , [Rec_FillFactor] = [R].[CurrentFillFactor]
         , [Rec_PadIndex] = CASE WHEN [R].[CurrentPadIndex] = 1 THEN N'ON' ELSE N'OFF' END
         , [Diff_FF] = 0
         , [Diff_PAD] = 0
         , [Reason] = CONCAT
            (
                ISNULL([R].[Reason] + N' ', N''),
                N'Bloqueado índice minúsculo: menor que 16MB e sem correção de compressão PAGE necessária; removido da fila. '
            )
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    WHERE [R].[ObjectType] = 'U'
      AND ISNULL([R].[IndexSizeMB],0) < @MinimumMaintainedIndexMB
      AND NOT
      (
          LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL([R].[CurrentCompression],N''))) = N'PAGE'
          AND LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL([R].[Rec_DataCompression],N''))) IN (N'ROW', N'NONE')
      );

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       ONLINE = ON apenas quando a edição suporta.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    DECLARE @IsEnterprise BIT = CASE WHEN @EngineEdition IN (3,8) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Geração do comando final.
       - REORGANIZE -> comando leve, sem mudanças estruturais
       - REBUILD    -> aplica FF / PAD / compressão / sort_in_tempdb
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    UPDATE [R]
       SET [SuggestedScript] =
            CASE
                WHEN [R].[IncludedInPlan] = 0 THEN NULL
                WHEN [R].[Rec_Action] = N'NONE' THEN NULL
                WHEN [R].[Rec_Action] = N'REORGANIZE'
                THEN
                    N'ALTER INDEX ' + QUOTENAME([R].[IndexName]) +
                    N' ON ' + QUOTENAME([R].[SchemaName]) + N'.' + QUOTENAME([R].[ObjectName]) +
                    N' REORGANIZE WITH (LOB_COMPACTION = ON);'
                WHEN [R].[Rec_Action] = N'REBUILD'
                THEN
                    N'ALTER INDEX ' + QUOTENAME([R].[IndexName]) +
                    N' ON ' + QUOTENAME([R].[SchemaName]) + N'.' + QUOTENAME([R].[ObjectName]) +
                    N' REBUILD WITH (' +
                    STUFF
                    (
                        (
                            SELECT N', ' + [V].[Opt]
                            FROM
                            (
                                SELECT N'FILLFACTOR = ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(3), ISNULL([R].[Rec_FillFactor], [R].[CurrentFillFactor])) AS [Opt]
                                UNION ALL
                                SELECT N'PAD_INDEX = ' +
                                       CASE
                                           WHEN ISNULL([R].[Rec_FillFactor], [R].[CurrentFillFactor]) >= 100 THEN N'OFF'
                                           WHEN [R].[Rec_PadIndex] IN (N'ON',N'OFF') THEN [R].[Rec_PadIndex]
                                           ELSE CASE WHEN [R].[CurrentPadIndex]=1 THEN N'ON' ELSE N'OFF' END
                                       END
                                UNION ALL
                                SELECT N'DATA_COMPRESSION = ' +
                                       CASE
                                           WHEN [R].[Rec_DataCompression] IN (N'NONE',N'ROW',N'PAGE') THEN [R].[Rec_DataCompression]
                                           ELSE [R].[CurrentCompression]
                                       END
                                UNION ALL
                                SELECT N'SORT_IN_TEMPDB = ' + ISNULL([R].[Rec_SortInTempdb], N'OFF')
                                UNION ALL
                                SELECT CASE WHEN @IsEnterprise = 1 THEN N'ONLINE = ON' END
                            ) AS [V]
                            WHERE [V].[Opt] IS NOT NULL
                            FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE
                        ).value('.', 'nvarchar(max)')
                    ,1,2,N'') +
                    N');'
                ELSE NULL
            END
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    WHERE [R].[IndexName] IS NOT NULL
      AND [R].[IndexName] NOT LIKE N'<%';

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Grid debug resumida.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    IF @Debug = 1
    BEGIN
        SELECT
              [TargetDatabase] = @TargetDatabase
            , [PlanDate] = @PlanDate
            , [SnapshotId] = @SnapshotId
            , [TotalRows] = COUNT(*)
            , [InPlan] = SUM(CASE WHEN [IncludedInPlan]=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            , [RecurringFragmenters] = SUM(CASE WHEN [IsRecurringFragmenter]=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            , [AbsoluteWriteIntensive] = SUM(CASE WHEN [IsAbsoluteWriteIntensive]=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            , [EphemeralTransient] = SUM(CASE WHEN [IsEphemeralTransient]=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            , [ProxySplitPressure] = SUM(CASE WHEN [HasProxySplitPressure]=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            , [ExtremeRecurringFrag] = SUM(CASE WHEN [HasExtremeRecurringFrag]=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            , [NeedsConservativeMediumFF] = SUM(CASE WHEN [NeedsConservativeMediumFF]=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            , [GlobalNo100Guard] = SUM(CASE WHEN [GlobalNo100Guard]=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            , [FFIncreaseBlocked] = SUM(CASE WHEN [FFIncreaseBlocked]=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            , [CompressionPromotionBlocked] = SUM(CASE WHEN [CompressionPromotionBlocked]=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            , [CompressionChangeRequired] = SUM(CASE WHEN [CompressionChangeRequired]=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            , [FillFactorChangeRequired] = SUM(CASE WHEN [FillFactorChangeRequired]=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            , [HysteresisBlockedFF] = SUM(CASE WHEN [HysteresisBlockedFF]=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            , [HysteresisBlockedPAD] = SUM(CASE WHEN [HysteresisBlockedPAD]=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            , [HysteresisBlockedCompression] = SUM(CASE WHEN [HysteresisBlockedCompression]=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            , [ReorganizeBase] = SUM(CASE WHEN [Rec_Action]=N'REORGANIZE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            , [RebuildBase] = SUM(CASE WHEN [Rec_Action]=N'REBUILD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        FROM #rec;
    END;

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Retorno final para análise.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    SELECT
          [R].[PriorityScore]
        , [R].[ObjectType]
        , [R].[SchemaName]
        , [R].[ObjectName]
        , [R].[IndexName]
        , [R].[IndexId]
        , [R].[PartitionNumber]
        , [R].[RowCount]
        , [R].[IndexSizeMB]
        , [R].[PageCount]
        , [R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent]
        , [R].[Reads]
        , [R].[Writes]
        , [R].[WriteReadRatio]
        , [R].[IsSmallIndex]
        , [R].[IsMediumIndex]
        , [R].[IsEphemeralWriteHeavy]
        , [R].[IsEphemeralTransient]
        , [R].[IsAbsoluteWriteIntensive]
        , [R].[HasRealSplitSignal]
        , [R].[HasProxySplitPressure]
        , [R].[HasExtremeRecurringFrag]
        , [R].[NeedsConservativeMediumFF]
        , [R].[GlobalNo100Guard]
        , [R].[FFIncreaseBlocked]
        , [R].[CompressionPromotionBlocked]
        , [R].[CompressionChangeRequired]
        , [R].[CompressionRequiredReason]
        , [R].[DeadlockPressureScore]
        , [R].[CurrentFillFactor]
        , [R].[CurrentPadIndex]
        , [R].[CurrentAllowPageLocks]
        , [R].[CurrentAllowRowLocks]
        , [R].[CurrentCompression]
        , [R].[HistorySamples]
        , [R].[HighFragHits]
        , [R].[VeryHighFragHits]
        , [R].[AvgFragHistory]
        , [R].[MaxFragHistory]
        , [R].[AvgWritesHistory]
        , [R].[AvgSplitRateHistory]
        , [R].[AdaptivePressureScore]
        , [R].[IsRecurringFragmenter]
        , [R].[PrevRec_FillFactor]
        , [R].[PrevRec_PadIndex]
        , [R].[PrevRec_DataCompression]
        , [R].[PrevSameFFSupport]
        , [R].[PrevSamePADSupport]
        , [R].[PrevSameCompressionSupport]
        , [R].[HysteresisBlockedFF]
        , [R].[HysteresisBlockedPAD]
        , [R].[HysteresisBlockedCompression]
        , [R].[Rec_Action]
        , [R].[Rec_FillFactor]
        , [R].[Rec_PadIndex]
        , [R].[Rec_AllowPageLocks]
        , [R].[Rec_AllowRowLocks]
        , [R].[Rec_DataCompression]
        , [R].[Rec_SortInTempdb]
        , [R].[Rec_MaxDop]
        , [R].[Reason]
        , [R].[SuggestedScript]
    FROM #rec AS [R]
    WHERE [R].[IncludedInPlan] = 1
      AND [R].[SuggestedScript] IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY [R].[PriorityScore] DESC, [R].[ObjectType], [R].[SchemaName], [R].[ObjectName], [R].[IndexName];

    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       Se solicitado, grava / atualiza a fila de execução.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    IF @QueuePlan = 1
    BEGIN
        MERGE Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexPlanQueue AS [TGT]
        USING
        (
            SELECT
                  @PlanDate AS [PlanDate]
                , @TargetDatabase AS [TargetDatabaseName]
                , @SnapshotId AS [SnapshotId]
                , [R].[ObjectType]
                , [R].[SchemaName]
                , [R].[ObjectName]
                , [R].[IndexName]
                , [R].[IndexId]
                , [R].[PartitionNumber]
                , [R].[PageCount]
                , [R].[IndexSizeMB]
                , [R].[AvgFragmentationInPercent]
                , [R].[CurrentFillFactor]
                , [R].[CurrentPadIndex]
                , [R].[CurrentAllowPageLocks]
                , [R].[CurrentAllowRowLocks]
                , [R].[CurrentCompression]
                , [R].[Rec_Action]
                , [R].[Rec_FillFactor]
                , [R].[Rec_PadIndex]
                , [R].[Rec_AllowPageLocks]
                , [R].[Rec_AllowRowLocks]
                , [R].[Rec_DataCompression]
                , [R].[Rec_SortInTempdb]
                , [R].[Rec_MaxDop]
                , [R].[Reason]
                , [R].[PriorityScore]
                , [R].[SuggestedScript]
            FROM #rec AS [R]
            WHERE [R].[IncludedInPlan] = 1
              AND [R].[SuggestedScript] IS NOT NULL
        ) AS [SRC]
          ON [TGT].[PlanDate] = [SRC].[PlanDate]
         AND [TGT].[TargetDatabaseName] = [SRC].[TargetDatabaseName]
         AND [TGT].[SnapshotId] = [SRC].[SnapshotId]
         AND [TGT].[ObjectType] = [SRC].[ObjectType]
         AND [TGT].[SchemaName] = [SRC].[SchemaName]
         AND [TGT].[ObjectName] = [SRC].[ObjectName]
         AND [TGT].[IndexName] = [SRC].[IndexName]
         AND [TGT].[IndexId] = [SRC].[IndexId]
         AND [TGT].[PartitionNumber] = [SRC].[PartitionNumber]
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
            UPDATE SET
                  [TGT].[PageCount] = [SRC].[PageCount]
                , [TGT].[IndexSizeMB] = [SRC].[IndexSizeMB]
                , [TGT].[AvgFragmentationInPercent] = [SRC].[AvgFragmentationInPercent]
                , [TGT].[CurrentFillFactor] = [SRC].[CurrentFillFactor]
                , [TGT].[CurrentPadIndex] = [SRC].[CurrentPadIndex]
                , [TGT].[CurrentAllowPageLocks] = [SRC].[CurrentAllowPageLocks]
                , [TGT].[CurrentAllowRowLocks] = [SRC].[CurrentAllowRowLocks]
                , [TGT].[CurrentCompression] = [SRC].[CurrentCompression]
                , [TGT].[Rec_Action] = [SRC].[Rec_Action]
                , [TGT].[Rec_FillFactor] = [SRC].[Rec_FillFactor]
                , [TGT].[Rec_PadIndex] = [SRC].[Rec_PadIndex]
                , [TGT].[Rec_AllowPageLocks] = [SRC].[Rec_AllowPageLocks]
                , [TGT].[Rec_AllowRowLocks] = [SRC].[Rec_AllowRowLocks]
                , [TGT].[Rec_DataCompression] = [SRC].[Rec_DataCompression]
                , [TGT].[Rec_SortInTempdb] = [SRC].[Rec_SortInTempdb]
                , [TGT].[Rec_MaxDop] = [SRC].[Rec_MaxDop]
                , [TGT].[Reason] = [SRC].[Reason]
                , [TGT].[PriorityScore] = [SRC].[PriorityScore]
                , [TGT].[SuggestedScript] = [SRC].[SuggestedScript]
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
            INSERT
            (
                  [PlanDate],[TargetDatabaseName],[SnapshotId]
                , [ObjectType],[SchemaName],[ObjectName],[IndexName],[IndexId],[PartitionNumber]
                , [PageCount],[IndexSizeMB],[AvgFragmentationInPercent]
                , [CurrentFillFactor],[CurrentPadIndex],[CurrentAllowPageLocks],[CurrentAllowRowLocks],[CurrentCompression]
                , [Rec_Action],[Rec_FillFactor],[Rec_PadIndex],[Rec_AllowPageLocks],[Rec_AllowRowLocks]
                , [Rec_DataCompression],[Rec_SortInTempdb],[Rec_MaxDop]
                , [Reason],[PriorityScore],[SuggestedScript]
            )
            VALUES
            (
                  [SRC].[PlanDate],[SRC].[TargetDatabaseName],[SRC].[SnapshotId]
                , [SRC].[ObjectType],[SRC].[SchemaName],[SRC].[ObjectName],[SRC].[IndexName],[SRC].[IndexId],[SRC].[PartitionNumber]
                , [SRC].[PageCount],[SRC].[IndexSizeMB],[SRC].[AvgFragmentationInPercent]
                , [SRC].[CurrentFillFactor],[SRC].[CurrentPadIndex],[SRC].[CurrentAllowPageLocks],[SRC].[CurrentAllowRowLocks],[SRC].[CurrentCompression]
                , [SRC].[Rec_Action],[SRC].[Rec_FillFactor],[SRC].[Rec_PadIndex],[SRC].[Rec_AllowPageLocks],[SRC].[Rec_AllowRowLocks]
                , [SRC].[Rec_DataCompression],[SRC].[Rec_SortInTempdb],[SRC].[Rec_MaxDop]
                , [SRC].[Reason],[SRC].[PriorityScore],[SRC].[SuggestedScript]
            );
    END;
END

/*==============================================================================

  - Compatvel com a estrutura real de Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_StatsSnapshot
  - Evita UPDATE_STATS para stats de ndice cobertas por REBUILD correspondente
  - Respeita fila  real

/*==============================================================================
  INDEX ADVISOR  - DOCUMENTAÇÃO FUNCIONAL E TÉCNICA DAS PROCS
  BASE: SCRIPT_TUNING_.sql + ajustes realizados na PC_IndexAdvisor_GenerateStatsPlan

  OBJETIVO DESTE ARQUIVO
    Documentar as regras, motivações e decisões operacionais de todas as
    procedures principais da solução IndexAdvisor , no mesmo estilo de cabeçalho
    técnico usado nas versões anteriores, mas atualizado para a arquitetura .

  VISÃO GERAL DA ARQUITETURA 
    A  foi desenhada para separar claramente o ciclo em 5 camadas:

    1) CONFIGURAÇÃO
       - Tabela de defaults por banco
       - Evita dependência manual do suporte
       - Permite parametrização por database

    2) COLETA / SNAPSHOT
       - Captura ambiente, índices, estatísticas e configuração do banco
       - Gera um SnapshotId consistente para correlação

    3) GERAÇÃO DE PLANOS
       - Plano de índices
       - Plano de estatísticas
       - Plano de configuração de banco
       - Reviews analíticos (overlap, unused, redundância)

    4) ORQUESTRAÇÃO
       - RunCore / RunAll coordenam a sequência completa
       - Garante que a geração dos planos use snapshots válidos

    5) CONSUMO / FILA EXTERNA / HISTÓRICO
       - Enfileiramento para DBA.TarefasManutencao
       - Atualização de status
       - Limpeza de histórico

  PRINCÍPIOS GERAIS DA 
    - Toda recomendação é heurística e orientada a segurança operacional.
    - A ferramenta privilegia automação em ações de baixo risco e REVIEW onde a
      mudança pode ter impacto sistêmico.
    - Indexed views recebem tratamento diferenciado porque têm custo de manutenção
      extra em cada modificação das tabelas base.
    - tempdb é tratado como fator crítico em decisões de SORT_IN_TEMPDB e em
      recomendações de configuração de concorrência.
    - A  separa índice, estatística e configuração do banco em filas distintas,
      para permitir execução e análise mais controladas.
==============================================================================*/

/*==============================================================================
  PROC: Manutencao.PC_IndexAdvisor_GenerateStatsPlan
  VERSÃO: 
  FINALIDADE:
    Gerar o plano de UPDATE STATISTICS baseado na snapshot real de estatísticas.

  OBJETIVO DA PROC:
    1) Identificar stats stale/elegíveis.
    2) Separar stats de índice de stats independentes.
    3) Evitar update stats desnecessário quando o índice correspondente já será
       REBUILD.
    4) Definir sampling apropriado por porte do objeto.
    5) Gerar fila sem duplicidade operacional PENDING.

  REGRAS PRINCIPAIS:

  1) ELEGIBILIDADE
     A stat vira candidata quando:
       - IncludeUpdateStats = 1
       - e (StatsStale = 1 ou ModificationCounter >= StatsMinModificationCount)

     MOTIVO:
       usar stale como critério principal, mas permitir entrada quando o número de
       modificações absolutas já justifica revisão.

  2) EXCLUSÃO POR REBUILD DO ÍNDICE
     A proc zera a ação quando:
       - IsFromIndex = 1
       - existe item em IndexPlanQueue com mesmo banco, snapshot, schema,
         objeto e índice correspondente
       - Rec_Action = REBUILD
       - Status = PENDING

     MATCH PRINCIPAL:
       RelatedIndexId = IndexId

     FALLBACK:
       RelatedIndexName = IndexName, quando RelatedIndexId vier nulo.

     MOTIVO:
       REBUILD já atualiza a estatística do índice; fazer UPDATE STATISTICS depois
       seria custo duplicado.

     OBS:
       REORGANIZE não exclui automaticamente a stat.
       MOTIVO:
         REORGANIZE não entrega o mesmo efeito de atualização estatística que o
         REBUILD.

  3) SAMPLING
     A decisão usa o porte do objeto a partir da config :
       - pequeno -> FULLSCAN
       - médio -> SAMPLE <StatsSamplePercentMedium>
       - grande -> SAMPLE <StatsSamplePercentLarge>
       - muito grande -> SAMPLE <StatsSamplePercentVeryLarge>

     MOTIVO:
       FULLSCAN é ótimo em objetos pequenos/médios; em objetos grandes o custo
       pode ser desproporcional.

  4) PRIORITYSCORE
     A  usa escala compatível com a fila real, com faixas como:
       - 340
       - 280
       - 260
       - 220
       - 200
       - 180

     REGRA LÓGICA:
       - VIEW / stats de view mais sensíveis -> topo
       - stats não ligadas a índice e stale -> prioridade alta
       - stats de índice stale, sem rebuild correspondente -> prioridade alta,
         mas abaixo de VIEW/não-index equivalente
       - sample mais agressivo ou elegibilidade mínima -> prioridade menor

     MOTIVO:
       manter ordenação operacional coerente com o padrão da fila existente.

  5) REASON
     A proc documenta por que a stat entrou ou não entrou, por exemplo:
       - stale/elegível
       - update desabilitado na config
       - índice coberto por REBUILD
       - não stale e abaixo do mínimo de modificações

  6) ANTI-DUPLICIDADE
     Regra operacional adotada:
       não inserir novamente se já existir item PENDING para a mesma chave lógica:
         - SnapshotId
         - TargetDatabaseName
         - SchemaName
         - ObjectName
         - StatsName

     MOTIVO:
       evitar duplicidade de planejamento dentro do mesmo snapshot e manter a
       fila limpa para execução.

     OBS:
       se existir DONE, a proc pode gerar nova linha.

  7) PERSISTÊNCIA
     A fila recebe somente:
       - Rec_Action = UPDATE_STATS
       - SuggestedScript não nulo
       - sem duplicidade PENDING

  LIMITAÇÕES IMPORTANTES:
    - stats muito pequenas podem distorcer percentual; por isso a decisão não se
      apoia apenas em ModificationPct.
    - stats independentes continuam sendo importantes mesmo sem relação com índice,
      especialmente AUTO_COLUMN.
==============================================================================*/

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE [Manutencao].[PC_IndexAdvisor_GenerateStatsPlan]
(
      @TargetDatabase SYSNAME
    , @PlanDate DATE = NULL
    , @SnapshotId BIGINT = NULL
    , @QueuePlan BIT = 1
    , @Debug BIT = 0
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 1) Validao de entrada
    --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    SET @TargetDatabase = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@TargetDatabase)), N'');

    IF @TargetDatabase IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR(N'@TargetDatabase est vazio.', 16, 1);
        RETURN;
    END;

    IF @PlanDate IS NULL
        SET @PlanDate = CONVERT(date, GETDATE());

    --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 2) Resolve SnapshotId vlido
    --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    IF @SnapshotId IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP (1)
            @SnapshotId = e.[SnapshotId]
        FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_EnvironmentSnapshot AS e
        WHERE e.[TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
          AND EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_StatsSnapshot AS s
              WHERE s.[TargetDatabaseName] = e.[TargetDatabaseName]
                AND s.[SnapshotId] = e.[SnapshotId]
          )
        ORDER BY e.[SnapshotId] DESC;
    END;

    IF @SnapshotId IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR(N'Nenhum SnapshotId encontrado para %s.', 16, 1, @TargetDatabase);
        RETURN;
    END;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_StatsSnapshot AS s
        WHERE s.[TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
          AND s.[SnapshotId] = @SnapshotId
    )
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR(
            N'Nenhum StatsSnapshot encontrado para %s no SnapshotId=%I64d.',
            16, 1, @TargetDatabase, @SnapshotId
        );
        RETURN;
    END;

    --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 3) Configurao 
    --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    DECLARE
          @IncludeUpdateStats BIT
        , @StatsMinModificationCount BIGINT
        , @StatsSmallObjectRows BIGINT
        , @StatsMediumObjectRows BIGINT
        , @StatsLargeObjectRows BIGINT
        , @StatsSamplePercentMedium INT
        , @StatsSamplePercentLarge INT
        , @StatsSamplePercentVeryLarge INT;

    SELECT TOP (1)
          @IncludeUpdateStats = c.[IncludeUpdateStats]
        , @StatsMinModificationCount = c.[StatsMinModificationCount]
        , @StatsSmallObjectRows = c.[StatsSmallObjectRows]
        , @StatsMediumObjectRows = c.[StatsMediumObjectRows]
        , @StatsLargeObjectRows = c.[StatsLargeObjectRows]
        , @StatsSamplePercentMedium = c.[StatsSamplePercentMedium]
        , @StatsSamplePercentLarge = c.[StatsSamplePercentLarge]
        , @StatsSamplePercentVeryLarge = c.[StatsSamplePercentVeryLarge]
    FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_Config AS c
    WHERE c.[TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase;

    -- Defaults defensivos caso a config esteja incompleta
    SET @IncludeUpdateStats = ISNULL(@IncludeUpdateStats, 1);
    SET @StatsMinModificationCount = ISNULL(@StatsMinModificationCount, 500);
    SET @StatsSmallObjectRows = ISNULL(@StatsSmallObjectRows, 100000);
    SET @StatsMediumObjectRows = ISNULL(@StatsMediumObjectRows, 1000000);
    SET @StatsLargeObjectRows = ISNULL(@StatsLargeObjectRows, 10000000);
    SET @StatsSamplePercentMedium = ISNULL(@StatsSamplePercentMedium, 50);
    SET @StatsSamplePercentLarge = ISNULL(@StatsSamplePercentLarge, 20);
    SET @StatsSamplePercentVeryLarge = ISNULL(@StatsSamplePercentVeryLarge, 10);

    --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 4) rea de trabalho
    --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#statsrec') IS NOT NULL
        DROP TABLE #statsrec;

    CREATE TABLE #statsrec
(
      [TargetDatabaseName] SYSNAME NOT NULL
    , [SnapshotId] BIGINT NOT NULL
    , [ObjectType] CHAR(1) NOT NULL
    , [SchemaName] SYSNAME NOT NULL
    , [ObjectName] SYSNAME NOT NULL
    , [ObjectId] INT NOT NULL
    , [StatsName] SYSNAME NOT NULL
    , [StatsId] INT NOT NULL
    , [StatsType] NVARCHAR(60) NOT NULL
    , [IsFromIndex] BIT NOT NULL
    , [RelatedIndexId] INT NULL
    , [RelatedIndexName] SYSNAME NULL
    , [RowCount] BIGINT NULL
    , [ModificationCounter] BIGINT NULL
    , [ModificationPct] FLOAT NULL
    , [LastUpdated] DATETIME NULL
    , [ObjectSizeMB] DECIMAL(19,2) NULL
    , [StatsStale] BIT NOT NULL
    , [Rec_Action] NVARCHAR(40) NOT NULL DEFAULT(N'NONE')
    , [Rec_Sampling] NVARCHAR(100) NULL
    , [PriorityScore] INT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0)
    , [Reason] NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL
    , [SuggestedScript] NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL
);

    INSERT INTO #statsrec
    (
          [TargetDatabaseName]
        , [SnapshotId]
        , [ObjectType]
        , [SchemaName]
        , [ObjectName]
        , [ObjectId]
        , [StatsName]
        , [StatsId]
        , [StatsType]
        , [IsFromIndex]
        , [RelatedIndexId]
        , [RelatedIndexName]
        , [RowCount]
        , [ModificationCounter]
        , [ModificationPct]
        , [LastUpdated]
        , [ObjectSizeMB]
        , [StatsStale]
    )
    SELECT
          s.[TargetDatabaseName]
        , s.[SnapshotId]
        , s.[ObjectType]
        , s.[SchemaName]
        , s.[ObjectName]
        , s.[ObjectId]
        , s.[StatsName]
        , s.[StatsId]
        , s.[StatsType]
        , s.[IsFromIndex]
        , s.[RelatedIndexId]
        , s.[RelatedIndexName]
        , s.[RowCount]
        , s.[ModificationCounter]
        , s.[ModificationPct]
        , s.[LastUpdated]
        , s.[ObjectSizeMB]
        , s.[StatsStale]
    FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_StatsSnapshot AS s
    WHERE s.[TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
      AND s.[SnapshotId] = @SnapshotId;

    --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 5) ndices que j vo sofrer REBUILD no snapshot/planDate atual
    --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#idx_rebuild') IS NOT NULL
        DROP TABLE #idx_rebuild;

    CREATE TABLE #idx_rebuild
    (
          [SchemaName] SYSNAME NOT NULL
        , [ObjectName] SYSNAME NOT NULL
        , [IndexId] INT NOT NULL
        , [IndexName] SYSNAME NOT NULL
        , PRIMARY KEY ([SchemaName], [ObjectName], [IndexId], [IndexName])
    );

    INSERT INTO #idx_rebuild
    (
          [SchemaName]
        , [ObjectName]
        , [IndexId]
        , [IndexName]
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT
          q.[SchemaName]
        , q.[ObjectName]
        , q.[IndexId]
        , q.[IndexName]
    FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexPlanQueue AS q
    WHERE q.[TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
      AND q.[PlanDate] = @PlanDate
      AND q.[SnapshotId] = @SnapshotId
      AND q.[Rec_Action] = N'REBUILD'
      AND q.[Status] = N'PENDING';

    --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 6) Elegibilidade inicial
    --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    UPDATE sr
       SET sr.[Rec_Action] =
            CASE
                WHEN @IncludeUpdateStats = 0 THEN N'NONE'
                WHEN sr.[StatsStale] = 1 THEN N'UPDATE_STATS'
                WHEN ISNULL(sr.[ModificationCounter], 0) >= @StatsMinModificationCount THEN N'UPDATE_STATS'
                ELSE N'NONE'
            END
    FROM #statsrec AS sr;

    --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 7) Excluir stats cobertas por REBUILD correspondente
    --    Match principal por RelatedIndexId = IndexId
    --    Fallback por nome se RelatedIndexId vier nulo
    --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    UPDATE sr
       SET sr.[Rec_Action] = N'NONE',
           sr.[Reason] = N'Estatstica do ndice ser atualizada pelo REBUILD correspondente.'
    FROM #statsrec AS sr
    WHERE sr.[Rec_Action] = N'UPDATE_STATS'
      AND sr.[IsFromIndex] = 1
      AND EXISTS
      (
          SELECT 1
          FROM #idx_rebuild AS ir
          WHERE ir.[SchemaName] = sr.[SchemaName]
            AND ir.[ObjectName] = sr.[ObjectName]
            AND
            (
                   (sr.[RelatedIndexId] IS NOT NULL AND ir.[IndexId] = sr.[RelatedIndexId])
                OR (sr.[RelatedIndexId] IS NULL AND sr.[RelatedIndexName] IS NOT NULL AND ir.[IndexName] = sr.[RelatedIndexName])
            )
      );

    --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 8) Sampling
    --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    UPDATE sr
       SET sr.[Rec_Sampling] =
            CASE
                WHEN sr.[Rec_Action] <> N'UPDATE_STATS' THEN NULL
                WHEN ISNULL(sr.[RowCount], 0) <= @StatsSmallObjectRows
                    THEN N'FULLSCAN'
                WHEN ISNULL(sr.[RowCount], 0) <= @StatsMediumObjectRows
                    THEN N'SAMPLE ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @StatsSamplePercentMedium) + N' PERCENT'
                WHEN ISNULL(sr.[RowCount], 0) <= @StatsLargeObjectRows
                    THEN N'SAMPLE ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @StatsSamplePercentLarge) + N' PERCENT'
                ELSE N'SAMPLE ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @StatsSamplePercentVeryLarge) + N' PERCENT'
            END
    FROM #statsrec AS sr;

    --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 9) PriorityScore em escala aderente  fila real
    --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    UPDATE sr
       SET sr.[PriorityScore] =
            CASE
                WHEN sr.[Rec_Action] <> N'UPDATE_STATS' THEN 0

                -- views/indexed views / stats de view mais sensveis
                WHEN sr.[StatsType] = N'VIEW' OR sr.[ObjectType] = 'V' THEN 340

                -- no-index, stale, sampling mais forte
                WHEN sr.[IsFromIndex] = 0 AND sr.[StatsStale] = 1
                     AND sr.[Rec_Sampling] IN (N'FULLSCAN', N'SAMPLE 20 PERCENT')
                    THEN 280

                -- index stats stale, sem rebuild correspondente
                WHEN sr.[IsFromIndex] = 1 AND sr.[StatsStale] = 1
                     AND sr.[Rec_Sampling] = N'FULLSCAN'
                    THEN 260

                -- no-index, stale, sample 50%
                WHEN sr.[IsFromIndex] = 0 AND sr.[StatsStale] = 1
                     AND sr.[Rec_Sampling] = N'SAMPLE 50 PERCENT'
                    THEN 220

                -- stats elegveis com menor prioridade, sample 50% ou 10%
                WHEN sr.[IsFromIndex] = 0
                    THEN 200

                -- index stats elegveis, sampling menor
                WHEN sr.[IsFromIndex] = 1 AND sr.[Rec_Sampling] = N'SAMPLE 50 PERCENT'
                    THEN 200

                ELSE 180
            END
    FROM #statsrec AS sr;

    --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 10) Reason
    --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    UPDATE sr
       SET sr.[Reason] =
            CASE
                WHEN sr.[Rec_Action] <> N'UPDATE_STATS' AND sr.[Reason] IS NOT NULL THEN sr.[Reason]

                WHEN sr.[Rec_Action] <> N'UPDATE_STATS' AND @IncludeUpdateStats = 0
                    THEN N'Update statistics desabilitado na configurao.'

                WHEN sr.[Rec_Action] <> N'UPDATE_STATS' AND sr.[StatsStale] = 0
                     AND ISNULL(sr.[ModificationCounter], 0) < @StatsMinModificationCount
                    THEN N'Estatstica no est stale e no atingiu o mnimo de modificaes.'

                WHEN sr.[Rec_Action] <> N'UPDATE_STATS' AND sr.[StatsStale] = 0
                    THEN N'Estatstica no est stale.'

                WHEN sr.[Rec_Action] = N'UPDATE_STATS'
                    THEN
                        N'Stats stale/elegvel. '
                        + N'Type=' + ISNULL(sr.[StatsType], N'') + N'. '
                        + N'IsFromIndex=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(1), sr.[IsFromIndex]) + N'. '
                        + N'ModCounter=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30), ISNULL(sr.[ModificationCounter], 0)) + N'. '
                        + N'ModPct=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), ISNULL(sr.[ModificationPct], 0)) + N'. '
                        + N'Sampling=' + ISNULL(sr.[Rec_Sampling], N'') + N'.'

                ELSE N'Sem ao.'
            END
    FROM #statsrec AS sr;

    --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 11) SuggestedScript
    --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    UPDATE sr
       SET sr.[SuggestedScript] =
            CASE
                WHEN sr.[Rec_Action] <> N'UPDATE_STATS' THEN NULL
                ELSE
                    N'UPDATE STATISTICS '
                    + QUOTENAME(sr.[SchemaName]) + N'.' + QUOTENAME(sr.[ObjectName])
                    + N' ' + QUOTENAME(sr.[StatsName])
                    + N' WITH ' + sr.[Rec_Sampling] + N';'
            END
    FROM #statsrec AS sr;

    --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 12) Debug
    --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    IF @Debug = 1
    BEGIN
        SELECT
              [PlanDate] = @PlanDate
            , [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
            , [SnapshotId] = @SnapshotId
            , [RowsRead] = COUNT_BIG(1)
            , [RowsInPlan] = SUM(CASE WHEN [Rec_Action] = N'UPDATE_STATS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        FROM #statsrec;
    END;

    --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 13) Grid 0 - documentao
    --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
          [GridName] = N'0) Documentao'
        , [Analysis] = N'Plano de estatsticas'
        , [Description] = N'Inclui index stats, auto-created stats, user-created stats e stats de indexed views. No atualiza estatstica de ndice quando o ndice correspondente j ser REBUILD. Anti-duplicidade: no reinsere item j PENDING para a mesma chave lgica no mesmo SnapshotId.';

    --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 14) Grid 1 - plano gerado
    --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
          sr.[PriorityScore]
        , sr.[ObjectType]
        , sr.[SchemaName]
        , sr.[ObjectName]
        , sr.[StatsName]
        , sr.[StatsType]
        , sr.[IsFromIndex]
        , sr.[RelatedIndexName]
        , sr.[RowCount]
        , sr.[ModificationCounter]
        , sr.[ModificationPct]
        , sr.[LastUpdated]
        , sr.[ObjectSizeMB]
        , sr.[Rec_Action]
        , sr.[Rec_Sampling]
        , sr.[Reason]
        , sr.[SuggestedScript]
    FROM #statsrec AS sr
    WHERE sr.[Rec_Action] = N'UPDATE_STATS'
      AND sr.[SuggestedScript] IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY
          sr.[PriorityScore] DESC
        , sr.[ObjectType]
        , sr.[SchemaName]
        , sr.[ObjectName]
        , sr.[StatsName];

    --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 15) Persistncia na fila
    --     Regra B: no inserir novamente se j existir PENDING
    --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    IF @QueuePlan = 1
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_StatsPlanQueue
        (
              [PlanDate]
            , [TargetDatabaseName]
            , [SnapshotId]
            , [ObjectType]
            , [SchemaName]
            , [ObjectName]
            , [StatsName]
            , [StatsId]
            , [StatsType]
            , [IsFromIndex]
            , [RelatedIndexName]
            , [RowCount]
            , [ModificationCounter]
            , [ModificationPct]
            , [LastUpdated]
            , [ObjectSizeMB]
            , [Rec_Action]
            , [Rec_Sampling]
            , [Reason]
            , [PriorityScore]
            , [SuggestedScript]
            , [Status]
            , [CreatedAt]
        )
        SELECT
              @PlanDate
            , @TargetDatabase
            , @SnapshotId
            , sr.[ObjectType]
            , sr.[SchemaName]
            , sr.[ObjectName]
            , sr.[StatsName]
            , sr.[StatsId]
            , sr.[StatsType]
            , sr.[IsFromIndex]
            , sr.[RelatedIndexName]
            , sr.[RowCount]
            , sr.[ModificationCounter]
            , sr.[ModificationPct]
            , sr.[LastUpdated]
            , sr.[ObjectSizeMB]
            , sr.[Rec_Action]
            , sr.[Rec_Sampling]
            , sr.[Reason]
            , sr.[PriorityScore]
            , sr.[SuggestedScript]
            , N'PENDING'
            , SYSDATETIME()
        FROM #statsrec AS sr
        WHERE sr.[Rec_Action] = N'UPDATE_STATS'
          AND sr.[SuggestedScript] IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_StatsPlanQueue AS q
              WHERE q.[SnapshotId] = @SnapshotId
                AND q.[TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
                AND q.[SchemaName] = sr.[SchemaName]
                AND q.[ObjectName] = sr.[ObjectName]
                AND q.[StatsName] = sr.[StatsName]
                AND q.[Status] = N'PENDING'
          );

        IF @Debug = 1
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                [RowsInsertedIntoQueue] = @@ROWCOUNT;
        END;
    END;
END

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE Manutencao.PC_IndexAdvisor_GenerateDbConfigPlan
(
      @TargetDatabase SYSNAME
    , @PlanDate DATE = NULL
    , @SnapshotId BIGINT = NULL
    , @QueuePlan BIT = 1
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SET @TargetDatabase = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@TargetDatabase)), N'');

    IF @TargetDatabase IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR(N'@TargetDatabase est vazio.',16,1);
        RETURN;
    END;

    IF @PlanDate IS NULL
        SET @PlanDate = CONVERT(date, GETDATE());

    IF @SnapshotId IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP (1) @SnapshotId = [SnapshotId]
        FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_EnvironmentSnapshot
        WHERE [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
        ORDER BY [SnapshotId] DESC;
    END;

    IF @SnapshotId IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR(N'Nenhum SnapshotId encontrado para %s.',16,1,@TargetDatabase);
        RETURN;
    END;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_DbConfigSnapshot
        WHERE [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
          AND [SnapshotId] = @SnapshotId
    )
    BEGIN
        EXEC Manutencao.PC_IndexAdvisor_CollectDbConfig
             @TargetDatabase = @TargetDatabase,
             @SnapshotId = @SnapshotId;
    END;

    DELETE Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_DbConfigPlan
    WHERE [PlanDate] = @PlanDate
      AND [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
      AND [SnapshotId] = @SnapshotId;

    DECLARE
        @AllowRecommendRCSI BIT = 1,
        @AllowRecommendSnapshotIsolation BIT = 1,
        @AllowRecommendAsyncStats BIT = 1,
        @AllowRecommendQueryStore BIT = 1;

    SELECT TOP (1)
        @AllowRecommendRCSI = [AllowRecommendRCSI],
        @AllowRecommendSnapshotIsolation = [AllowRecommendSnapshotIsolation],
        @AllowRecommendAsyncStats = [AllowRecommendAsyncStats],
        @AllowRecommendQueryStore = [AllowRecommendQueryStore]
    FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_Config
    WHERE [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase;

    DECLARE
        @AutoCreateStatistics BIT,
        @AutoUpdateStatistics BIT,
        @AutoUpdateStatisticsAsync BIT,
        @IsReadCommittedSnapshotOn BIT,
        @SnapshotIsolationState TINYINT,
        @SnapshotIsolationStateDesc NVARCHAR(60),
        @ParameterizationDesc NVARCHAR(60),
        @RecoveryModelDesc NVARCHAR(60),
        @PageVerifyOptionDesc NVARCHAR(60),
        @IsQueryStoreOn BIT,
        @CompatibilityLevel INT;

    SELECT TOP (1)
        @AutoCreateStatistics = [AutoCreateStatistics],
        @AutoUpdateStatistics = [AutoUpdateStatistics],
        @AutoUpdateStatisticsAsync = [AutoUpdateStatisticsAsync],
        @IsReadCommittedSnapshotOn = [IsReadCommittedSnapshotOn],
        @SnapshotIsolationState = [SnapshotIsolationState],
        @SnapshotIsolationStateDesc = [SnapshotIsolationStateDesc],
        @ParameterizationDesc = [ParameterizationDesc],
        @RecoveryModelDesc = [RecoveryModelDesc],
        @PageVerifyOptionDesc = [PageVerifyOptionDesc],
        @IsQueryStoreOn = [IsQueryStoreOn],
        @CompatibilityLevel = [CompatibilityLevel]
    FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_DbConfigSnapshot
    WHERE [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
      AND [SnapshotId] = @SnapshotId;

    INSERT Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_DbConfigPlan
    (
        [PlanDate],[TargetDatabaseName],[SnapshotId],
        [ConfigName],[CurrentValue],[RecommendedValue],[Classification],[PriorityScore],[Reason],[SuggestedScript]
    )
    SELECT
        @PlanDate, @TargetDatabase, @SnapshotId,
        [x].[ConfigName], [x].[CurrentValue], [x].[RecommendedValue], [x].[Classification], [x].[PriorityScore], [x].[Reason], [x].[SuggestedScript]
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            [ConfigName] = N'AUTO_CREATE_STATISTICS',
            [CurrentValue] = CASE WHEN @AutoCreateStatistics=1 THEN N'ON' ELSE N'OFF' END,
            [RecommendedValue] = N'ON',
            [Classification] = CASE WHEN @AutoCreateStatistics=1 THEN N'SAFE' ELSE N'REVIEW' END,
            [PriorityScore] = CASE WHEN @AutoCreateStatistics=1 THEN 10 ELSE 80 END,
            [Reason] = CASE WHEN @AutoCreateStatistics=1
                            THEN N'Configurao adequada para OLTP.'
                            ELSE N'Em OLTP normalmente deve ficar ON.'
                       END,
            [SuggestedScript] = CASE WHEN @AutoCreateStatistics=0
                                     THEN N'ALTER DATABASE ' + QUOTENAME(@TargetDatabase) + N' SET AUTO_CREATE_STATISTICS ON;'
                                END

        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            N'AUTO_UPDATE_STATISTICS',
            CASE WHEN @AutoUpdateStatistics=1 THEN N'ON' ELSE N'OFF' END,
            N'ON',
            CASE WHEN @AutoUpdateStatistics=1 THEN N'SAFE' ELSE N'REVIEW' END,
            CASE WHEN @AutoUpdateStatistics=1 THEN 10 ELSE 100 END,
            CASE WHEN @AutoUpdateStatistics=1
                 THEN N'Configurao adequada para OLTP.'
                 ELSE N'Em OLTP normalmente deve ficar ON.'
            END,
            CASE WHEN @AutoUpdateStatistics=0
                 THEN N'ALTER DATABASE ' + QUOTENAME(@TargetDatabase) + N' SET AUTO_UPDATE_STATISTICS ON;'
            END

        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            N'AUTO_UPDATE_STATISTICS_ASYNC',
            CASE WHEN @AutoUpdateStatisticsAsync=1 THEN N'ON' ELSE N'OFF' END,
            CASE WHEN @AllowRecommendAsyncStats=1 THEN N'ON'
                 ELSE CASE WHEN @AutoUpdateStatisticsAsync=1 THEN N'ON' ELSE N'OFF' END END,
            CASE
                WHEN @AllowRecommendAsyncStats=1 AND @AutoUpdateStatisticsAsync=1 THEN N'SAFE'
                WHEN @AllowRecommendAsyncStats=1 AND @AutoUpdateStatisticsAsync=0 THEN N'REVIEW'
                ELSE N'SAFE'
            END,
            CASE
                WHEN @AllowRecommendAsyncStats=1 AND @AutoUpdateStatisticsAsync=0 THEN 120
                ELSE 10
            END,
            CASE
                WHEN @AllowRecommendAsyncStats=1 AND @AutoUpdateStatisticsAsync=1 THEN N'Para OLTP write-heavy, ASYNC ON  saudvel.'
                WHEN @AllowRecommendAsyncStats=1 AND @AutoUpdateStatisticsAsync=0 THEN N'Para OLTP write-heavy, ASYNC ON costuma reduzir impacto do auto update sncrono.'
                ELSE N'Sem recomendao automtica para esse item.'
            END,
            CASE
                WHEN @AllowRecommendAsyncStats=1 AND @AutoUpdateStatisticsAsync=0
                THEN N'ALTER DATABASE ' + QUOTENAME(@TargetDatabase) + N' SET AUTO_UPDATE_STATISTICS_ASYNC ON;'
            END

        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            N'READ_COMMITTED_SNAPSHOT',
            CASE WHEN @IsReadCommittedSnapshotOn=1 THEN N'ON' ELSE N'OFF' END,
            CASE WHEN @AllowRecommendRCSI=1 THEN N'REVIEW_FORTE'
                 ELSE CASE WHEN @IsReadCommittedSnapshotOn=1 THEN N'ON' ELSE N'OFF' END END,
            CASE WHEN @AllowRecommendRCSI=1 AND @IsReadCommittedSnapshotOn=0 THEN N'REVIEW' ELSE N'SAFE' END,
            CASE WHEN @AllowRecommendRCSI=1 AND @IsReadCommittedSnapshotOn=0 THEN 150 ELSE 20 END,
            CASE
                WHEN @IsReadCommittedSnapshotOn=1 THEN N'RCSI j est habilitado.'
                WHEN @AllowRecommendRCSI=1 THEN N'Para OLTP com conteno de leitura/escrita, RCSI merece avaliao forte.'
                ELSE N'Sem recomendao automtica para esse item.'
            END,
            CASE
                WHEN @AllowRecommendRCSI=1 AND @IsReadCommittedSnapshotOn=0
                THEN N'ALTER DATABASE ' + QUOTENAME(@TargetDatabase) + N' SET READ_COMMITTED_SNAPSHOT ON WITH ROLLBACK IMMEDIATE;'
            END

        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            N'ALLOW_SNAPSHOT_ISOLATION',
            @SnapshotIsolationStateDesc,
            CASE WHEN @AllowRecommendSnapshotIsolation=1 THEN N'REVIEW' ELSE @SnapshotIsolationStateDesc END,
            N'SAFE',
            20,
            N'Habilitar snapshot isolation depende do padro transacional da aplicao.',
            CASE
                WHEN @AllowRecommendSnapshotIsolation=1 AND @SnapshotIsolationState = 0
                THEN N'ALTER DATABASE ' + QUOTENAME(@TargetDatabase) + N' SET ALLOW_SNAPSHOT_ISOLATION ON;'
            END

        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            N'PAGE_VERIFY',
            @PageVerifyOptionDesc,
            N'CHECKSUM',
            CASE WHEN @PageVerifyOptionDesc = N'CHECKSUM' THEN N'SAFE' ELSE N'REVIEW' END,
            CASE WHEN @PageVerifyOptionDesc = N'CHECKSUM' THEN 10 ELSE 120 END,
            CASE WHEN @PageVerifyOptionDesc = N'CHECKSUM' THEN N'Configurao adequada.' ELSE N'CHECKSUM  a configurao recomendada.' END,
            CASE WHEN @PageVerifyOptionDesc <> N'CHECKSUM'
                 THEN N'ALTER DATABASE ' + QUOTENAME(@TargetDatabase) + N' SET PAGE_VERIFY CHECKSUM;'
            END

        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            N'QUERY_STORE',
            CASE WHEN @IsQueryStoreOn=1 THEN N'ON' ELSE N'OFF' END,
            CASE WHEN @AllowRecommendQueryStore=1 THEN N'ON'
                 ELSE CASE WHEN @IsQueryStoreOn=1 THEN N'ON' ELSE N'OFF' END END,
            CASE WHEN @AllowRecommendQueryStore=1 AND @IsQueryStoreOn=0 THEN N'REVIEW' ELSE N'SAFE' END,
            CASE WHEN @AllowRecommendQueryStore=1 AND @IsQueryStoreOn=0 THEN 90 ELSE 10 END,
            CASE
                WHEN @IsQueryStoreOn=1 THEN N'Query Store j est habilitado.'
                WHEN @AllowRecommendQueryStore=1 THEN N'Query Store ajuda a controlar regresso e tuning.'
                ELSE N'Sem recomendao automtica para esse item.'
            END,
            CASE
                WHEN @AllowRecommendQueryStore=1 AND @IsQueryStoreOn=0
                THEN N'ALTER DATABASE ' + QUOTENAME(@TargetDatabase) + N' SET QUERY_STORE = ON;'
            END

        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            N'PARAMETERIZATION',
            @ParameterizationDesc,
            N'SIMPLE',
            CASE WHEN @ParameterizationDesc = N'SIMPLE' THEN N'SAFE' ELSE N'REVIEW' END,
            CASE WHEN @ParameterizationDesc = N'SIMPLE' THEN 10 ELSE 60 END,
            CASE WHEN @ParameterizationDesc = N'SIMPLE'
                 THEN N'Configurao comum para OLTP.'
                 ELSE N'FORCED s deve ser usado com evidncia clara.'
            END,
            NULL

        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            N'RECOVERY_MODEL',
            @RecoveryModelDesc,
            @RecoveryModelDesc,
            N'SAFE',
            10,
            N'Essa ferramenta no altera recovery model automaticamente.',
            NULL

        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            N'COMPATIBILITY_LEVEL',
            CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), @CompatibilityLevel),
            CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), @CompatibilityLevel),
            N'SAFE',
            10,
            N'Informativo. Mudana de compatibilidade exige validao separada.',
            NULL
    ) AS [x];

    SELECT
        [ConfigName],[CurrentValue],[RecommendedValue],[Classification],[PriorityScore],[Reason],[SuggestedScript]
    FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_DbConfigPlan
    WHERE [PlanDate] = @PlanDate
      AND [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
      AND [SnapshotId] = @SnapshotId
    ORDER BY [PriorityScore] DESC, [ConfigName];
END

/*==============================================================================
  2) GenerateIndexReview
     - review de ndices duplicados / overlap / unused
     - somente sugesto, sem ao automtica
==============================================================================*/
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE Manutencao.PC_IndexAdvisor_GenerateIndexReview
(
      @TargetDatabase SYSNAME
    , @PlanDate DATE = NULL
    , @SnapshotId BIGINT = NULL
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SET @TargetDatabase = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@TargetDatabase)), N'');

    IF @TargetDatabase IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR(N'@TargetDatabase est vazio.',16,1);
        RETURN;
    END;

    IF @PlanDate IS NULL
        SET @PlanDate = CONVERT(date, GETDATE());

    IF @SnapshotId IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP (1) @SnapshotId = [SnapshotId]
        FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_EnvironmentSnapshot
        WHERE [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
        ORDER BY [SnapshotId] DESC;
    END;

    DELETE Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexReview
    WHERE [PlanDate] = @PlanDate
      AND [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
      AND [SnapshotId] = @SnapshotId;

    /* Unused candidate */
    INSERT Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexReview
    (
        [PlanDate],[TargetDatabaseName],[SnapshotId],
        [ReviewType],[SchemaName],[ObjectName],[IndexName],[RelatedIndexName],
        [Reads],[Writes],[IndexSizeMB],
        [Classification],[Reason],[SuggestedAction]
    )
    SELECT
        @PlanDate,@TargetDatabase,@SnapshotId,
        N'UNUSED',
        [i].[SchemaName],[i].[ObjectName],[i].[IndexName],NULL,
        [i].[Reads],[i].[Writes],[i].[IndexSizeMB],
        N'REVIEW',
        N'ndice com reads muito baixos ou zero e writes altos. Pode ser redundante/custoso.',
        N'Validar em homolog com Query Store, planos e janela de negcio antes de considerar DROP.'
    FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexSnapshot AS [i]
    WHERE [i].[TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
      AND [i].[SnapshotId] = @SnapshotId
      AND ISNULL([i].[Reads],0) = 0
      AND ISNULL([i].[Writes],0) >= 100000
      AND ISNULL([i].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= 128;

    /* Overlap / duplicate simplificado por mesmo objeto e mesmo IndexTypeDesc + reads/writes similares */
    INSERT Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexReview
    (
        [PlanDate],[TargetDatabaseName],[SnapshotId],
        [ReviewType],[SchemaName],[ObjectName],[IndexName],[RelatedIndexName],
        [Reads],[Writes],[IndexSizeMB],
        [Classification],[Reason],[SuggestedAction]
    )
    SELECT
        @PlanDate,@TargetDatabase,@SnapshotId,
        N'OVERLAP',
        [a].[SchemaName],[a].[ObjectName],[a].[IndexName],[b].[IndexName],
        [a].[Reads],[a].[Writes],[a].[IndexSizeMB],
        N'REVIEW',
        N'Possvel sobreposio de ndices no mesmo objeto. Revisar chaves/includes e uso real.',
        N'Comparar definio completa dos ndices e validar consolidao em homolog.'
    FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexSnapshot AS [a]
    JOIN Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexSnapshot AS [b]
      ON [b].[TargetDatabaseName] = [a].[TargetDatabaseName]
     AND [b].[SnapshotId] = [a].[SnapshotId]
     AND [b].[SchemaName] = [a].[SchemaName]
     AND [b].[ObjectName] = [a].[ObjectName]
     AND [b].[IndexName] <> [a].[IndexName]
     AND [b].[IndexTypeDesc] = [a].[IndexTypeDesc]
    WHERE [a].[TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
      AND [a].[SnapshotId] = @SnapshotId
      AND [a].[IndexId] < [b].[IndexId]
      AND ISNULL([a].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= 64
      AND ISNULL([b].[IndexSizeMB],0) >= 64;

    SELECT
        [ReviewType],[SchemaName],[ObjectName],[IndexName],[RelatedIndexName],
        [Reads],[Writes],[IndexSizeMB],[Classification],[Reason],[SuggestedAction]
    FROM Manutencao.IndexAdvisor_IndexReview
    WHERE [PlanDate] = @PlanDate
      AND [TargetDatabaseName] = @TargetDatabase
      AND [SnapshotId] = @SnapshotId
    ORDER BY [ReviewType],[SchemaName],[ObjectName],[IndexName];
END
GO
